description: On-site fitting and adjustment of landing door frames, door panels, sill tracks, and interlocks at each floor opening.

name: Lift Electrical and Control Wiring
description: On-site routing and termination of power cables, traveling cables, and control wiring between the machine room, shaft devices, and car.

name: Lift Controller Programming and Testing
description: On-site configuration of the controller's logic, safety circuits, and call-allocation software followed by operational testing.

name: Lift Safety Device Commissioning
description: On-site testing and certification of overspeed governors, safety gears, buffers, door interlocks, and emergency stop systems.

name: Lift Pit Construction and Waterproofing
description: On-site excavation, formwork, concreting, and waterproofing of the lift pit to prevent groundwater ingress.

name: Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) Shielding for Lift Shaft
description: Bonded metal enclosure or foil lining around the shaft to contain electromagnetic radiation from the lift drive system.

name: Lift Emergency Phone or Intercom
description: Two-way communication device installed in the car for passengers to contact building security or emergency services.

name: Lift Smoke Detection and Fireman's Recall System
description: Fire detection sensors in the shaft and lobby that trigger automatic recall of the lift to a designated floor during a fire alarm.

name: Stretcher / Ambulance Lift
description: A lift variant with elongated car dimensions to accommodate a hospital stretcher and medical attendants.

name: Auditorium/Tiered Seating
description: Fixed stepped seating systems installed in lecture halls, theaters, or cinemas, often with attached folding tablet arms or seat numbering.

name: Bleacher/Grandstand Seating
description: Retractable or fixed telescopic seating platforms for sports halls and multipurpose venues, with integrated seat boards and footrests.

name: Fixed Bench Seating
description: Built-in wall-mounted or floor-supported continuous bench units for lobbies, corridors, locker rooms, or exterior sidewalks.

name: Fixed Individual Seat
description: Floor- or riser-mounted single chairs fastened permanently to the structure, common in cinemas, auditoriums, and transit waiting areas.

name: Reception Desk / Welcome Counter
description: Fixed front-desk assembly incorporating work surface, storage cabinetry, and fascia panels, integrated with building finishes and data/power outlets.

name: Fixed Booth Seating
description: Pre-assembled or site-built banquette seating units with fixed tables, typically installed in restaurants, cafeterias, or waiting areas.

name: Stadium Seat with Armrest
description: Injection-molded or upholstered tip-up seat attached to concrete or steel risers, with integrated cup holders and armrests.

name: Fixed Seat Anchoring System
description: Concrete-embedded or structural-steel brackets, rails, and bolts used to secure seating to the building structure or floor slab.

name: Seat Numbering / Row Marker Plate
description: Engraved or applied signage plates indicating row letters, seat numbers, or accessibility logos fixed to seat ends or riser faces.

name: Built-in Waiting Area Seating
description: Fixed modular seat-and-table assemblies installed in airport gates, hospital lobbies, or transit platforms with integrated armrest dividers.

name: Fixed Seating Installation Activity
description: Site work to set, align, level, and anchor seating units to the floor or riser structure according to layout and accessibility codes.

name: Seat Anchoring and Bolting
description: On-site drilling, epoxy injection, or torque fastening of seat brackets into structural substrate.

name: Tiered Riser / Stadia Construction
description: Concrete pouring or steel erection of stepped platforms that support fixed seating rows.

name: Seat Layout Survey and Marking
description: Field layout of seat rows, aisles, and sightline geometry using total station or laser before installation.

name: Seat Finish / Upholstery Installation
description: On-site attachment of fabric, vinyl, or perforated metal seat covers and cushions to pre-mounted seat frames.

name: Accessibility-Compliant Seating Provision
description: Installation of wheelchair companion spaces, aisle-access seats, and transfer-arm units per building code requirements.

name: Fixed Seating Framing and Support Structure
description: Underlying steel sub-frame, cantilever arms, or channel rails that transfer seat loads to the building superstructure.

name: Integrated Power/Data Grommet
description: Flush-mounted electrical outlets, USB ports, and cable management fittings built into fixed seating armrests or table surfaces.

name: Custom Cabinetry
description: Custom-fabricated cabinets designed and installed for specific spatial conditions in kitchens, bathrooms, and other rooms.

name: Kitchen Base Cabinets
description: Floor-mounted cabinet units that support countertops and provide storage in kitchen layouts.

name: Kitchen Wall Cabinets
description: Wall-mounted upper storage cabinets installed above countertops in kitchens.

name: Tall/Utility Cabinets
description: Full-height cabinet units used for pantry storage, broom closets, or utility storage that extend from floor to ceiling.

name: Vanity Cabinets
description: Bathroom cabinets installed beneath washbasins that provide storage and conceal plumbing.

name: Medicine Cabinets
description: Wall-recessed or surface-mounted mirrored storage cabinets installed in bathrooms.

name: Closet Organization Systems
description: Built-in shelving, hanging rods, and drawer units installed within closet spaces for wardrobe storage.

name: Built-in Bookcases/ Shelving
description: Custom-fitted shelving units built into wall recesses or along walls for storage and display.

name: Entertainment Center Cabinetry
description: Built-in cabinetry designed to house audio-visual equipment, televisions, and media components.

name: Home Office Built-in Desk/Workstation
description: Fixed desk surfaces, shelf units, and drawer assemblies built into a room for office use.

name: Mudroom/Locker Cabinetry
description: Built-in bench, cubby, and hook assemblies installed in entryways for storage of coats, shoes, and bags.

name: Built-in Window Seats
description: Fixed seating units constructed below windowsills, often with hinged storage beneath.

name: Reception/Check-in Desks
description: Fixed front-desk assemblies installed in lobbies, offices, or commercial entries for staff greeting and check-in functions.

name: Built-in Banquette Seating
description: Fixed bench seating installed along walls or in alcoves, typically in dining or waiting areas.

name: Laboratory Casework
description: Specialized cabinetry for science and medical labs, including chemical-resistant base and wall cabinets.

name: Millwork Trim & Moldings
description: Decorative and transitional wood or MDF trim pieces such as crown molding, baseboard, chair rail, and wainscoting.

name: Countertop Installation
description: On-site installation of stone, solid-surface, quartz, laminate, or wood countertops atop base cabinets.

name: Cabinet Hardware Installation
description: Attachment of hinges, drawer slides, knobs, pulls, and soft-close mechanisms to cabinet doors and drawers.

name: Cabinet Filler/Shim Installation
description: Placement of filler strips and shims between cabinets and adjacent walls to achieve a flush fit.

name: Backsplash Installation
description: On-site tiling or solid-sheet application of wall surfacing behind countertops, adjacent to cabinetry.

name: Under-Cabinet Lighting Installation
description: Installation of task lighting fixtures mounted beneath wall cabinets to illuminate countertop work surfaces.

name: Appliance Integration
description: Fitting of built-in appliances such as dishwashers, ovens, cooktops, and refrigerators into designated cabinet openings.

name: Custom Paneled Appliance Fronts
description: Custom millwork panels applied to appliance fronts so they match the surrounding cabinetry.

name: Toe Kick Installation
description: Recessed base trim panel installed at the bottom of base cabinets to allow toe space and conceal leveling legs.

name: Drawer/Door Fitting & Adjustment
description: Final on-site alignment and adjustment of cabinet doors and drawers for proper closure, gap consistency, and level operation.

name: Bulk Excavation
description: Large-scale removal of earth material to achieve required site levels and create space for foundations and substructures.

name: Trench Excavation
description: Narrow, linear excavation for strip footings, drainage runs, utility trenches, or retaining wall bases.

name: Pit Excavation
description: Localized deep excavation for isolated pad footings, column bases, lift pits, or sumps.

name: Mass Excavation / Basement Excavation
description: Large, deep open excavation to form basement levels, underground parking, or below-grade volumes.

name: Topsoil Stripping
description: Removal of the upper vegetative soil layer to expose sub-grade material suitable for load-bearing.

name: Rock Excavation
description: Breaking and removal of bedrock or boulders requiring mechanical ripping, chiseling, or blasting.

name: Unsuitable Material Removal & Replacement
description: Digging out soft, contaminated, or otherwise unsuitable soil and backfilling with engineered fill material.

name: Excavation Support / Shoring
description: Temporary lateral support system (sheet piles, soldier piles, lagging, or rakers) to retain excavation walls.

name: Dewatering
description: Pumping or draining groundwater from the excavation to maintain a dry working condition during construction.

name: Excavation Sloping & Benching
description: Cutting excavation sides at safe angles or in stepped benches to prevent collapse without shoring.

name: Slope & Embankment Excavation
description: Shaping of cut slopes or embankment platforms for building pads on sloped sites or terraced designs.

name: Utility Excavation
description: Trenching for incoming and outgoing building services including water, sewer, gas, electrical, and communications conduits.

name: Compaction Testing & Control
description: On-site testing of compacted sub-grade or backfill to verify density and load-bearing requirements.

name: Spoil Management & Hauling
description: Temporary stockpiling, loading, and off-site transport of excess excavated material.

name: Soil Backfilling
description: Placing and spreading excavated or imported soil material in layers around foundations, against walls, or in trenches to restore ground levels.

name: Compaction Passes
description: Applying mechanical compaction passes (via plate compactor, roller, or rammer) to each lift of backfill to achieve specified density.

name: Granular Backfill Material
description: Course-grained soils, crushed stone, or gravel used as backfill where drainage and reduced settlement are critical.

name: Engineered Fill
description: Select, tested soil material meeting specified compaction and grading requirements for structural fill applications.

name: Controlled Low-Strength Material (CLSM)
description: A flowable cementitious backfill slurry (also known as flowable fill) that self-levels and requires minimal compaction.

name: Trench Backfilling
description: Backfilling utility trenches after pipe or conduit installation, including bedding, haunching, and initial cover layers.

name: Foundation Backfilling
description: Backfilling against foundation walls or footings, performed after waterproofing and drainage board installation are complete.

name: Retaining Wall Backfill
description: Placing free-draining granular material behind retaining walls, often including a drainage composite or perforated pipe system.

name: Lift Thickness Control
description: Spreading backfill in uniform lifts of controlled thickness (typically 150–300 mm) to ensure uniform compaction.

name: Moisture Content Optimization
description: Adjusting the water content of backfill material to within the optimum moisture range for the specified compaction method.

name: Compaction Testing
description: Performing field density tests (nuclear gauge, sand cone, or rubber balloon) to verify achieved compaction meets specification.

name: Proof Rolling
description: Passing a heavy roller over the finished compacted surface to detect soft spots or inadequate compaction before subsequent work.

name: Geotextile Separation Layer
description: A woven or non-woven fabric placed between subgrade and backfill to prevent soil mixing and maintain drainage performance.

name: Backfill Compaction Equipment
description: Plate compactors, vibratory rollers, jumping jacks, and rammers used to densify backfill material on construction sites.

name: Drainage Backfill (French Drain)
description: A gravel or crushed stone backfill envelope around perforated drain pipes that collects and conveys groundwater away from the structure.

name: Scaffold Tubes
description: Metal (typically steel or aluminum) pipes used as the primary load-bearing vertical and horizontal members of the scaffold frame.

name: Scaffold Couplers/Fittings
description: Clamps and connectors (e.g., swivel, putlog, sleeve couplers) that join scaffold tubes together at nodes.

name: Scaffold Boards/Planks
description: Timber or composite planks laid across scaffold ledgers to form working platforms for personnel and materials.

name: Scaffold Base Plates
description: Metal plates placed under scaffold standards to distribute vertical loads to the ground or supporting slab.

name: Scaffold Sole Plates/Timbers
description: Timber baulks placed beneath base plates on soft ground to prevent differential settlement.

name: Scaffold Ledgers
description: Horizontal tubes running parallel to the building face, connected to standards, supporting transoms and boards.

name: Scaffold Transoms
description: Horizontal tubes spanning between ledgers perpendicular to the building face, directly supporting scaffold boards.

name: Scaffold Standards (Uprights)
description: Vertical tubes that transmit the scaffold load down to the base plates and foundations.

name: Scaffold Guardrails
description: Horizontal safety rail components fixed at working-platform level to prevent personnel falls.

name: Scaffold Toe Boards
description: Vertical boards secured along the platform edge to prevent tools and materials from falling.

name: Scaffold Bracing (Diagonal/Lateral)
description: Diagonal tubes fixed to frames to resist lateral sway and provide overall structural stability.

name: Scaffold Ladders/Stair Towers
description: Integrated or separate access ladders or stair units providing safe vertical movement between scaffold lifts.

name: Scaffold Ties (Anchors)
description: Metal ties connecting the scaffold to the building structure at regular intervals to prevent overturning.

name: Scaffold Sheeting/Netting
description: Debris netting, shrink-wrap, or tarpaulins attached to the scaffold frame for weather protection, dust containment, or safety screening.

name: Scaffold Fan/Shield Deck
description: Projecting protective platforms or decks installed at intervals to catch falling debris and protect public or lower work areas.

name: Scaffold Hoist Bracket
description: Steel bracket fixed to scaffold standards to support a material hoist or gin wheel for lifting loads.

name: Independent Tied Scaffold System
description: A freestanding scaffold frame with two rows of standards tied to the building, the most common general-access scaffold configuration.

name: Putlog Scaffold System
description: A scaffold system where one end of the transom (putlog) is built into the brick/block wall, used for masonry construction.

name: Birdcage Scaffold System
description: A dense grid of standards and ledgers forming a large internal working platform, used for ceilings and soffits.

name: Cantilever/Hanging Scaffold System
description: A scaffold supported by cantilever beams from the building structure rather than from the ground, used where ground access is restricted.

name: System Scaffold (Modular Frame)
description: A prefabricated modular scaffold system with factory-welded frames and wedged connections (e.g., Cuplok, Ringlock, Kwikstage).

name: Mobile Scaffold Tower
description: A freestanding, castor-mounted scaffold tower that can be moved as a single unit for low-height works.

name: Suspended Access Scaffold (Cradle/Gondola)
description: A platform suspended by cables from roof-mounted outriggers, used for facade maintenance and glazing installation.

name: Shoring/Falsework Scaffold
description: Temporary scaffold supports used to hold formwork, wet concrete, or existing structures during construction or propping.

name: Scaffold Erection/Installation
description: The on-site assembly and erection of scaffold components to form a safe working platform.

name: Scaffold Inspection/Certification
description: The formal safety inspection and tagging of erected scaffold prior to use and after any alteration or adverse weather.

name: Scaffold Dismantling/Striking
description: The controlled top-down disassembly and removal of scaffold components from the building.

name: Scaffold Loading/Platform Capacity Check
description: Verification that scaffold platform load ratings are appropriate for the intended materials, equipment, and personnel.

name: Edge Protection Installation
description: Installation of temporary guardrails and toe boards at slab edges and openings to provide fall protection during construction.

name: Scaffold Tie Installation
description: The on-site fixing of scaffold ties into the building structure (drilling, inserting anchors) to secure the scaffold frame.

name: Safety Net Installation
description: Installation of safety nets below or beside the work area to arrest falls during steel erection or concrete work.

name: Scaffolding Tubes & Standards
description: Vertical and horizontal metal tubes that form the primary load-bearing structural frame of the scaffold.

name: Scaffold Boards / Planks
description: Timber or metal planks laid across ledgers to create working platforms for personnel and materials.

name: Scaffold Couplers & Clamps
description: Fittings used to connect tubes at various angles, including swivel, putlog, and right-angle couplers.

name: Scaffold Base Plates & Jacks
description: Load-distributing plates and adjustable screw jacks that support standards on the ground or slab.

name: Scaffold Ledgers & Transoms
description: Horizontal longitudinal (ledger) and transverse (transom) members that stiffen the frame and support boards.

name: Scaffold Guardrails & Toe Boards
description: Safety barriers fixed at platform edges to prevent falls and falling objects during dismantling.

name: Scaffold Bracing (Diagonal & Cross)
description: Diagonal or cross braces installed to provide lateral stability to the scaffold structure.

name: Scaffold Ladders / Stairs
description: Integrated access ladders or stair towers used for safe climbing during dismantling operations.

name: Scaffold Debris Netting / Fans
description: Protective nets or catchment fans fitted around the scaffold to contain falling debris during dismantling.

name: Scaffold Hoist / Gin Wheel
description: Manual or powered lifting device mounted on the scaffold to lower dismantled components to the ground.

name: Controlled Descent / Chute System
description: Debris chutes or controlled lowering systems used to safely transport dismantled material down from height.

name: Lay-Down & Sorting Area
description: Designated ground-level zone where dismantled scaffold components are received, sorted, and staged for removal.

name: Scaffold Tag & Inspection System
description: Color-coded tagging and inspection regime that tracks scaffold status from erection through safe dismantling.

name: Reverse Sequence Dismantling Procedure
description: Structured removal of components in strict reverse order of erection to maintain structural integrity.

name: Scaffold Component Inventory & Segregation
description: On-site sorting, counting, and segregating of dismantled components by type and condition for reuse or return.

name: Living Wall System
description: A vertical building-integrated panel system supporting climbing plants or modular planted panels attached to the building facade or interior wall.

name: Bioretention Planter
description: A building-integrated planter box with engineered soil and drainage designed to capture and filter stormwater runoff from roof or hardscape surfaces.

name: Irrigation System
description: Built-in drip or sprinkler supply lines, controllers, and emitters integrated into the building's landscape or green roof zones.

name: Drainage Layer Assembly
description: A geocomposite or granular drainage mat installed beneath growing media to convey excess water to building drains.

name: Growing Medium (Engineered Soil)
description: Lightweight, mineral-based soil mix formulated specifically for building-integrated landscapes to support plant growth while limiting structural load.

name: Root Barrier Membrane
description: A chemical or sheet membrane installed above the waterproofing layer to prevent root penetration into the building envelope.

name: Green Roof Vegetation Mat
description: Pre-grown sedum or wildflower mat (e.g., sedum carpet) laid directly onto the growing medium for instant green roof coverage.

name: Installing Waterproofing Membrane
description: On-site application or placement of liquid-applied or sheet waterproofing over the structural deck prior to landscape assembly.

name: Installing Drainage Layer
description: On-site placement and connection of drainage boards, mats, or aggregate to ensure proper water conveyance within the assembly.

name: Placing Growing Medium
description: On-site delivery and spreading of engineered soil mix over the drainage layer to the specified depth.

name: Installing Irrigation Lines
description: On-site routing, connection, and pressure-testing of drip or sprinkler supply lines embedded in the landscape assembly.

name: Planting Vegetation
description: On-site installation of pre-grown mats, plugs, seeds, or container plants into the growing medium to establish the landscape cover.

name: Green Roof Protection Layer
description: A geotextile fabric placed between waterproofing and drainage layers to prevent abrasion and physical damage.

name: Planter Retaining Edge
description: A perimeter curb, angle, or frame that contains the growing medium and separates landscape areas from other roof or plaza finishes.

name: Zone
description: A defined portion of a building floor plate designated for a specific use, bounded by walls, partitions, or virtual boundaries.

name: Enclave
description: A physically or visually separated sub-area within a larger region, such as a quiet corner of a lobby or a designated waiting alcove.

name: Sector
description: A major functional subdivision of the building, such as a clinical wing in a hospital or an academic wing in a school.

name: Bay
description: A repetitive structural or spatial unit within a larger region, defined by column spacing or module lines.

name: Courtyard
description: An outdoor or semi-enclosed area bounded by building wings or walls that functions as an extension of adjacent interior regions.

name: Separation Wall Assembly
description: Vertical construction that defines the physical boundary between independent regions, providing fire, acoustic, or visual separation.

name: Demarcation Floor Finish
description: A change in flooring material, pattern, or level that visually or tactilely marks the transition between independent regions.

name: Threshold
description: A transitional element at a doorway or opening where two independent regions meet, often including a raised strip or transition strip.

name: Independent Region Demising Construction
description: On-site installation of partition walls, glazed screens, sliding partitions, or other boundary-defining assemblies that create independent regions within the building.

name: Regional Floor Finish Installation
description: On-site laying of distinct flooring materials or patterns that visually demarcate the boundaries of each independent region.

name: Town Center
description: The central public or commercial hub of a town, often containing gathering spaces, retail, and civic functions.

name: Residential District
description: A designated area within a town primarily composed of housing units and residential buildings.

name: Commercial Zone
description: A district of a town dedicated to shops, offices, and business activities.

name: Industrial Quarter
description: A section of a town set aside for manufacturing, warehouses, and industrial operations.

name: Civic Plaza
description: An open public square in a town used for gatherings, markets, and community events.

name: Town Square
description: A formal open space at the heart of a town, typically surrounded by important civic buildings.

name: Marketplace
description: A covered or open area within a town designated for stalls, vendors, and trading activities.

name: Park & Recreation Area
description: A landscaped open space within a town providing leisure, sports, and natural respite.

name: Utility Corridor
description: An underground or above-ground linear zone within a town housing infrastructure such as pipes, cables, and ducts.

name: Parking Structure
description: A multi-level building or facility within a town dedicated to vehicle parking.

name: Town Hall
description: A civic building within a town housing administrative offices and public meeting chambers.

name: Perimeter Wall
description: A boundary enclosure defining the edge of a town or its districts for security or demarcation.

name: Entry Gate
description: A controlled access point at the boundary of a town or district, often with security infrastructure.

name: Street Lighting System
description: The network of poles, luminaires, and wiring that illuminates streets and public spaces within a town.

name: Town Drainage Network
description: The buried pipe and channel system that collects and conveys stormwater and wastewater from a town.

name: Town Water Supply System
description: The network of mains, pumps, and storage tanks delivering potable water to buildings in a town.

name: District Energy Plant
description: A centralized heating, cooling, or power generation facility serving multiple buildings within a town.

name: Road Pavement
description: The constructed surface layer of asphalt, concrete, or paving stones forming the roadways of a town.

name: Curb & Gutter Assembly
description: The concrete edge and drainage channel lining the sides of streets within a town.

name: Site Grading & Earthwork
description: The on-site excavation, filling, and leveling of terrain to prepare the land for town development.

name: Roadway Construction
description: The on-site laying of pavement, curbs, and signage to build the vehicular circulation network of a town.

name: Utility Trenching & Installation
description: The on-site excavation and placement of water, sewer, gas, electrical, and communication lines within a town.

name: Street Lighting Installation
description: The on-site mounting, wiring, and commissioning of light poles and fixtures along town streets.

name: Landscaping & Hardscaping
description: The on-site planting of vegetation and installation of paving, walls, and site furniture in town public spaces.

name: Town Plaza Construction
description: The on-site building of paved surfaces, steps, planters, and seating to form a civic town square.

name: Boundary Wall Erection
description: The on-site masonry or concrete construction of perimeter walls and gates defining the town's edge.

name: City Country Finger
description: A single elongated wing or finger-like volume extending outward from a central core in a building layout, commonly found in hospitals, hotels, and large institutional buildings.

name: Finger Corridor
description: The central linear circulation spine within a city-country-finger wing that connects rooms along both sides.

name: Patient Room (Finger Wing)
description: A patient accommodation room arranged along one or both sides of a finger corridor in a healthcare building.

name: Nursing Station (Finger Wing)
description: A staff workspace or satellite nurse base located within or at the junction of a finger wing to serve adjacent patient rooms.

name: Central Core / Hub
description: The central vertical circulation and services core from which city-country-finger wings radiate.

name: Finger Wing Structural Frame
description: The structural system (columns, beams, slabs) supporting the elongated wing volume.

name: Finger Wing Exterior Wall
description: The external wall assembly enclosing the elongated wing, typically with repetitive window modules.

name: Finger Wing Roof Assembly
description: The roof covering and waterproofing system over the single wing volume.

name: Finger Wing MEP Distribution
description: The horizontal mechanical, electrical, and plumbing distribution runs that branch from the central core into each finger wing.

name: Finger Wing Fire Compartment
description: A fire-rated subdivision of the finger wing corridor or rooms to limit smoke and fire spread.

name: Finger Wing Foundation
description: The strip or spread footings supporting the linear structural bay of a finger wing.

name: Nurse Call System (Finger Wing)
description: The patient-to-staff communication system installed in each room and corridor of the finger wing.

name: Headwall (Patient Room)
description: The prefabricated wall panel behind a patient bed containing medical gas outlets, power, and data connections.

name: Finger Wing Glazing System
description: The repetitive window or curtain wall units along the long facades of the finger wing.

name: Construct Finger Wing Structure
description: Erection of columns, beams, and floor slabs for each linear wing bay.

name: Install Finger Wing MEP Rough-In
description: Installation of horizontal ductwork, piping, and conduit within the finger wing ceiling and shaft spaces.

name: Install Finger Wing Exterior Cladding
description: Installation of the external wall and window system along the extended wing facade.

name: Install Headwall Panels
description: Mounting of prefabricated patient headwall units with integrated services in finger wing patient rooms.

name: Commission Nurse Call System
description: Testing and verification of the patient-to-staff communication system throughout the finger wing.

name: Greenhouse Enclosure
description: The transparent or translucent building envelope (glass, polycarbonate, ETFE) forming the climate-controlled growing environment.

name: Hydroponic Growing System
description: Integrated soilless cultivation infrastructure including nutrient delivery piping, pumps, and reservoir tanks fixed within the building.

name: Irrigation Distribution Network
description: Fixed pipework, valves, drip lines, and misting headers supplying water to planting areas throughout the valley.

name: Growing Media Bed
description: Built-in containment structure (raised trough, planter box, or flood table) holding substrate for plant root systems.

name: Supplemental Lighting Array
description: Fixed overhead LED or HPS luminaires and mounting rails providing photosynthetically active radiation to crops.

name: Climate Control System
description: HVAC equipment, fans, louvers, and sensors regulating temperature, humidity, and CO₂ within the valley environment.

name: Shading Screen System
description: Motorized retractable fabric or louver assemblies mounted to the structure for controlling solar gain and light levels.

name: Vertical Growing Rack
description: Multi-tier fixed metal or plastic shelving unit installed to stack growing trays vertically and maximize floor area yield.

name: Nutrient Delivery Manifold
description: Pre-assembled piping header with dosing ports that distributes fertilized water from the central reservoir to growing zones.

name: Crop Support Trellis System
description: Fixed overhead wire, netting, or vertical string framework attached to structure for vining crop support.

name: Gravel or Sloped Floor Drainage
description: Sloped concrete floor with integrated trench drains and a washed gravel drainage layer to manage irrigation runoff.

name: Water Recycling & Filtration Plant
description: Fixed mechanical equipment for recirculating, filtering, and UV-treating irrigation runoff within the building.

name: Environmental Sensor Network
description: Fixed array of wall- or rack-mounted sensors (temperature, humidity, pH, EC, light) feeding data to building automation.

name: Pollination Air Circulation Unit
description: Dedicated overhead fans and ducting positioned to create airflow patterns that assist natural pollination of flowering crops.

name: Harvest Preparation Zone
description: An alcove or room within the valley with built-in stainless steel counters and wash-down sinks for initial crop processing.

name: Entry Air Lock / Vestibule
description: Sealed double-door transition space designed to prevent contaminant and pest ingress into the controlled growing environment.

name: Insulated Thermal Curtain Wall
description: A movable or fixed insulated partition that separates sub-zones within the valley for differential temperature control.

name: CO₂ Enrichment Delivery System
description: Fixed piping and diffusers connected to CO₂ tanks or generators that boost atmospheric carbon for plant growth.

name: Install Irrigation & Drainage Piping
description: On-site installation of all water supply, nutrient delivery, and floor drainage pipework within the valley structure.

name: Install Growing Racks & Trellis Supports
description: On-site assembly and anchoring of multi-tier shelving and overhead crop support framing to the building structure.

name: Commission Environmental Control System
description: On-site calibration and testing of the HVAC, lighting, shading, and sensor systems to achieve target growing conditions.

name: Install Hydroponic Plumbing & Manifolds
description: On-site connection of pumps, manifolds, valves, and tubing from the nutrient tank to all growing zones.

name: Street Grid Layout
description: The orthogonal or organic network of intersecting pedestrian routes that defines circulation within the building.

name: Pedestrian Pathways
description: The finished walking surfaces, paving, and floor finishes that form the street surfaces within the building.

name: Street Curbs/Edges
description: Raised or demarcated boundaries that separate pedestrian pathways from adjoining zones or planting.

name: Street Lighting
description: Fixed overhead or wall-mounted luminaires that illuminate the interior street-like circulation routes.

name: Street Signage & Wayfinding
description: Fixed signs, direction markers, and information boards mounted along street routes for navigation.

name: Street Furniture (Built-in)
description: Fixed benches, seating clusters, and built-in rest points integrated along the pedestrian streets.

name: Bridge/Crosswalk Connections
description: Elevated walkways or grade-level crosswalks that link street routes across atria or voids.

name: Street Canopy/Covering
description: Fixed overhead glazing, louvers, or roof elements that shelter portions of the interior street.

name: Street Planting Beds
description: Fixed planter boxes, raised beds, or integrated green strips along the street edges.

name: Street Drainage System
description: Floor drains, sloped channels, and concealed drainage that manage water on interior street surfaces.

name: Street Column Cladding
description: Architectural finishes or cladding applied to structural columns that line the street routes.

name: Street Wall Finishes
description: The applied wall surfaces, paneling, or cladding defining the vertical edges of the street space.

name: Street Ceiling/Soflit Treatment
description: The finished overhead surface and any suspended elements above the street route.

name: Street Furniture Installation
description: On-site assembly and fixing of built-in benches, seating, and rest elements along the street.

name: Street Surface Paving Installation
description: On-site laying, tiling, or pouring of floor finishes that form the street walking surface.

name: Street Signage Installation
description: On-site mounting and securing of wayfinding signs and information boards along the street.

name: Street Planting Installation
description: On-site placement of planters, soil, and plants into fixed street planting beds.

name: Main street
description: The primary commercial corridor of a country town, lined with shops, services, and footpaths.

name: Country road
description: A rural vehicular and pedestrian route connecting the town to outlying farms and villages, typically unpaved or simply surfaced.

name: Village green
description: A grassy communal open area in the heart of a country town, used for recreation and events.

name: General store
description: A single-room retail and trading post space serving the daily needs of a country town.

name: Post office
description: A small civic space for mail services, often combined with the general store.

name: Schoolhouse
description: A one- or two-room educational building serving the town's children.

name: Church
description: A place of worship typically forming the visual and social anchor of a country town.

name: Cemetery
description: A burial ground adjacent to the church, enclosed by walls or fences.

name: Public well
description: A community water supply structure consisting of a lined shaft, pump, and hand-operated mechanism.

name: Water tower
description: An elevated tank on timber or steel legs providing gravity-fed water distribution to the town.

name: Septic tank
description: An underground concrete or fibreglass tank for on-site wastewater treatment and disposal.

name: Rainwater harvesting system
description: A system of gutters, downpipes, and tanks collecting roof runoff for household use.

name: Timber verandah
description: A covered outdoor walkway attached to the front of commercial buildings, supported by timber posts.

name: Wide eave overhang
description: A roof projection extending well beyond the external wall to shade windows and walls from sun and rain.

name: Corrugated metal roof
description: A lightweight, sloped roofing system of profiled steel or iron sheets, common in rural construction.

name: Weatherboard cladding
description: Horizontal timber boards overlapped to form the external wall finish of country town buildings.

name: Picket fence
description: A low timber boundary fence of vertical pointed boards and horizontal rails.

name: Stone foundation wall
description: A load-bearing base wall of locally quarried stone supporting the timber superstructure.

name: Wooden barn
description: A large agricultural shed for storing hay, grain, and farm equipment, typically with a gable roof.

name: Silo
description: A tall cylindrical structure for bulk storage of grain or silage, made of steel or concrete.

name: Stockyard
description: An open fenced enclosure with timber rails and loading ramp for managing livestock.

name: Farmers' market stall
description: A demountable timber counter and awning structure for selling produce, installed in the town square.

name: Telephone booth
description: A small enclosed kiosk housing a public payphone, now often repurposed as a community info point.

name: Country town house
description: A detached single-family dwelling on a generous lot, typically with a verandah and corrugated roof.

name: Boardwalk
description: A raised timber walkway over uneven or wet ground, connecting buildings across the town.

name: Street lamp
description: A cast-iron or timber pole supporting a lantern for night-time illumination of streets and squares.

name: Cemetery wall
description: A low stone or brick enclosure wall defining the boundary of the burial ground.

name: Railway station
description: A small passenger shelter and platform building along a rural rail line serving the town.

name: Freight loading dock
description: A raised concrete or timber platform for transferring goods between rail cars and road vehicles.

name: Rural Landscape Setting
description: The exterior land context surrounding the countryside building, including fields, hedgerows, and natural topography.

name: Barn
description: A large agricultural outbuilding typically used for storage of hay, grain, or livestock housing.

name: Countryside Foundation
description: The below-grade structural support system adapted to rural soil conditions, including strip footings, stone rubble foundations, or concrete piers.

name: Rural Structural Frame
description: The primary load-bearing system of a countryside building, often timber-framed with oak or heavy timber posts, beams, and trusses.

name: Thatched Roof
description: A roof covering made from dry vegetation such as water reed or wheat straw, layered to shed water and insulate.

name: Clay or Slate Roof Tiles
description: Individual fired clay or natural slate units laid in overlapping courses to form a durable, traditional roof finish.

name: Stone or Brick Masonry Wall
description: Load-bearing or veneer walls constructed from locally quarried stone or fired clay bricks laid in mortar.

name: Timber Cladding
description: Horizontal or vertical wooden boards fixed to the exterior wall to provide weather protection and a rural aesthetic.

name: Lime Plaster / Render
description: A breathable, lime-based coating applied to internal or external masonry walls, traditional in historic rural buildings.

name: Farmhouse Windows and Doors
description: Wooden or metal framed openings with multi-pane glazing and traditional ironmongery suited to a rural building.

name: Rural Drainage System

name: Rural Water Supply System

name: Wood-Burning Stove / Fireplace

name: Rural Electrical Generation

name: Countryside Insulation

name: Rural Floor Construction

name: Porch / Mudroom

name: Pantry / Larder

name: Stable / Livestock Stall

name: Farm Track / Hardstanding

name: Rural Fencing and Hedging

name: Root Cellar

name: Workshop / Tractor Shed

description: Fitting of sound-absorbing panels to control noise transmission between learning zones.

name: Commission Smart Lighting Zones
description: Programming and calibration of zone-based lighting controls to match learning activity profiles.

name: Install Flexible Partition Track System
description: Mounting of overhead tracks and floor guides for movable partition walls in the learning network.

name: Shopping Mall
description: A large enclosed shopping complex containing multiple retail stores, restaurants, and entertainment venues.

name: Retail Store
description: Individual tenant space designed for the display and sale of goods to customers.

name: Department Store
description: A large retail space subdivided into departments offering a wide variety of merchandise categories.

name: Boutique
description: A small, specialized retail space focusing on a curated selection of goods, often with a distinct brand identity.

name: Shopping Arcade
description: A covered pedestrian passageway lined with small retail shops and stalls.

name: Food Court
description: A communal dining area within a shopping center surrounded by multiple fast-food or quick-service vendor stalls.

name: Pop-Up Shop
description: A temporary retail space designed for short-term use, often with modular or demountable fit-out.

name: Convenience Store
description: A small retail space stocking everyday essentials and packaged goods for quick in-and-out shopping.

name: Supermarket
description: A large self-service retail space organized into aisles for groceries, fresh produce, and household items.

name: Cash Wrap / Checkout Zone
description: Designated area within a retail space housing point-of-sale counters and queue management systems.

name: Display Shelving System
description: Fixed or modular shelving units integrated into the retail fit-out for product display and storage.

name: Fitting Room
description: Enclosed area within a clothing retail store where customers can try on garments before purchase.

name: Shopping Center Signage
description: Building-integrated directory boards, wayfinding signs, and tenant identification panels.

name: Escalator / Travelator
description: Mechanized moving stair or flat walkway installed to transport shoppers between levels.

name: Atrium / Central Hall
description: A multi-story open volume within a shopping center that provides circulation, daylight, and a visual anchor.

name: Retail Fit-Out Partitioning
description: On-site installation of non-load-bearing partition walls and demountable shopfront systems within a retail shell.

name: Checkout Counter Installation
description: On-site assembly and fixing of built-in point-of-sale counters and service desks.

name: Display Fixture Installation
description: On-site mounting of shelving, hanging rails, and display cases to the building structure or partition walls.

name: Shopping Center Security System
description: Building-integrated CCTV, access control, and alarm infrastructure serving the entire shopping complex.

name: Loading Dock / Service Yard
description: Dedicated service area for delivery vehicles to unload merchandise into the shopping center.

name: Bus parking bay
description: A designated parking area within the mini-bus depot or garage for individual mini-buses.

name: Mini-bus garage
description: An enclosed housing structure specifically sized for mini-bus parking, maintenance, and shelter.

name: Mini-bus maintenance pit
description: A recessed service pit within the mini-bus bay floor allowing underside vehicle access for inspections and repairs.

name: Bus charging station (mini-bus)
description: A building-integrated electric vehicle charging system dedicated to replenishing mini-bus batteries.

name: Mini-bus wash bay
description: A wash-down area with drainage and pressure washing equipment for cleaning mini-buses.

name: Bus bay floor drainage
description: A network of floor drains, trenches, and piping to collect and remove water, oil, and wash-down effluent from the bay.

name: Mini-bus bay exhaust extraction system
description: A fixed ventilation system capturing and removing vehicle exhaust fumes directly from the bay area.

name: Mini-bus bay lighting
description: High-bay or explosion-proof light fixtures providing illumination for parking and maintenance activities.

name: Mini-bus bay fire suppression system
description: A fire sprinkler or foam-based suppression system designed for vehicle parking and maintenance areas.

name: Bus bay rolling door
description: A sectional overhead or rolling steel door providing weatherproof access for mini-buses entering and exiting the garage.

name: Bus bay bumper rail
description: A wall- or column-mounted steel or rubber rail protecting building surfaces from mini-bus impact during maneuvering.

name: Mini-bus signage and marking
description: Fixed painted or applied markings and signs designating parking positions, directional flow, and clearance limits.

name: Construction of mini-bus bay floor slab
description: On-site pouring, finishing, and curing of reinforced concrete floor slab with appropriate slope and load capacity for mini-buses.

name: Installation of bus bay exhaust extraction
description: On-site mounting and ductwork connection of vehicle exhaust capture hoses, fans, and discharge stacks.

name: Installation of bus charging station
description: On-site mounting, wiring, and commissioning of the electric vehicle supply equipment for mini-buses.

name: Floor count (storeys)
description: The discrete building floors or levels that are limited to four in this concept, each being a horizontal plane dividing the building vertically.

name: High-rise exemption threshold
description: The regulatory boundary at four storeys below which different fire, structural, and egress requirements apply compared to high-rise buildings.

name: Stairwell egress configuration
description: The stair and exit arrangement designed for buildings of four storeys or fewer, typically allowing a single exit stair under certain codes.

name: Sprinkler system requirement zone
description: The fire suppression system scope that changes at the four-storey threshold, often triggering mandatory sprinkler installation above this limit.

name: Building height measurement
description: The vertical dimension from grade to roof that correlates with four storeys, used to determine code compliance and zoning envelope.

name: Vertical circulation core
description: The elevator, stair, and shaft arrangement sized and configured for a building of up to four floors.

name: Structural load path for mid-rise
description: The gravity and lateral load-resisting system designed for the reduced wind and seismic demands typical of four-storey buildings.

name: Floor-to-floor height
description: The vertical distance between finished floor levels across the four storeys, influencing overall building height compliance.

name: Mezzanine exclusion zone
description: The open intermediate floor areas within a storey that may or may not count toward the four-storey limit depending on code definitions.

name: Construction sequencing for multi-storey
description: The on-site erection sequence of structural floors, columns, and walls to achieve the four-storey building height.

name: Parking Space Markings
description: Painted or applied markings on the parking surface that designate individual nine-per-cent (compact) parking stall boundaries.

name: Compact Parking Stall
description: A reduced-dimension parking space designed to accommodate smaller vehicles, typically 2.3 m wide or less.

name: Parking Barrier / Wheel Stop
description: A fixed concrete, rubber, or metal stop installed at the front of each compact stall to prevent vehicles from overrunning the walkway.

name: Compact Parking Signage
description: Signage indicating the stall is designated for compact/small vehicles, often labeled 'Nine Per Cent Parking' or similar.

name: Parking Aisle
description: The driving aisle adjacent to compact parking rows, sized to allow maneuverability for smaller vehicles.

name: Parking Surface Pavement
description: The asphalt, concrete, or permeable paving layer forming the driving and parking surface of the nine-per-cent parking area.

name: Parking Area Drainage System
description: Subsurface drains, catch basins, and sloped paving that collect and convey stormwater away from compact parking stalls.

name: Parking Stall Layout and Stenciling
description: On-site layout surveying and stencil painting of compact stall boundaries and identification codes.

name: Wheel Stop Installation
description: Anchoring or bolting of wheel stops at the head of each compact parking stall.

name: Compact Parking Sign Installation
description: Mounting of compact-vehicle-only signage on posts or walls adjacent to the parking area.

name: Electric Vehicle Charging Station (Compact Bay)
description: A wall- or pedestal-mounted EV charging unit installed in or adjacent to a nine-per-cent stall for compact electric vehicles.

name: Roadway Pavement Layers
description: The structural material layers (base course, binder course, wearing course) forming the drivable surface of a parallel road.

name: Roadway Base Subgrade
description: The prepared earth or engineered fill beneath the pavement layers providing load-bearing support for the roadway.

name: Roadway Curbs
description: Linear concrete or stone edges along the sides of the roadway that contain pavement and direct drainage.

name: Roadway Gutters
description: Drainage channels running alongside or within the roadway to collect and convey surface water runoff.

name: Roadway Drainage Inlets
description: Grilled openings at low points that capture stormwater from the road surface into the underground drainage system.

name: Roadway Stormwater Pipes
description: Underground pipe network that conveys captured runoff from inlets to discharge points or retention systems.

name: Roadway Catch Basins
description: Underground sump structures with sediment traps that receive water from inlets before discharging into storm pipes.

name: Roadway Manholes
description: Access chambers set into the roadway allowing entry to underground utility or drainage systems for inspection and maintenance.

name: Roadway Utility Trenches
description: Excavated corridors within the road right-of-way that house buried electrical, communications, water, or gas utility lines.

name: Roadway Subsurface Utility Vaults
description: Precast or cast-in-place underground enclosures providing access space for valves, splices, or meters within the road zone.

name: Roadway Traffic Signs
description: Fixed signage mounted on posts or gantries conveying regulatory, warning, or guidance information to road users.

name: Roadway Pavement Markings
description: Painted or thermoplastic stripes, symbols, and legends applied to the pavement surface for lane delineation and traffic control.

name: Roadway Guardrails
description: Longitudinal safety barriers installed along road edges to contain and redirect errant vehicles.

name: Roadway Median Strip
description: The central separator space between opposing travel directions, which may be vegetated, paved, or fitted with barrier systems.

name: Roadway Shoulder
description: The paved or gravel strip adjacent to the outer travel lane that provides emergency stopping area and lateral support.

name: Roadway Lighting Poles
description: Vertical structural supports with luminaires that illuminate the roadway for nighttime visibility and safety.

name: Roadway Bicycle Lanes
description: Designated striped or separated portions of the roadway reserved for bicycle travel, marked and signed accordingly.

name: Roadway Sidewalks
description: Pedestrian travel surfaces adjacent to or parallel with the roadway, separated by curbs or buffer strips.

name: Roadway Accessibility Ramps
description: Sloped curb cuts at intersections and crosswalks providing wheelchair and pedestrian access between sidewalk and roadway level.

name: Roadway Expansion Joints
description: Preformed gaps and filler seals placed at intervals in rigid pavement to accommodate thermal movement and prevent cracking.

name: Roadway Subsurface Drainage Geotextile
description: Filter fabric placed between subgrade and aggregate layers to prevent soil migration while allowing water passage.

name: Roadway Pavement Interlocking Units
description: Precast concrete or stone pavers arranged in a pattern over a bedding layer, used for decorative or permeable paving surfaces.

name: Roadway Pavement Installation Activity
description: The on-site construction process of grading, compacting subgrade, placing base materials, and laying pavement courses for a parallel road.

name: Roadway Curb and Gutter Installation Activity
description: The on-site forming, pouring, and finishing of concrete curbs and gutters along the road edges.

name: Roadway Signage and Marking Installation Activity
description: The on-site erection of sign posts and the application of pavement markings to complete the traffic control system for the road.

name: Roadway Drainage System Installation Activity
description: The on-site excavation, pipe laying, inlet placement, and backfilling of the stormwater collection and conveyance network beneath the road.

name: Altar
description: A raised structure or table used for religious offerings, rituals, or central worship within a sacred site.

name: Chancel
description: The area around the altar in a church or temple, often raised and reserved for clergy and choir.

name: Nave
description: The central, main body of a church or temple where congregants gather, flanked by aisles.

name: Sanctuary
description: The most sacred inner space of a religious building, typically housing the altar or main idol.

name: Bell Tower / Campanile
description: A freestanding or attached tower housing bells, used to signal worship times and ceremonial events.

name: Steeple / Spire
description: A tall, pointed structural element atop a sacred building, serving as a visual landmark and often housing a cross or finial.

name: Stained Glass Window
description: A decorative window made of colored glass pieces set in lead, depicting religious imagery or symbolic patterns.

name: Pulpit
description: An elevated platform or lectern from which sermons or religious teachings are delivered to the congregation.

name: Baptistry
description: A dedicated space or structure containing a font for baptism ceremonies, often separate from the main worship area.

name: Sacristy
description: A room adjoining the sanctuary for storage of vestments, vessels, and preparation by clergy before services.

name: Choir Stall
description: Fixed seating for choir members, typically arranged in rows within the chancel area and often ornately carved.

name: Iconostasis
description: A screen or wall of icons and religious imagery that separates the sanctuary from the nave in Eastern Christian traditions.

name: Prayer Niche / Mihrab
description: A niche or alcove in a mosque wall indicating the direction of Mecca for prayer orientation.

name: Minaret
description: A tall slender tower attached to a mosque from which the call to prayer is announced.

name: Pew
description: A long, fixed bench with a backrest arranged in rows for seating the congregation in a church.

name: Confessional
description: An enclosed booth or room where clergy hear confessions from penitents through a screen.

name: Votive Candle Rack
description: A fixed rack or stand for holding rows of votive candles lit by worshippers as offerings or prayers.

name: Shrine / Reliquary Enclosure
description: A built-in niche, case, or small structure housing sacred relics or a devotional statue within the sacred site.

name: Processional Aisle
description: A defined pathway within the sacred site designed for ceremonial processions and movement during rituals.

name: Ambo
description: A raised reading desk or lectern from which scripture readings and liturgical announcements are delivered.

name: Sacred Site Construction
description: On-site erection of the building shell, foundations, and structural framing specifically for a religious building.

name: Stained Glass Installation
description: On-site fitting, setting, and glazing of stained glass panels into window openings of the sacred building.

name: Steeple Erection
description: On-site assembly, hoisting, and securing of the steeple or spire structure onto the roof of the sacred building.

name: Bell Tower Framing & Installation
description: On-site construction of the bell tower frame and installation of the bell suspension system and bells.

name: Altar Construction & Placement
description: On-site building or positioning of the altar structure, including its masonry, joinery, or stonework.

name: Pew / Choir Stall Installation
description: On-site anchoring, assembly, and fixing of rows of pews or choir stalls to the floor of the sanctuary.

name: Iconostasis Installation
description: On-site assembly and fixing of the iconostasis screen, including its structural framing and icon panels.

name: Chancel & Sanctuary Flooring
description: On-site laying of raised floor or special paving materials in the chancel and sanctuary areas.

name: Minaret Construction
description: On-site vertical construction of the minaret tower, including its masonry, stair core, and balcony.

name: Water Supply Piping
description: Network of pipes that distribute potable water from the building main to points of use.

name: Hot Water Generation
description: Water heating equipment including boilers, heat exchangers, and solar thermal collectors that produce hot water for the building.

name: Water Metering & Shutoff Valves
description: Devices that measure water consumption and control the flow of water for maintenance and emergency shutoff.

name: Water Pressure Regulation
description: Pumps, pressure tanks, and pressure-reducing valves that maintain proper water pressure throughout the distribution system.

name: Greywater Collection & Reuse System
description: Separate piping and treatment system that captures used water from sinks and showers for non-potable reuse.

name: Drinking Water Fountains
description: Wall-mounted or free-standing fixtures that provide filtered drinking water to building occupants.

name: Fixture Installation & Commissioning
description: On-site mounting and connection of water fixtures followed by pressure testing and flow verification.

name: Water Heater Installation & Startup
description: On-site placement, connection, and initial operation of water heating equipment including safety checks.

name: Water Service Connection to Mains
description: On-site excavation and connection of building water supply pipe to municipal or private water main.

name: Emergency Eyewash & Safety Shower Stations
description: Plumbed safety fixtures installed in laboratories and industrial areas providing immediate water flow for decontamination.

name: Lifecycle Assessment (LCA) Data
description: Environmental impact metrics and embodied carbon data tracked for building materials and products across their full life cycle.

name: Service Life / Design Life
description: Expected duration of functional performance for building elements before replacement or major maintenance is needed.

name: End-of-Life Strategy
description: On-site deconstruction, selective demolition, and material separation activities planned for building removal at end of useful life.

name: Replacement Cycle Schedule
description: Planned intervals and sequences for replacing building systems and components such as HVAC filters, roofing membranes, and finishes.

name: Maintenance & Inspection Regime
description: On-site periodic inspection, cleaning, and servicing activities required to preserve building component performance over time.

name: Life Cycle Cost (LCC) Model
description: Financial analysis framework tracking capital, operational, maintenance, and replacement costs across the building's lifespan.

name: Embodied Energy Inventory
description: Cumulative energy consumed during extraction, transport, manufacturing, and on-site installation of building materials.

name: Operational Energy Baseline
description: Reference energy consumption profile for the completed building's heating, cooling, lighting, and equipment operation.

name: Carbon Sequestration & Storage
description: Biogenic carbon stored within timber, bamboo, and other bio-based building materials over the life of the structure.

name: Warranty & Performance Bond Term
description: Legally enforceable coverage periods for building products and systems installed on-site during construction.

name: Renovation & Retrofit Cycle
description: On-site modification, upgrading, or adaptive reuse construction activities applied to existing building fabric and systems.

name: Durability & Degradation Mechanism
description: Physical or chemical deterioration processes affecting building materials on-site such as corrosion, UV degradation, and freeze-thaw.

name: Component Replacement Log
description: Historical record of on-site removal and reinstallation of building elements including serial numbers and installation dates.

name: Lifecycle Phase Gate
description: On-site milestone reviews and handover activities marking transitions between design, construction, operation, and end-of-life phases.

name: Men's Restroom
description: A dedicated toilet and washroom space designed for male building occupants with urinals, water closets, and lavatories.

name: Women's Restroom
description: A dedicated toilet and washroom space designed for female building occupants with water closets and lavatories.

name: Gender-Neutral Restroom
description: A single-occupancy or multi-stall restroom facility accessible to all genders, often with full privacy partitions.

name: Men's Locker Room
description: A changing and storage room with lockers, benches, and showers designated for male use in sports or workplace facilities.

name: Women's Locker Room
description: A changing and storage room with lockers, benches, and showers designated for female use in sports or workplace facilities.

name: Men's Changing Room
description: A fitting or changing area in retail or pool facilities designated for male occupants to try on clothing or change attire.

name: Women's Changing Room
description: A fitting or changing area in retail or pool facilities designated for female occupants to try on clothing or change attire.

name: Men's Prayer/Meditation Room
description: A quiet space designated for male occupants to perform religious observances or meditation.

name: Women's Prayer/Meditation Room
description: A quiet space designated for female occupants to perform religious observances or meditation.

name: Men's Shower Room
description: A wet area with multiple shower stalls designated for male use in gyms, pools, and dormitory facilities.

name: Women's Shower Room
description: A wet area with multiple shower stalls designated for female use in gyms, pools, and dormitory facilities.

name: Men's Nursing/Family Room
description: A room designated for men to attend to children including diaper changing and feeding in family-friendly facilities.

name: Women's Nursing/Mother's Room
description: A private room with seating and electrical provisions for breastfeeding and expressing breast milk.

name: Gender-Separated Dormitory
description: A sleeping quarters space segregated by gender in institutional, hostel, or barracks settings with bunks and storage.

name: Gender-Separated Sauna/Steam Room
description: A heated wellness room designated for single-gender use in fitness and spa facilities.

name: Gender-Separated Toilet Partition System
description: The fixed floor-mounted or ceiling-hung partition panels, doors, and hardware forming individual toilet stalls within gender-designated restrooms.

name: Urinal Screen/Divider
description: A fixed vertical privacy panel installed between urinals in men's restrooms, typically of stainless steel or compact laminate.

name: Men's Restroom Signage
description: Fixed pictogram sign mounted on or near the restroom door indicating male-designated facility, meeting accessibility code requirements.

name: Women's Restroom Signage
description: Fixed pictogram sign mounted on or near the restroom door indicating female-designated facility, meeting accessibility code requirements.

name: Gender-Neutral Restroom Signage
description: Fixed pictogram sign mounted on or near the restroom door indicating all-gender facility, meeting accessibility code requirements.

name: Gender-Separated Restroom Construction
description: On-site installation of plumbing fixtures, partitions, finishes, and signage for gender-separated toilet rooms including accessibility compliance.

name: Gender-Separated Locker Room Fit-Out
description: On-site assembly and installation of lockers, benches, shower stalls, and cubicle partitions in gender-separated changing and locker areas.

name: Core Wall
description: A thickened vertical structural wall encircling the nucleus, typically of reinforced concrete or masonry, providing lateral stability and fire separation.

name: Service Core
description: The integrated vertical circulation and utility zone within the nucleus containing elevators, stairs, and mechanical shafts.

name: Elevator Shaft
description: A vertically enclosed void within the nucleus dedicated to elevator car travel and counterweight clearance.

name: MEP Riser Shaft
description: A vertical chase within the nucleus accommodating plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and data risers between floors.

name: Structural Shear Core
description: The interconnected system of walls and floor diaphragms within the nucleus that resists wind and seismic lateral loads.

name: Core Floor Slab
description: The concrete or composite floor deck within the nucleus at each level, often with penetrations for MEP drops.

name: Fire-Rated Enclosure
description: The combination of fire-rated walls, doors, dampers, and glazing that compartmentalizes the nucleus for life safety.

name: Core Cladding / Finishes
description: The interior surface materials applied to core walls, including gypsum board, paint, tile, or acoustic paneling.

name: Core Foundation
description: The deep foundation element (mat, caisson, or pile cap) directly supporting the eccentric nucleus and transferring its loads to the ground.

name: Core Wall Formwork Installation
description: On-site assembly and erection of formwork systems for pouring the reinforced concrete core walls.

name: Core Wall Reinforcement Placement
description: Installation of rebar cages and shear reinforcement within the core wall formwork prior to concrete pour.

name: Core Concrete Pouring & Curing
description: On-site placement, vibration, and curing of concrete for the nucleus walls and slabs.

name: Core MEP Rough-In
description: Installation of conduit, piping, ductwork, and sleeves within the core walls and shafts before finishing.

name: Elevator Installation & Commissioning
description: On-site assembly, mounting of rails, cabling, and testing of elevator systems within the nucleus shaft.

name: Fire-Stopping Installation
description: Application of fire-stop sealants and barriers at penetrations through the fire-rated core enclosure.

name: Concentric Density Ring
description: A circular band of varying density or occupancy intensity radiating outward from a central point within a building.

name: Radial Density Ring
description: A wedge-shaped or sector zone of uniform density extending outward from a center, forming a ring segment.

name: Density Ring Boundary
description: The physical or virtual separator (wall, partition, visual marker) that defines the transition between adjacent density rings.

name: Ring Circulation Path
description: The annular corridor or walkway that follows the contour of a density ring, connecting zones within the same ring band.

name: Density Gradient Floor Finish
description: A flooring material whose pattern, color, or texture varies radially to indicate changes in spatial density zones.

name: Ring Transition Threshold
description: A doorway, opening, or passage point between different density rings, possibly with access control or zoning indicators.

name: Fixed Density Ring Seating
description: Built-in tiered or concentric seating arranged in ring formations, common in auditoriums or lecture halls.

name: Density Ring Partition System
description: Movable or fixed partition assemblies that subdivide a larger space into concentric density zones.

name: Install Density Ring Floor Markings
description: On-site application of painted lines, inlaid strips, or floor decals defining density ring boundaries.

name: Erect Ring Partitions
description: Construction and installation of partition walls or screens along radial or concentric ring lines.

name: Atrium Nodes
description: Large multi-story open spaces within a building that serve as central gathering, circulation, and visual connection points, often featuring skylights or prominent architectural treatment.

name: Circulation Nodes
description: Points where multiple circulation paths (corridors, stairs, ramps) converge, including lobbies, landings, and junction spaces that organize pedestrian movement.

name: Assembly Nodes
description: Spaces designed for gatherings of people such as meeting rooms, conference centers, lecture halls, and multi-purpose rooms with fixed or flexible seating arrangements.

name: Auditorium / Performance Nodes
description: Dedicated spaces with tiered or raked seating, stage areas, and acoustic treatments for live performances, presentations, or cinematic viewing.

name: Reception / Entry Nodes
description: Formal entry points where visitors are greeted, including reception desk zones, waiting areas, and controlled-access vestibules integrated with the building's security and wayfinding systems.

name: Exhibition / Display Nodes
description: Spaces arranged for viewing exhibits, art, or products, with appropriate wall surfaces, lighting tracks, and circulation clearances for display layouts.

name: Breakout / Collaboration Nodes
description: Informal zones adjacent to primary workspaces equipped with built-in banquettes, whiteboards, and flexible furniture for spontaneous team interaction.

name: Screening / Viewing Nodes
description: Dedicated media-viewing spaces with controlled lighting, projection surfaces or large displays, and fixed or tiered seating for presentations or film screenings.

name: Elevated Walkway
description: A raised pedestrian pathway within or linking building spaces, often as a feature of a promenade.

name: Promenade Deck
description: An outdoor or semi-outdoor walking surface at an upper level of a building, designed for circulation and views.

name: Interior Concourse
description: A wide internal corridor or gallery designed for pedestrian flow, gathering, and exhibition.

name: Colonnade
description: A row of columns supporting an entablature or roof along a promenade path, defining the edge.

name: Paving / Decking Surface
description: The finished walking surface material (stone, tile, timber, composite) laid along the promenade path.

name: Promenade Canopy
description: An overhead cover or roof structure sheltering portions of the promenade from weather.

name: Outdoor Seating Niche
description: Built-in alcoves or widened areas along the promenade that accommodate fixed seating or rest stops.

name: Built-in Planter
description: A fixed planter box or integrated landscaped bed constructed within the promenade zone.

name: Promenade Lighting System
description: Fixed overhead, wall-mounted, or ground-recessed luminaires dedicated to illuminating the promenade path.

name: Railing Installation
description: On-site assembly and fixing of guardrails, handrails, or balustrades along the promenade edges.

name: Paving / Decking Installation
description: Laying, leveling, and finishing the walking surface materials of the promenade.

name: Column Erection
description: Positioning, aligning, and fixing columns for a colonnade or structural promenade edge.

name: Canopy Installation
description: Assembling and fixing the overhead shelter structure over portions of the promenade.

name: Retail Unit
description: Individual tenant shop spaces that line the shopping street and serve as leasable retail areas.

name: Shopping Street Floor
description: The finished walking surface of the shopping street, including its structural slab, finish flooring, and any floor drainage systems.

name: Shopping Street Ceiling
description: The overhead surface or soffit of the shopping street, which may include finish materials, lighting integration, and MEP routing.

name: Shopping Street Wall
description: The vertical enclosure surfaces flanking the shopping street, typically comprising glazed storefronts, partition walls, or structural walls.

name: Storefront Glazing
description: Fixed or operable glazed assemblies forming the primary visual interface between retail units and the shopping street.

name: Shopping Street Lighting
description: The artificial lighting system designed to illuminate the shopping street, including ambient, accent, and emergency lighting fixtures.

name: Shopping Street HVAC
description: Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems serving the shopping street common area, including diffusers, grilles, and ductwork.

name: Shopping Street Fire Safety System
description: Fire detection, alarm, sprinkler, and smoke control equipment installed along the shopping street for life safety.

name: Common Seating Area
description: Designated zones within the shopping street with fixed or built-in seating for shopper rest and congregation.

name: Public Art or Feature Display
description: Built-in display plinths, wall recesses, or mounting provisions for artwork or feature installations within the shopping street.

name: Shopping Street Signage and Wayfinding
description: Fixed signage, directory boards, and directional markers mounted on walls, ceilings, or floors to guide pedestrians.

name: Shopping Street Floor Drainage
description: Floor drains and related piping embedded in the shopping street floor to handle cleaning runoff and spillage.

name: Shopping Street Electrical and Data
description: Power outlets, data ports, and raceways embedded in floors, walls, or columns for temporary event use or kiosk operation.

name: Shopping Street Column
description: Structural columns located within the shopping street volume, which may be finished, clad, or used for signage mounting.

name: Shopping Street Kiosk or Cart Station
description: Fixed or designated locations with utility connections for temporary retail kiosks or carts operating in the common area.

name: Retail Unit Entry Door
description: Doors providing access from the shopping street into individual retail units, including frames, hardware, and access control provisions.

name: Shopping Street Floor Construction
description: On-site installation of the shopping street floor slab, waterproofing, underlayment, and finish flooring materials.

name: Storefront Glazing Installation
description: On-site erection and glazing of storefront framing systems along the shopping street elevation.

name: Shopping Street Ceiling Installation
description: On-site assembly and hanging of ceiling grids, panels, and integrated lighting or MEP components.

name: Shopping Street MEP Rough-In
description: On-site installation of concealed HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection infrastructure within shopping street walls and ceilings.

name: Shopping Street Lighting and Signage Commissioning
description: On-site testing, aiming, and programming of lighting controls and illuminated signage along the shopping street.

name: Shopping Street Floor Finishing
description: On-site application of final floor finish such as tile, terrazzo, polished concrete, or stone in the shopping street common area.

name: Retail Entry and Storefront Commissioning
description: On-site testing and adjustment of retail unit entry doors, automatic openers, and storefront hardware for proper operation.

name: Nightclub
description: A high-energy entertainment space with a dance floor, DJ booth, lighting rigs, sound system, and often a built-in bar.

name: Bar/Lounge
description: A social seating area centered around a fixed bar counter, integrated shelving for glassware, and built-in banquette seating.

name: Live Music Venue
description: A performance-oriented space with a fixed stage, built-in stage lighting trusses, and integrated sound system infrastructure.

name: Cinema/Theater
description: A tiered auditorium with fixed raked seating, a projection screen, and built-in acoustic wall paneling.

name: Karaoke Room

name: Multi-Family Mix

name: Single-Family Mix

name: Co-Living Mix

name: Mixed-Income Household Mix

name: Intergenerational Household Mix

name: Student Housing Mix

name: Senior Living Mix

name: Rubbish Chute Installation

name: Common Corridor System

name: Public Zone

name: Semi-Public Zone

name: Private Zone

name: Public Entrance

name: Reception/Information Desk

name: Access Control Turnstile

name: Security Vestibule
