name: Public Corridor
description: A circulation path within the building that is openly accessible to visitors and the general public.

name: Restricted Corridor
description: A circulation path located behind access control points, serving only authorized building occupants.

name: Visitor Waiting Area

name: Access Control System Installation

name: Reception Desk Construction

name: Public Signage Installation

name: Cluster Access Road

name: Cluster Pedestrian Walkway
description: The footpath network connecting dwelling units to each other and to common amenities within the cluster.

name: Shared Courtyard / Common Green

name: Cluster Parking Area

name: Common Utility Trench

name: Cluster Boundary Wall / Fence
description: The perimeter enclosure or screening element that defines the territorial edge of the house cluster.

name: Cluster Entrance Gateway
description: The formal entry point or portal marking vehicular and pedestrian access into the cluster.

name: Shared Waste / Recycling Enclosure

name: Cluster Stormwater Drainage Network

name: Common Mailbox Kiosk

name: Cluster Utility Rough-In Installation
description: Installation of shared underground water, sewer, gas, power, and data conduits serving all units.

name: Cluster Road & Walkway Construction

name: Cluster Landscaping & Planting

name: Shared Outdoor Lighting System

name: Cluster Fire Hydrant Assembly

name: Row House Unit

name: Front Façade

name: Rear Façade

name: Party Wall Parapet

name: Common Roof Assembly

name: Row House Interior Stair

name: Row House Cellar / Basement

name: Party Wall Firestop

name: Rear Addition / Back Extension

name: Row House Cornice

name: Interior Wall System

name: Elevator System

name: Stair Construction

name: Terrace and Balcony Elements

name: Residential Entry Doors

name: Built-in Bathroom Fit-Out

name: Window and Glazing System

description: Workspaces for town hall administrative staff handling records, permits, and public inquiries.

name: Reception and Information Desk
description: The built-in front counter where visitors are greeted and directed to appropriate services.

name: Public Records Archive
description: A climate-controlled storage room for official documents, deeds, meeting minutes, and historical records.

name: Municipal Courtroom
description: A formal hearing room for local judicial proceedings including traffic violations and ordinance disputes.

name: Judge's Bench and Witness Stand
description: Fixed elevated judicial furniture for the presiding judge and the witness during court proceedings.

name: Voter Registration and Polling Area
description: Designated space within the town hall equipped for voter registration and election day voting.

name: Public Meeting / Multi-Purpose Room
description: A flexible community room for public hearings, workshops, civic events, and after-hours functions.

name: Utility Billing and Permit Counter
description: A service counter with built-in transaction equipment for paying bills and obtaining permits.

name: Mayor's Private Office
description: An enclosed office for the town's chief elected official to conduct executive business.

name: Municipal IT Server Room
description: A dedicated conditioned space housing network servers for municipal data, communications, and record systems.

name: Town Hall Foyer / Lobby
description: The primary entrance and circulation space connecting visitors to all public office areas.

name: Public Toilet Facilities
description: Accessible restroom areas provided for visitors and staff within the town hall.

name: Building Security System
description: Integrated access control, surveillance cameras, and alarm systems protecting municipal offices and records.

name: Audio-Visual System for Chambers
description: Fixed sound reinforcement, recording, and projection systems installed in the council chamber for public meetings.

name: Town Hall Signage and Directory
description: Fixed interior and exterior signs identifying the building, departments, and directional wayfinding.

name: Install Council Chamber Seating
description: On-site assembly and anchoring of fixed tiered seating for the public gallery and council members.

name: Install Reception and Service Counters
description: Fabrication and installation of built-in transaction counters, cabinetry, and service desk assemblies.

name: Install Courtroom Furnishings
description: On-site placement and anchoring of the judge's bench, witness stand, and jury box fixed furniture.

name: Commission Audio-Visual and IT Systems
description: Testing, calibration, and integration of installed AV, recording, and data network equipment for operation.

name: Install Security and Access Control
description: Mounting, wiring, and configuration of door locks, card readers, cameras, and alarm system components.

name: Community Hub Pavilion
description: A central gathering space within the necklace that serves as the primary social and informational anchor for the community.

name: Connecting Pedestrian Link
description: A system of covered or landscaped walkways that physically ties the dispersed project nodes together.

name: Multi-Purpose Gallery Spine
description: An elongated exhibition and circulation space that links programmatic nodes and displays community work.

name: Shared Workshop Node
description: A flexible construction and making space where community members collaborate on building projects.

name: Community Garden Terrace
description: A planted outdoor room integrated into the building fabric for food growing and environmental education.

name: Neighborhood Porch Entry
description: A generous sheltered entrance portal that marks each project node and invites public access.

name: Modular Project Room Partition
description: Reconfigurable demountable wall panels that allow the sub-spaces to expand or contract as project needs change.

name: Integrated Display Casework
description: Fixed built-in cabinets and shelving that exhibit community project artifacts and documentation.

name: Built-in Meeting Alcove Seating
description: Fixed bench seating with integrated tables arranged in intimate nooks for small group discussions.

name: Project Resource Kiosk
description: A fixed reception and information desk serving as the material and tool check-out point for each node.

name: Community Broadcast Booth
description: A small glazed recording room for community podcasting and digital storytelling integrated into the circulation path.

name: Market Hall / Enclosure
description: The primary covered or open-air volume that contains all individual shop stalls and circulation.

name: Individual Shop Stall / Kiosk
description: A demarcated retail unit within the market, often consisting of a counter, shelving, and a small enclosed area for the vendor.

name: Market Stall Partition System
description: Demountable or fixed dividing walls, screens, or glazed panels that separate adjacent shop stalls.

name: Shared Customer Circulation Aisle
description: The pedestrian walkways between stalls that allow customers to move through the market.

name: Market Loading / Service Yard
description: A dedicated back-of-house area for vendor deliveries, goods unloading, and waste removal.

name: Vendor Storage Room
description: Individual or shared enclosed storage spaces for vendors to keep surplus stock, crates, and equipment.

name: Central Refuse & Recycling Enclosure
description: A designated built area for bins, compactors, and recycling containers serving all market shops.

name: Market Counters & Display Shelving
description: Built-in or fixed counters, shelving units, and display fixtures that form part of each stall's permanent fit-out.

name: Public Seating & Rest Area
description: Fixed benches, tables, and seating clusters integrated into the market for customer dining and rest.

name: Market Signage & Directory System
description: Fixed overhead or wall-mounted signage, stall number plates, and digital directories for vendor identification.

name: Market Lighting System
description: General ambient, task, and accent lighting installed above aisles and within each stall for illumination.

name: Market Electrical Distribution
description: Floor boxes, under-counter outlets, and sub-panels providing power to each vendor stall.

name: Market Mechanical Ventilation
description: Extraction hoods, supply air grilles, and ductwork serving the market hall, particularly over food stalls.

name: Market Plumbing & Drainage
description: Water supply lines, floor drains, and grease traps installed to serve vendor sinks and food-prep areas.

name: Market Fire Suppression System
description: Sprinkler heads, standpipes, and fire-extinguisher cabinets distributed across the market hall.

name: Market Floor Finish
description: Slip-resistant, washable flooring (tile, sealed concrete, or epoxy) laid throughout the market.

name: Market Ceiling Finish / Soffit
description: Exposed structural ceiling, acoustic panels, or suspended grid system covering the market hall.

name: Stall Electrical Sub-Metering
description: Individual utility meters or sub-meters installed per stall for tracking vendor energy consumption.

name: Market Security Shutters
description: Roll-down metal shutters or mesh gates at each stall front that secure the shop after hours.

name: Install Market Stall Partitions
description: On-site assembly and fixing of demountable or fixed partition walls between individual market stalls.

name: Install Market Counters & Shelving
description: On-site installation of built-in counters, display shelves, and vendor work surfaces within each stall.

name: Install Market Signage
description: Mounting of overhead directories, stall number plates, and informational signs throughout the market.

name: Install Market Plumbing & Drainage
description: On-site connection of water supply, floor drains, and grease traps for each food-vendor stall.

name: Commission Market Ventilation Hoods
description: Testing and balancing of extraction hoods and ventilation ductwork serving the food-preparation stalls.

name: Exam Room
description: An enclosed room within the health center where clinicians conduct patient examinations and consultations.

name: Treatment Room
description: A room equipped for minor medical procedures, wound care, and therapeutic treatments.

name: Reception Desk / Check-in Counter
description: A fixed counter and workstation at the main entry where patient check-in, billing, and administrative tasks occur.

name: Pharmacy Dispensary
description: A secured room or counter area for storing and dispensing prescription medications to patients.

name: Laboratory / Specimen Collection
description: A room for collecting, processing, and storing biological specimens with appropriate countertops and sinks.

name: Triage Bay
description: A rapid-assessment area with vital-signs equipment where patients are prioritized upon arrival.

name: Clean Utility Room
description: A storage and staging room for sterilized instruments, clean linens, and medical supplies.

name: Soiled Utility Room
description: A dedicated room with a slop sink and disposal area for contaminated waste and used linens.

name: Sterilization / Autoclave Room
description: A room housing autoclave equipment for sterilizing reusable medical instruments and tools.

name: Exam Table
description: A fixed or floor-mounted adjustable patient examination table with stirrups and paper roll holder.

name: Nurse Call System
description: A fixed communication system with pull-cords and wall-mounted buttons that alert staff from patient areas.

name: Handwashing Station
description: A clinical-grade sink with hands-free faucet, soap dispenser, and paper towel holder fixed to the wall.

name: X-Ray Room
description: A lead-lined radiographic imaging room with a fixed X-ray unit and wall-mounted control panel.

name: Lead-Lined Wall Assembly
description: A radiation-shielding wall construction containing lead sheeting or lead-impregnated gypsum board.

name: Exam Room Cabinetry
description: Fixed wall-mounted and base cabinets in clinical rooms for storing instruments, gloves, and supplies.

name: Consultation Room
description: A private office space where physicians discuss diagnoses and treatment plans with patients and families.

name: Staff Break Room
description: A back-of-house rest area with kitchenette counters and seating for health center personnel.

name: Medical Records Storage
description: A secure shelved room for filing and storing patient medical records and administrative documents.

name: IT / Server Closet
description: A climate-controlled enclosure for network servers, electronic health record hardware, and telecom equipment.

name: Emergency Power / Generator Room
description: A room housing a backup diesel generator and automatic transfer switch for life-safety systems.

name: Handicap-Accessible Toilet Room
description: An ADA-compliant restroom with grab bars, accessible fixtures, and emergency pull-cord for patient use.

name: Vaccine Refrigerator
description: A built-in medical-grade refrigeration unit for storing vaccines and biologics at controlled temperatures.

name: Medical Ceiling Pendant / Boom
description: A ceiling-mounted articulating arm delivering power, data, and medical gas drops above treatment beds.

name: Built-in Seating (Waiting Benches)
description: Fixed wall-attached benches in waiting or corridor areas providing durable seating without loose furniture.

name: Patient Privacy Curtain Track
description: A ceiling-mounted track system with curtains that subdivide exam or treatment bays for visual privacy.

name: Vaccination / Immunization Station
description: A dedicated alcove or station with a chair and supply counter for administering routine immunizations.

name: Wheelchair Storage Alcove
description: A recessed wall niche for parking wheelchairs and mobility aids without obstructing corridors.

name: Central Courtyard
description: An open-air or semi-enclosed space at the core of the housing cluster providing light, air, and communal gathering.

name: In-Between Gallery
description: A covered semi-public circulation space linking individual dwelling units to the central courtyard.

name: Load-Bearing Party Walls
description: Shared structural walls separating adjacent dwelling units within the in-between block.

name: Lattice Screen Facade
description: A perforated or brise-soleil enclosure on the in-between gallery side providing privacy and solar control.

name: Rainwater Collection System
description: An integrated roof drainage and cistern system capturing runoff from the housing block.

name: Natural Ventilation Shaft
description: A vertical duct system promoting stack-effect airflow through the interstitial spaces.

name: Shared Terrace Roof
description: An accessible flat roof above the in-between block used for communal activities or drying.

name: Unit Entry Alcove
description: A recessed transitional space at the threshold of each dwelling off the in-between gallery.

name: Concrete Frame Structure
description: The primary column-and-beam skeleton that defines the in-between volume.

name: In-Slab Hydronic Heating
description: Embedded hot-water pipes within the floor slabs of the in-between spaces for radiant heating.

name: Integrated Planter Bench
description: A fixed concrete or masonry seat built into the gallery edge containing planting.

name: Rammed Earth Infill Panel
description: A non-structural wall panel of compacted earth used as infill between the concrete frame.

name: Construction of Frame and Slabs
description: On-site casting or erection of the concrete structural frame and floor slabs for the in-between block.

name: Installation of Lattice Screens
description: On-site assembly and fixing of perforated facade panels to the gallery elevations.

name: Installation of Rainwater System
description: On-site installation of gutters, downpipes, filters, and cisterns for the rainwater harvesting system.

name: Commissioning of Ventilation Shafts
description: On-site testing and balancing of natural ventilation dampers and shaft pathways.

name: Road Base Course
description: The granular material layer placed on prepared subgrade to distribute traffic loads and provide drainage for the road pavement structure.

name: Asphalt Wearing Surface
description: The top layer of asphalt pavement providing a smooth, durable, weather-resistant driving surface for looped local roads.

name: Road Pavement Structure
description: The multi-layer engineered system comprising base, binder, and wearing courses that supports vehicular loads on local roads.

name: Concrete Curb
description: A precast or cast-in-place concrete edging element that delineates the road edge, controls drainage, and prevents vehicle encroachment onto adjacent surfaces.

name: Road Gutter
description: A concrete or stone-lined channel along the road edge that collects and conveys stormwater runoff to drainage inlets.

name: Road Shoulder
description: The maintained strip of ground adjacent to the road pavement providing lateral support, emergency stopping area, and pedestrian access.

name: Traffic Signage
description: Fixed regulatory, warning, or guidance signs mounted on posts adjacent to the road to direct and inform drivers and pedestrians.

name: Road Pavement Marking
description: Painted or thermoplastic markings applied to the road surface indicating lane delineation, pedestrian crossings, and stop lines.

name: Road Drainage Inlet
description: A grated catch basin or grated trench drain that captures surface runoff from the road and conveys it into the underground stormwater system.

name: Road Lighting Pole
description: A fixed vertical pole supporting a luminaire to provide nighttime illumination for vehicular and pedestrian safety along the local road.

name: Underground Stormwater Drainage Pipe
description: A buried pipe network that conveys collected road runoff from drainage inlets to detention basins or municipal storm sewers.

name: Pedestrian Crosswalk
description: A designated marked crossing area where the road surface is specially treated to provide safe pedestrian passage across the traffic lane.

name: Road Subgrade Preparation
description: The on-site compaction and grading of the natural soil foundation to achieve the required bearing capacity for the road pavement layers.

name: Road Base Installation
description: The on-site spreading, grading, and compaction of granular base material to create a stable foundation for the asphalt pavement.

name: Asphalt Paving
description: The on-site placement, screeding, and rolling of hot-mix asphalt to form the finished road surface of the looped local road.

name: Curb and Gutter Installation
description: The on-site forming, pouring, and finishing of concrete curbs and gutters along the edges of the looped local road.

name: Road Signage Installation
description: The on-site setting of posts in concrete footings and mounting of traffic signs along the local road corridor.

name: Road Marking Application
description: The on-site application of thermoplastic or paint markings to the cured asphalt surface for traffic guidance and pedestrian safety.

name: Speed Bump Installation
description: The on-site forming and pouring of concrete or installation of prefabricated rubber modules to create raised traffic-calming features across the road width.

name: T-Junction Corridor
description: A corridor segment that terminates at a perpendicular corridor or wall, forming a T-shaped intersection in the circulation path.

name: T-Junction Wall Intersection
description: The wall assembly where one wall meets another perpendicularly to create the T-shaped junction.

name: T-Junction Door Assembly
description: A door installed at the head or stem of a T-junction to control access between the intersecting corridors or rooms.

name: T-Junction Corner Guard
description: A protective metal or plastic fitting installed at the exposed internal corner of a T-junction to prevent wall damage from traffic.

name: T-Junction Ceiling Transition
description: The ceiling plane treatment at a T-junction where two corridor ceilings meet, often requiring special tile layout or bulkhead detailing.

name: T-Junction Floor Transition
description: The floor finish transition line where two corridor floor materials or patterns meet at the T-intersection.

name: T-Junction Signage Location
description: Wayfinding signage mounted at a T-junction to indicate directional paths to occupants.

name: T-Junction Fire Compartment Penetration
description: Fire-rated construction at the T-junction where a corridor passes through a fire compartment wall, including required fire dampers and seals.

name: T-Junction Lighting Layout
description: The arrangement of light fixtures at a T-junction to ensure adequate illumination on both corridor paths without dark corners.

name: T-Junction Handrail Termination
description: The special handrail fitting or return at a T-junction where a corridor handrail meets a perpendicular wall.

name: T-Junction Accessibility Turning Circle
description: The clear floor space at a T-junction required for a wheelchair to turn 90 degrees between the intersecting corridors per accessibility codes.

name: T-Junction Wall Framing
description: On-site installation of stud framing at the intersection of two walls to form the T-junction structural support.

name: T-Junction Drywall Finishing
description: On-site taping, mudding, and sanding of the drywall at the internal and external corners of a T-junction to achieve a smooth finish.

name: T-Junction Corner Bead Installation
description: On-site fitting of metal or vinyl corner beads at the exposed T-junction edges prior to drywall finishing.

name: Green Street Planting Beds
description: Dedicated planting zones within or alongside the street right-of-way that accommodate vegetation, soil, and drainage layers for stormwater management.

name: Green Street Pavement Systems
description: Permeable or porous pavement assemblies (e.g., pervious concrete, porous asphalt, permeable interlocking pavers) designed to allow infiltration of stormwater through the surface.

name: Stormwater Bioretention Cells
description: Engineered depressions or basins with filtration media, typically including sand, soil, mulch, and plantings, that capture and treat runoff from adjacent impervious surfaces.

name: Tree Trench Systems
description: Below-grade structural soil cells or modular trench frameworks that provide uncompacted rooting volume for street trees while supporting pavement loads and managing stormwater.

name: Curb Extension Bump-Out
description: Extended curb sections that protrude into the roadway at intersections or mid-block to shorten pedestrian crossings and create space for plantings or bioretention.

name: Green Street Drainage Infrastructure
description: Subsurface drainage network including underdrains, catch basins, overflow inlets, and conveyance pipes that manage excess stormwater from green street features.

name: Street Tree Canopy Elements
description: Planting of shade trees within the street right-of-way, including tree grates, guards, stakes, and irrigation connections to support tree establishment and growth.

name: Green Street Irrigation System
description: Fixed drip or spray irrigation infrastructure supplying water to planted areas within the green street during establishment and dry periods.

name: Rain Garden Planters
description: Contained planter boxes or raised beds integrated into the streetscape that collect and filter roof or sidewalk runoff through soil and vegetation.

name: Green Street Signage and Interpretive Elements
description: Fixed signs, markers, or educational displays mounted in the streetscape that identify green street features and explain their stormwater or ecological functions.

name: Construct Green Street Excavation and Grading
description: On-site earthwork including removal of existing pavement, grading for positive drainage, and shaping of bioretention basins and trench profiles.

name: Install Permeable Pavement
description: On-site installation of permeable pavement materials including base aggregate layers, bedding courses, and surface pavers or porous concrete placement.

name: Install Bioretention Soil Media and Plantings
description: Placement of engineered soil mix, mulch, and installed vegetation within bioretention cells, tree trenches, or planting beds on site.

name: Install Subsurface Drainage and Overflow Systems
description: On-site assembly and connection of underdrain pipes, perforated laterals, cleanouts, and overflow structures within green street sub-grade zones.

name: Install Curb and Curb Extension Structures
description: Forming, placing, and finishing concrete or masonry curbs and curb extensions at designed locations within the street right-of-way.

name: Roadway Pavement
description: The layered structural surface (asphalt, concrete, or paving stones) that supports vehicle loads on the roadway.

name: Road Base/Subbase
description: The compacted aggregate layers beneath the pavement that distribute loads and provide drainage for the road structure.

name: Vehicular Travel Lane
description: The designated longitudinal section of roadway for the movement of motor vehicles in one direction.

name: Parking Lane
description: A marked lane along or beside the roadway set aside for stationary vehicle parking.

name: Road Curbs
description: The raised edge (concrete or stone) along the roadway perimeter that defines the boundary and channels stormwater.

name: Road Gutters
description: The concrete channel at the edge of the roadway that collects and conveys surface runoff to drainage inlets.

name: Sidewalk / Footpath
description: The paved pedestrian walkway running parallel to the roadway, separated by a curb or verge.

name: Pedestrian Crossing / Crosswalk
description: A marked pedestrian crossing zone across the roadway, often with contrasting pavement and signage.

name: Bicycle Lane
description: A dedicated lane on or beside the roadway marked for exclusive or preferential bicycle use.

name: Traffic Median / Refuge Island
description: A raised or painted central divider on the roadway that separates opposing traffic and provides pedestrian refuge.

name: Roadway Drainage System
description: The network of inlets, pipes, and catch basins that collects and removes stormwater from the road surface.

name: Roadway Base Preparation
description: On-site excavation, grading, and compaction of subgrade to the required density and elevation for the road structure.

name: Roadway Paving Installation
description: On-site placement, spreading, and compaction of asphalt or concrete pavement to form the finished road surface.

name: Road Markings Application
description: On-site painting or thermoplastic application of lane lines, crosswalks, arrows, and symbols on the finished pavement.

name: Curb and Gutter Construction
description: On-site forming, pouring, and finishing of concrete curbs and gutters along the roadway edges.

name: Traffic Sign Installation
description: On-site mounting of regulatory, warning, and guide signs on posts or structures along the roadway.

name: Signalization System
description: The traffic signal poles, signal heads, controller cabinets, and inductive loop detectors that control vehicular and pedestrian movements.

name: Road Lighting System
description: The light poles, luminaires, and underground cabling that illuminate the roadway for nighttime safety.

name: Guardrails / Traffic Barriers
description: Metal beams, concrete barriers, or cable systems installed along roadway edges to prevent vehicle departure.

name: Roadway Subgrade
description: The native or imported soil layer prepared and compacted to support the road base and pavement structure.

name: Verge / Roadside Strip
description: The unpaved grass or landscaped strip between the roadway edge and the adjacent property or sidewalk.

name: Driveway / Access Ramp
description: The short paved connection from the roadway to an adjacent building or parking area.

name: Speed Bump / Speed Table
description: A raised transverse pavement feature designed to reduce vehicle speed on the roadway.

name: Roadway Joint Sealant
description: The flexible sealant material placed in saw-cut transverse and longitudinal joints in concrete pavement.

name: Gate House
description: A small enclosed building or shelter located at the main entrance that houses security personnel and access control systems.

name: Entry Portal
description: The physical opening frame and structure that defines the primary pedestrian or vehicular passage through the gateway.

name: Security Barrier System
description: Fixed bollards, rising arm barriers, or retractable gate elements that control vehicular and pedestrian access at the main entry point.

name: Gateway Canopy
description: A roof-like overhead structure extending over the gateway area to provide weather protection for arriving and departing users.

name: Access Control Hardware
description: Building-integrated electronic readers, intercoms, card swipe units, and biometric scanners fixed at the gateway for entry authorization.

name: Gateway Signage Pylon
description: A fixed structure or wall-mounted sign carrying the building name, address, or identification at the main gateway location.

name: Entry Gate Leaves
description: The operable swinging or sliding panels (metal, wood, or composite) that physically close off the gateway opening.

name: Gateway Lighting
description: Fixed luminaires mounted on posts, walls, or canopy at the gateway for security illumination and wayfinding.

name: Vehicle Entry Lane
description: The paved approach and queuing area immediately preceding and passing through the gateway for automobile or truck access.

name: Gateway Foundation
description: The concrete or masonry substructure that anchors gateway columns, gate posts, and barrier systems to the ground.

name: Gateway Intercom Station
description: A fixed weatherproof communication unit mounted at the gateway for visitor-to-occupant audio or video calls.

name: Perimeter Fence Transition
description: The segments of fixed fencing or walling on either side of the gateway that connect the gate opening to the surrounding property boundary.

name: Gateway Bollard Set
description: Fixed vertical posts installed at the gateway perimeter to prevent vehicle encroachment while allowing pedestrian passage.

name: Install Gateway Foundations
description: Excavating, forming, and pouring concrete footings for gateway posts, columns, and barrier systems.

name: Install Gate Leaves & Hardware
description: Mounting and hanging gate panels, hinges, tracks, rollers, and locking mechanisms at the gateway opening.

name: Install Access Control & Security Systems
description: Fixing and commissioning electronic entry systems, intercoms, card readers, and security barriers at the gateway.

name: Install Gateway Canopy & Lighting
description: Erecting the overhead canopy structure and mounting all fixed luminaires and electrical connections at the gateway.

name: Install Gateway Signage
description: Mounting building identification signs, direction markers, and address displays on gateway structures or walls.

name: Road Crossing Base
description: The foundational structural slab or platform that forms the road crossing surface within the building or site context.

name: Road Crossing Pavement
description: The finished paving surface material applied over the road crossing base to provide vehicular or pedestrian traffic durability.

name: Road Crossing Drainage System
description: A system of drains, gratings, and channels that removes surface water from the road crossing to prevent ponding and slipping hazards.

name: Road Crossing Bollards
description: Fixed vertical posts installed at the edges of the road crossing to control vehicular access and protect pedestrians.

name: Road Crossing Signage
description: Fixed informational or warning signs mounted at or near the road crossing to direct traffic and indicate crossing rules.

name: Road Crossing Markings
description: Painted or thermoplastic surface markings on the pavement that delineate pedestrian crossing zones and traffic lanes.

name: Road Crossing Lighting
description: Fixed lighting fixtures installed above or beside the road crossing to illuminate the area for safe passage during low-light conditions.

name: Road Crossing Ramp
description: Sloped transition element at the edge of the crossing that provides accessible passage between the roadway and footpath levels.

name: Road Crossing Kerb
description: Raised edge element separating the road crossing from adjacent paving or landscaping to contain and direct vehicular traffic.

name: Road Crossing Traffic Calming Device
description: A fixed raised element such as a speed table or raised crosswalk integrated into the crossing to slow vehicular traffic.

name: Road Crossing Barrier
description: Fixed guardrails or fences installed at the sides of the crossing to physically separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

name: Road Crossing Foundation
description: The substructure below the road crossing base that transfers loads from the crossing and traffic into the ground.

name: Road Crossing Installation
description: On-site construction activity comprising excavation, base preparation, and placement of the road crossing structure and finishes.

name: Road Crossing Drainage Installation
description: On-site installation of drains, gratings, and channel systems to manage surface water runoff at the road crossing.

name: Road Crossing Signage Mounting
description: On-site fixing of warning and directional signs at the road crossing to ensure clear visual communication to users.

name: Road Crossing Marking Application
description: On-site painting or thermoplastic application of lane and pedestrian crossing markings onto the road crossing pavement.

name: Road Crossing Lighting Installation
description: On-site mounting and connection of lighting fixtures above or adjacent to the road crossing for illumination.

name: Road Crossing Bollard Installation
description: On-site fixing of bollards into the ground or base at the road crossing perimeter to control vehicular access.

name: Raised Walk Decking
description: The horizontal walking surface panels or boards that form the top layer of a raised walkway.

name: Raised Walk Substructure/Support Frame
description: The underlying framework of joists, beams, or pedestals that elevates the walk surface above the subgrade or roof membrane.

name: Raised Walk Handrail/Guardrail
description: Safety railing system running along the edge of the raised walk to prevent falls.

name: Raised Walk Balustrade
description: The full edge barrier assembly including posts, infill panels, and top rail alongside the raised walk.

name: Raised Walk Stair/Step Access
description: Integrated steps or stair segments providing vertical transition onto or off the raised walk level.

name: Raised Walk Ramp Access
description: Sloped access pathway providing barrier-free transition between ground level and raised walk level.

name: Raised Walk Foundation/Footing
description: Concrete or structural base elements that transfer loads from the raised walk supports to the ground or roof structure.

name: Raised Walk Expansion Joint
description: A designed gap and cover assembly that accommodates thermal movement and structural deflection in long raised walk runs.

name: Raised Walk Anti-Slip Surface Treatment
description: A textured coating, insert, or applied finish that increases friction on the walking surface to improve slip resistance.

name: Elevated Timber Walkway
description: A raised walk variant where the primary decking and structural components are timber, often used in landscape and park settings.

name: Elevated Steel Grating Walkway
description: A raised walk variant using metal grating panels for the walking surface, common in industrial or utility areas.

name: Roof-Level Raised Walk
description: A raised walk installed on a roof slab to protect the waterproofing membrane while providing occupant access across the roof.

name: Raised Walk Deck Installation
description: On-site installation of the decking boards or panels onto the prepared substructure of the raised walk.

name: Raised Walk Substructure Erection
description: Assembly and fixing of the support frame, pedestals, or joists that carry the raised walk surface.

name: Raised Walk Railing Installation
description: On-site fixing of handrails, guardrails, or balustrade components along the edge of the raised walk.

name: Bicycle Shelter/Canopy
description: A roofed structure (often with side panels) that protects parked bicycles from rain, sun, and snow.

name: Bicycle Repair Station
description: A fixed post or stand with integrated tools and an air pump for on-site bicycle repairs and tire inflation.

name: Bike Path Pavement
description: The surfacing layer (asphalt, concrete, or paving stones) specifically laid for designated bicycle travel lanes.

name: Bike Path Curb/Edge Restraint
description: A raised border or curb that delineates the bike path from adjacent roadways, sidewalks, or landscaping.

name: Bike Path Signage
description: Fixed signs indicating bike route directions, distances, shared-use rules, and wayfinding for cyclists.

name: Bike Path Bollard
description: A short vertical post installed at bike path entrances to prevent motor vehicle access while allowing bicycles to pass.

name: Bicycle Storage Room
description: An enclosed interior room within a building dedicated to parking tenants' or employees' bicycles, often with racks and lockers.

name: Bike Path Lighting
description: Fixed light fixtures mounted along a bike path to provide illumination for safe nighttime cycling.

name: Bicycle Wash Station
description: A fixed outdoor or indoor station with a water hose, drain, and grate for cleaning bicycles.

name: Bike Path Drainage System
description: The network of drains, swales, and sloping designed to remove stormwater from the bike path surface.

name: Install Bicycle Racks
description: On-site anchoring, bolting, or embedding of bicycle rack units into concrete or pavement.

name: Construct Bike Path Pavement
description: On-site grading, base preparation, and laying of asphalt or concrete surfacing for bike paths.

name: Install Bike Shelter/Canopy
description: On-site assembly and anchoring of shelter posts, roof panels, and glazing over a bike parking area.

name: Install Bike Path Signage
description: On-site mounting of bike route signs and wayfinding markers along the designated path.

name: Install Bike Path Bollards

name: Site Earthwork & Grading
description: On-site excavation, cut, fill, and shaping of the ground to achieve the designed drainage and level conditions for common land.

name: Paving Installation
description: On-site placement of unit pavers, concrete slabs, or stone flags over prepared subbase to form walkways and plazas.

name: Sodding / Seeding
description: On-site installation of rolled turf or broadcast seeding of grass onto prepared topsoil to establish the lawn surface.

name: Tree / Shrub Planting
description: On-site digging of planting pits, placement of root balls, backfilling, and staking vegetation within the common land beds.

name: Site Furnishing Installation
description: On-site anchoring, bolting, or embedding of fixed benches, bollards, racks, and receptacles into the common land surface.

name: Play Structure Climbing Wall
description: A building-integrated climbing surface with holds, attached to walls or freestanding structural frames within play spaces.

name: Soft Fall Flooring
description: Impact-absorbing resilient floor surface (rubber tile, poured-in-place rubber, or foam-backed carpet tile) installed in play zones for safety.

name: Indoor Slide / Tube Slide
description: A fixed, built-in slide structure, often integrated with platforms or mezzanines, constructed from plastic, metal, or concrete.

name: Ball Pit Enclosure
description: A contained pit area with padded edges and built-in perimeter seating, designed to hold play balls, typically framed in plywood and upholstered.

name: Interactive Digital Play Wall
description: A wall-mounted or floor-projected interactive display system with motion sensors and projection hardware integrated into the building finish.

name: Play Loft / Mezzanine Platform
description: A raised elevated floor platform within a double-height space, accessible via built-in stairs or ladder, used for supervised play activities.

name: Foam Block Pit
description: A built-in pit lined with foam mattresses and padded wall surrounds for loose foam block play, commonly found in early childhood settings.

name: Sensory Play Wall Panel
description: A fixed wall panel with integrated tactile, auditory, or visual elements (gears, chimes, mirrors, texture tiles) for sensory stimulation.

name: Play Structure Support Column Padding
description: Foam or padded wraps permanently installed around structural columns within play areas to prevent injury from collisions.

name: Indoor Playground Structure
description: A multi-level, built-in modular play frame with platforms, tunnels, bridges, and slides, typically anchored to the floor and walls.

name: Connected Play Area Floor Plan Layout
description: The spatial configuration and zoning of play zones including circulation paths, sightlines, and adjacency to supervision areas.

name: Safety Zone Clearance
description: Designated open floor area surrounding play equipment required by code to provide fall-zone clearance around all play components.

name: Play Equipment Anchoring System
description: Bolts, brackets, and floor fasteners that secure freestanding play structures to the building slab to prevent tip-over.

name: Soft Play Shape Set (Built-in)
description: Fixed foam geometric shapes (wedges, cylinders, steps) covered in vinyl or fabric that are permanently attached to the floor or walls.

name: Child-Scale Entry Gate
description: A building-integrated gate or barrier at play area entrances with child-safe latching hardware, set into wall openings.

name: Play Area Acoustic Treatment
description: Acoustic panels, baffles, or ceiling clouds installed in play spaces to control noise reverberation from children's activities.

name: Installation of Play Structure Anchors
description: On-site process of drilling, setting expansion bolts, and securing play equipment base plates to concrete floor slabs.

name: Installation of Soft Fall Flooring
description: On-site placement of rubber tiles, mats, or poured-in-place rubber safety surfacing over prepared subfloor within play zones.

name: Assembly and Erection of Indoor Play Structure
description: On-site bolting, bracketing, and vertical assembly of modular play platform components, slides, and tunnels per manufacturer specifications.

name: Integration of Interactive Digital Wall System
description: On-site mounting of projector, sensors, and protective housing, plus in-wall conduit routing and connection to building power/data.

name: Public Outdoor Room Floor/Deck
description: The walking surface of the outdoor room, which may be timber decking, stone paving, concrete slabs, or composite deck boards.

name: Public Outdoor Room Roof/Canopy
description: Overhead weather protection such as a fixed pergola, tensile membrane, louvered roof, or solid canopy covering the outdoor room.

name: Public Outdoor Room Enclosure Walls
description: Vertical boundary elements including partial-height walls, screen walls, glass balustrades, or green walls that define the room's perimeter.

name: Public Outdoor Room Structural Frame
description: The load-bearing framework — steel columns, timber posts, or concrete piers — supporting the canopy and any overhead elements.

name: Public Outdoor Room Integrated Seating
description: Fixed or built-in benches, seat walls, or stepped seating integrated into the construction of the outdoor room.

name: Public Outdoor Room Lighting
description: Permanently installed luminaires for ambient, task, or accent illumination, including uplights, string lights and wall-mounted fixtures.

name: Public Outdoor Room Drainage System
description: Sub-surface or surface drainage including trench drains, floor gullies, and sloped substrates to manage rainwater runoff.

name: Public Outdoor Room Power and Data Outlets
description: Weatherproof electrical receptacles and data ports fixed to walls, columns, or floor boxes for public use.

name: Public Outdoor Room Shading Devices
description: Adjustable louvers, retractable awnings, shade sails, or brise-soleil elements controlling solar gain and glare.

name: Public Outdoor Room Planting and Planters
description: Built-in planter boxes, raised garden beds, or permanent trellis systems containing vegetation within the outdoor room.

name: Public Outdoor Room Wind Screens
description: Fixed glass, polycarbonate, or perforated metal panels strategically placed to reduce wind speed at occupant level.

name: Public Outdoor Room Heating System
description: Permanently mounted radiant heaters, fire pits, or underfloor heating extending into the outdoor space.

name: Public Outdoor Room Sound System
description: Fixed weather-rated speakers and audio equipment integrated into the structure for background music or announcements.

name: Public Outdoor Room Signage and Wayfinding
description: Fixed signs, information boards, or interpretive panels mounted on walls or freestanding within the space.

name: Public Outdoor Room Furniture (Fixed)
description: Site-built or permanently anchored tables, counters, reception desks, or other casework intended for public use.

name: Public Outdoor Room Fire Protection
description: Fixed fire extinguisher cabinets, standpipes, or sprinkler heads servicing the outdoor room area.

name: Subgrade Preparation and Earthworks
description: Excavation, grading, and compaction of the subgrade below the outdoor room to achieve proper drainage and bearing capacity.

name: Decking/Paving Installation
description: Laying of the finished floor surface including joist/substructure work for decking or screed/slab work for paving.

name: Canopy/Structural Frame Erection
description: Assembly and erection of the structural frame and roof elements including connections to adjacent building structure.

name: Enclosure and Screen Installation
description: Installation of all vertical boundary elements such as glass balustrades, screen walls, and wind screens.

name: Built-in Seating and Furniture Installation
description: Construction and fixing of all permanent benches, seat walls, tables, and counters to the substrate.

name: MEP Rough-In and Fit-Out
description: Installation of all electrical, data, lighting, heating, and audio systems including conduit, cabling, and final fixture trim-out.

name: Planter Construction and Planting
description: Building of planter boxes and raised beds including waterproofing, soil fill, and installation of specified vegetation.

name: Grave Excavation
description: On-site excavation of earth to create the pit for a grave site.

name: Grave Liner/Vault
description: A concrete or metal container placed in the excavation to support the earth and prevent subsidence.

name: Headstone/Stele
description: A fixed vertical stone or metal marker identifying the deceased at the head of the grave.

name: Grave Base/Foundation
description: A concrete slab or footing laid at the base of the grave to support the vault or liner.

name: Grave Curb/Edging
description: A fixed border element outlining the perimeter of the grave plot at grade level.

name: Grave Cover/Lawn Slab
description: A flush-mounted stone or concrete slab covering the grave surface to allow mowing.

name: Grave Drainage System
description: Subsurface perforated pipes and gravel fill that divert groundwater away from the grave.

name: Cemetery Plot Grid
description: The surveyed layout of grave plots within a cemetery section, defining rows and plot boundaries.

name: Crypt/Burial Chamber
description: A below-grade masonry chamber designed to hold caskets, often within a mausoleum structure.

name: Grave Backfill & Compaction
description: On-site placement and mechanical compaction of excavated soil over the vault.

name: Plot Marker Installation
description: On-site setting and anchoring of the headstone or grave marker into its foundation.

name: Columbarium Niche
description: A small compartment within a wall or structure designed to hold cremation urns.

name: Mausoleum Wall
description: A built masonry wall containing stacked crypts or columbarium niches for above-ground burial.

name: Cenotaph
description: A fixed commemorative monument marking a grave where the remains are elsewhere.

name: Grave Landscape/Turf
description: Sod or seeded grass covering the finished grave surface as part of the cemetery landscape.

name: Still Water Basin
description: A contained basin or pool that holds still water as a designed architectural feature, such as a reflecting pond or indoor water court.

name: Still Water Reservoir
description: A building-integrated water storage system designed to hold still water for fire suppression, greywater reuse, or HVAC make-up water.

name: Still Water Feature Floor Sump
description: A recessed floor drain or sump pit specifically placed beneath indoor still water features to collect overflow and enable drainage.

name: Still Water Liner & Membrane System
description: A waterproof liner or membrane (e.g., EPDM, PVC, bentonite) installed as a continuous barrier to contain still water within a basin or reservoir.

name: Indoor Reflecting Pool
description: A shallow, contained water feature within a building designed for visual reflection and aesthetic purposes, typically with recirculation omitted or minimal.

name: Still Water Containment Wall
description: A perimeter wall or curb cast in place to physically confine still water within a designated pool or basin area.

name: Still Water Overflow Weir
description: A notched edge or slot set at a designed water level to passively route excess still water to a drain or recirculation system.

name: Still Water Recirculation Bypass
description: A closed-loop piping system with low-flow pump that slowly moves water through the still water feature primarily for filtration, not for visible flow.

name: Subgrade Still Water Cistern
description: A below-grade concrete or plastic tank that stores collected rainwater as still water for landscape irrigation or non-potable building use.

name: Still Water Level Sensor System
description: An electronic or mechanical sensor array that monitors the static water level in a basin and triggers alarms or auto-fill valves at preset thresholds.

name: Basin Structural Slab
description: A reinforced concrete slab specifically designed to support the static hydrostatic load of a still water basin and transfer it to the building foundation.

name: Still Water Cleaning & Commissioning Activity
description: On-site flushing, disinfection, and testing of the still water basin and its containment surfaces prior to final fill and occupancy.

name: Still Water Basin Waterproofing Application
description: On-site application of liquid-applied or sheet waterproofing to basin surfaces to ensure long-term watertight containment.

name: Still Water Feature Drainage Rough-In
description: Installation of sub-slab drainage piping, sump basins, and overflow connections during the building's rough-in phase specifically for a still water feature.

name: Sports Hall
description: Large indoor open hall designed for court-based sports such as basketball, volleyball, badminton, and futsal.

name: Gymnasium / Fitness Studio
description: Dedicated space for exercise equipment, aerobics, weight training, and fitness classes.

name: Changing Rooms / Locker Rooms
description: Rooms equipped with lockers, benches, and drying areas for athletes to change and store personal belongings.

name: Shower & Sanitary Facilities
description: Wet areas with showers, toilets, and sinks serving sports participants.

name: Swimming Pool Hall
description: Indoor space housing a swimming pool, with pool basin, deck, and humidity control systems.

name: Spectator Seating / Bleachers
description: Fixed or retractable tiered seating installed for audiences watching sports events.

name: Sports Flooring System
description: Engineered resilient flooring including subfloor, shock-absorption layer, and finished sport surface (e.g., wood, vinyl, polyurethane).

name: Court Markings & Linework
description: Painted or taped boundary lines and zone markings applied to the sports floor for various games.

name: Basketball Hoop Assembly
description: Fixed backboard, rim, and support structure mounted to wall or ceiling for basketball play.

name: Volleyball Net System
description: Ceiling-anchored or floor-socketed posts and net for volleyball courts.

name: Badminton Post & Net Set
description: Floor-mounted posts and net system for badminton play.

name: Futsal Goal
description: Fixed or portable goal frame with netting for indoor soccer.

name: Climbing Wall
description: Structural wall panel with artificial holds and safety anchor points for climbing activities.

name: Scoreboard / Display System
description: Electronic or manual score display board mounted on wall or suspended from ceiling in the sports hall.

name: Gym Equipment Mounts & Floor Anchors
description: Floor inserts, wall brackets, and fixing plates for securing fitness machines, cable stations, or weight racks.

name: Padded Wall Protection
description: Impact-absorbing wall padding installed around sports halls and gymnasiums for player safety.

name: Sports Lighting System
description: High-output artificial lighting with glare control designed for even illumination of sports surfaces.

name: Sports Acoustics Treatment
description: Sound-absorbing panels, baffles, or ceiling clouds to control noise and reverberation in sports spaces.

name: Pool Water Treatment System
description: Filtration, circulation, chemical dosing, and heating equipment serving the swimming pool hall.

name: HVAC for Sports Space
description: Heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning system sized for high-occupancy sports halls and pools.

name: Sports Flooring Installation
description: On-site assembly and fixing of subfloor, shock pads, and finished sport surface panels or sheets.

name: Court Marking Application
description: On-site painting or taping of game lines and zone markings onto the finished sports floor.

name: Fixed Equipment Installation
description: On-site anchoring and assembly of basketball hoops, volleyball posts, climbing holds, and scoreboards.

name: Seating System Erection
description: On-site installation of fixed or retractable spectator seating including structural supports and row numbering.

name: Pool Basin Construction
description: On-site forming, waterproofing, and tiling of the swimming pool basin including circulation inlets and drains.

name: Play Structure Foundation
description: Concrete or engineered base pad and anchorage system for freestanding climbing frames, towers, and multi-level play platforms.

name: Soft Safety Surfacing
description: Impact-attenuating rubber tile or poured-in-place rubber surface installed over the playground fall zone.

name: Climbing Wall Panel
description: Structural panel with integrated handholds and footholds fixed to a wall or freestanding frame for vertical climbing activities.

name: Slide Unit
description: Fixed molded plastic or metal slide chute with platform, stair, or ladder access integrated into the playground structure.

name: Swing Frame Assembly
description: Freestanding structural frame with hung seats, chains, and anchorage hardware for swinging activities.

name: Zip Line System
description: Overhead cable track with trolley and handle assembly mounted on structural supports within the playground.

name: Net Climber
description: Rigidly framed cargo net or rope web structure mounted to posts or a play frame for climbing.

name: Balance Beam
description: Narrow elevated beam of timber or composite material fixed on low supports for walking balance activities.

name: Play Bridge
description: Fixed timber, rope, or cable bridge connecting elevated play platforms or towers within the playground.

name: Tire Swing Support
description: Structural A-frame or beam with hanging hardware for large tire swings within the playground area.

name: Spinner Roundabout
description: Rotating platform assembly with hand grips mounted on a central bearing post and embedded foundation.

name: Spring Rocker
description: Individual animal- or vehicle-shaped seat mounted on a heavy coil spring anchored to a concrete footing.

name: Sand Play Basin
description: Contained sand-filled pit with perimeter seating walls, drainage layer, and geotextile liner.

name: Water Play Feature
description: Fixed splash pad, water channel, or hand pump with integrated drainage and recirculation plumbing.

name: Playground Fence and Gate
description: Perimeter safety fence with self-closing, self-latching gates enclosing the adventure playground boundary.

name: Shade Structure
description: Fixed canopy, sail, or roof structure mounted on posts providing sun protection over play zones.

name: Seating Wall
description: Low built-in masonry or concrete bench wall surrounding play zones for supervision and rest.

name: Adventure Trail Path
description: Continuous accessible pathway system connecting all play zones with appropriate surface materials and edging.

name: Playground Drainage System
description: Subsurface drainage network including french drains, catch basins, and piping to manage stormwater runoff.

name: Adventure Playground Signage
description: Fixed informational and regulatory signs mounted on posts or walls showing age guidelines and rules.

name: Storage Shed
description: Enclosed lockable structure within the playground boundary for storing loose equipment and supplies.

name: Supervision Seating Area
description: Designated paved or decked zone with built-in benches or seating for adult supervision of children.

name: Softfall Surfacing Installation
description: On-site pouring, troweling, or laying of impact-attenuating rubber surfacing over the prepared base.

name: Play Equipment Anchoring
description: Bolt-down installation and concrete encasement of play structure posts and footings into foundations.

name: Safety Zone Marking
description: Layout and marking of required fall zones and clearance areas around play equipment on the finished surface.

name: Fence and Gate Erection
description: Installation of perimeter fence posts, panels, and self-closing gates around the playground boundary.

name: Animal Enclosure
description: A confined area within a building designed to house animals, such as kennels, cages, pens, or stalls.

name: Animal Containment System
description: Fixed barriers, gates, fences, glass partitions, or mesh walls that prevent animal movement beyond designated zones.

name: Animal Habitat Fixtures
description: Building-integrated elements like fixed feeding troughs, watering stations, nesting boxes, and resting platforms installed within animal spaces.

name: Animal Flooring
description: Specialized floor finishes or surface materials designed for animal occupancy, including slatted flooring, rubber matting, and drainage-compatible surfaces.

name: Animal Waste Management System
description: Fixed drainage, flushing, and waste collection infrastructure integrated into animal spaces to manage manure and soiled bedding.

name: Animal Space Ventilation
description: Dedicated HVAC or exhaust systems designed to maintain air quality and temperature for specific animal occupancy requirements.

name: Animal Door
description: Specialized building openings such as pet doors, stable doors, or sliding cage doors that control animal access between spaces.

name: Animal Enclosure Construction
description: On-site installation of fixed barriers, habitat fixtures, and specialized flooring within designated animal spaces.

name: Veterinary Treatment Area
description: A building space fitted with fixed examination tables, sinks, and medical-grade surfaces for animal health care.

name: Animal-Accessible Circulation
description: Corridors, ramps, and transition zones designed with appropriate dimensions and surfaces for animal movement between building areas.

name: Family Living Room
description: The primary shared interior space within the family unit for daily activities, lounging, and social interaction.

name: Family Kitchen
description: The dedicated food preparation and cooking area serving the family household.

name: Family Dining Area
description: The interior space set aside for the family to eat meals together.

name: Family Bedroom
description: A private sleeping room for one or more family members within the dwelling.

name: Family Bathroom
description: A room containing sanitary fixtures such as toilet, sink, and shower/bath for family use.

name: Family Hallway/Corridor
description: An interior circulation space connecting the various family rooms within the dwelling.

name: Family Storage Room
description: A dedicated enclosed space for storing family belongings, equipment, and supplies.

name: Family Laundry Room
description: A room equipped with washing machine and dryer connections for cleaning family clothing and linens.

name: Family Study/Home Office
description: A quiet interior room used by family members for reading, paperwork, or remote work.

name: Family Utility/Mudroom
description: A transitional entry space with built-in storage for outerwear and footwear used by the family.

name: Family Toilet
description: A small room containing only a toilet and hand-washing sink for family use.

name: Family Walk-in Closet
description: An enclosed storage space accessible from a bedroom with built-in shelving and hanging rods for family clothing.

name: Family Pantry
description: A dedicated small storage room adjacent to the kitchen for dry food and provisions.

name: Interior Partition Walls (Family Zone)
description: The non-load-bearing wall assemblies that subdivide the family dwelling into individual rooms and spaces.

name: Family Room Interior Doors
description: The hinged or sliding door assemblies providing access and privacy between family rooms.

name: Family Room Windows
description: The glazed window assemblies in the exterior walls of family rooms providing daylight and ventilation.

name: Family Room Floor Finishes
description: The finished floor covering materials such as hardwood, tile, or carpet installed within family spaces.

name: Family Room Wall Finishes
description: The finished wall surface materials including paint, wallpaper, or tile applied to family room walls.

name: Family Room Ceiling Finishes
description: The finished ceiling surface material such as painted drywall or suspended ceiling in family spaces.

name: Family Lighting System
description: The permanently installed light fixtures, switches, and dimmers serving the family rooms.

name: Family Electrical System
description: The fixed wiring, sockets, and outlets providing power throughout the family dwelling spaces.

name: Family Plumbing System
description: The fixed hot and cold water supply and drainage piping serving family kitchen, bathroom, and laundry spaces.

name: Family HVAC System
description: The fixed heating, ventilation, and air conditioning ductwork and terminal units serving the family dwelling.

name: Built-in Family Seating
description: Permanently fixed bench seating, window seats, or banquettes installed in family living or dining spaces.

name: Built-in Family Shelving
description: Fixed wall-mounted or recessed shelving units installed in family rooms for books and display.

name: Family Kitchen Cabinetry (Fixed)
description: The permanently installed base and wall cabinets, countertops, and backsplash in the family kitchen.

name: Family Bathroom Vanity (Fixed)
description: The permanently installed sink cabinet and countertop unit in the family bathroom.

name: Family Window Coverings
description: Permanently mounted blinds, shades, or curtains tracks installed on family room windows.

name: Interior Family Room Construction
description: On-site erection and finishing of partition walls, ceilings, and built-in elements within the family dwelling.

name: Family Room Flooring Installation
description: On-site installation of finished floor materials in all family spaces.

name: Family Kitchen & Bathroom Fit-Out
description: On-site installation of fixed cabinetry, countertops, vanities, and sanitary fixtures in family wet areas.

name: Family MEP Rough-In
description: On-site installation of electrical wiring, plumbing pipes, and HVAC ductwork within the family dwelling zones.

name: Family Room Painting & Finishing
description: On-site application of paint, wallcoverings, and ceiling finishes to family room surfaces.

name: Family Door & Window Installation
description: On-site fitting of interior doors and window assemblies into the family room openings.

name: Load-Bearing Walls
description: Vertical structural wall assemblies that support roof and upper floor loads, commonly timber-framed or masonry.

name: External Wall Cladding
description: The outer finish applied to exterior walls for weather protection, such as brick veneer, timber siding, or render.

name: Damp-Proof Membrane
description: A polyethylene or bituminous layer installed below slabs and within walls to prevent rising damp.

name: Floor Structure
description: The suspended floor framing system, typically timber joists with particleboard or plywood decking.

name: Internal Partition Walls
description: Non-load-bearing wall assemblies that divide interior space into rooms, typically timber studs with plasterboard lining.

name: Plasterboard Lining
description: Gypsum-based board sheets fixed to wall and ceiling framing to form finished interior surfaces.

name: Window Assemblies
description: Pre-assembled glazed frames installed into wall openings for daylighting, ventilation, and view.

name: External Door
description: A weather-sealed door assembly at the main entrance and any patio or service entrances.

name: Internal Doors
description: Hinged or sliding door assemblies fitted within internal partition openings for room access and privacy.

name: Sanitary Fixtures
description: Fixed plumbing fixtures such as toilet, washbasin, shower tray, and bathtub within wet areas.

name: Kitchen Fittings
description: Fixed cabinetry, countertops, sink, and built-in appliances forming the kitchen workspace.

name: Built-In Wardrobes
description: Fixed storage cabinetry installed within bedroom alcoves or along walls for clothes and linen.

name: Floor Finishes
description: The final walking surface layer such as timber flooring, tiles, vinyl, or carpet applied over the floor structure.

name: Paint and Decorative Coatings
description: Water-based or solvent-based paints applied to walls, ceilings, and joinery for protection and appearance.

name: Rainwater Drainage
description: Gutters, downpipes, and underground drains that collect and convey rainwater away from the building.

name: Ground Slab Construction
description: On-site placement, finishing, and curing of the concrete ground floor slab.

name: Wall Framing Erection
description: On-site assembly and fixing of timber or steel stud wall frames to floor and roof structure.

name: Roof Truss Installation
description: On-site craning and fixing of prefabricated roof trusses to top plates of load-bearing walls.

name: Plasterboard Fixing and Finishing
description: On-site installation of plasterboard sheets to framing, followed by jointing, taping, and sanding.

name: Plumbing Rough-In
description: On-site installation of pipework within walls and floor cavities before lining and fixture connection.

name: Electrical Rough-In
description: On-site running of cables, mounting of junction boxes, and positioning of switch/socket outlets within wall cavities.

name: Staircase Construction
description: On-site fabrication or installation of stair stringers, treads, risers, handrails, and balustrades.

name: Flooring Installation
description: On-site laying, gluing, or nailing of finished floor covering materials to the prepared subfloor.

name: Sanitary Fixture Installation
description: On-site connection and fixing of toilets, basins, showers, and baths to plumbing rough-ins.

name: Kitchen Cabinet Installation
description: On-site assembly, leveling, and fixing of base and wall cabinets and benchtops to walls and floor.

name: HVAC Equipment Installation
description: On-site mounting and connection of the heat pump or furnace, ductwork, and diffusers to the building.

name: Lighting Fixture Installation
description: On-site fixing and wiring of ceiling-mounted, wall-mounted, and recessed light fittings.

name: Painting and Decorating
description: On-site application of primer, undercoat, and finish paints to prepared interior and exterior surfaces.

name: Septic Tank or Sewer Connection
description: The on-site wastewater treatment tank or connection pipe to municipal sewer for waste disposal.

name: Hot Water System
description: A fixed water heater, typically electric or gas storage tank or heat pump unit, installed within the building.

name: Structural Frame
description: The skeleton of columns, beams, and load-bearing walls that supports the building envelope.

name: Exterior Walls
description: Vertical enclosures forming the outer perimeter of the house, providing weather protection and thermal insulation.

name: Roof Assembly
description: The overhead covering system including structure, insulation, waterproofing, and finish that protects the interior.

name: Interior Partition Walls
description: Non-load-bearing walls that subdivide the interior into separate rooms.

name: Windows
description: Glazed openings in walls providing natural light, ventilation, and views to the outside.

name: Doors
description: Movable barriers for controlling access and passage between interior spaces or to the exterior.

name: Kitchen Cabinetry
description: Built-in cabinets, countertops, and backsplash forming the fixed kitchen workspace.

name: Bathroom Fixtures
description: Fixed sanitary ware including toilet, sink, shower, and bathtub with associated trim.

name: Ceiling Finishes
description: The exposed underside surface treatment of the floor above or roof structure.

name: Fireplace
description: A fixed masonry or factory-built hearth and chimney system for ambience and supplementary heating.

name: Garage
description: An attached or integrated covered space designed for vehicle parking and storage.

name: Front Porch
description: A covered exterior entrance platform providing transition between outdoors and the main entry.

name: Concrete Placement
description: On-site pouring, finishing, and curing of concrete for foundations, slabs, and structural elements.

name: Framing Erection
description: On-site assembly and erection of wood or steel structural framing members.

name: Roof Installation
description: On-site installation of roof deck, underlayment, flashing, and finished roofing material.

name: Interior Drywall Installation
description: On-site hanging, taping, and finishing of gypsum board on interior walls and ceilings.

name: Trim and Millwork Installation
description: On-site fitting and fastening of baseboards, casings, crown molding, and built-in cabinetry.

name: Final Fixture Installation
description: On-site mounting and connection of all plumbing fixtures, lighting fixtures, and switch/outlet covers.

name: Built-In Seating
description: Fixed benches or banquettes integrated into the architecture of dining or entry areas.

name: Rainwater Gutter System
description: Eavestroughs, downspouts, and drainage components channeling roof runoff away from the building.

name: Micro-Foundation & Floor Slab
description: A minimal concrete or screw-pile foundation with an insulated floor slab sized for a single-occupant footprint.

name: Single-Layer Exterior Wall System
description: A compact wall assembly (e.g. timber-frame or insulated concrete form) providing structure, insulation, and weathertightness for a one-person dwelling.

name: Compact Roof Assembly
description: A mono-pitch or flat insulated roof system that spans the small floor plan and sheds water.

name: Entry Door & Locking System
description: A single exterior door with weather seal, threshold, and a secure locking mechanism for private access.

name: Single-Pane or Double-Glazed Window Unit
description: One or more operable windows sized to provide daylight and natural ventilation for a single occupant.

name: Micro-Kitchen Block
description: A compact built-in kitchen unit comprising a sink, cooktop, small refrigerator, and base/wall cabinetry fixed to the structure.

name: Compact Bathroom Pod
description: A prefabricated or site-built wet room containing a toilet, shower, and hand basin within minimal floor area.

name: Multi-Functional Sleeping / Living Platform
description: A built-in raised platform or fold-down bed unit that doubles as seating or storage during the day.

name: Integrated Storage System
description: Fixed cabinetry, wardrobes, or shelving built into walls or alcoves to organize a single person's belongings.

name: Mechanical Ventilation with Heat Recovery (MVHR) Unit
description: A compact ducted ventilation system that supplies fresh air and extracts stale air while recovering heat for energy efficiency.

name: Point-of-Use Water Heater
description: A small electric or gas water heater located near the kitchen and bathroom to serve one occupant's hot water demand.

name: Single-Zone Heating / Cooling Split System
description: A mini-split heat pump or electric radiant system conditioning the single open-plan space for one person.

name: Electrical Distribution Board & Meter
description: A small consumer unit with circuit breakers and a utility meter serving the dwelling's electrical loads.

name: Lighting Fixture Set
description: Permanently wired ceiling and task lights illuminating the living, kitchen, and bathroom zones.

name: Plumbing Rough-In Network
description: A minimal layout of supply and waste pipes connecting the kitchen and bathroom to building services.

name: Rainwater Downpipe & Greywater Diversion
