name: Biergarten (variant)
description: Outdoor or semi-enclosed adjunct to a beer hall with fixed picnic tables, umbrellas, and external bar service.

name: Festhalle (variant)
description: Large temporary or semi-permanent beer hall structure for seasonal festivals with demountable seating and bar modules.

name: Guestroom Wing
description: A cluster of individual sleeping rooms arranged along corridors, forming the primary guest accommodation area of the inn.

name: Common Lounge
description: A shared interior sitting area with built-in seating, fireplace, or shelving for guest relaxation and socializing.

name: Breakfast Room / Dining Hall
description: A dedicated dining space with fixed tables and serving counters where complimentary meals are served to guests.

name: Commercial Kitchen
description: A fully equipped kitchen with built-in cooking, refrigeration, and ventilation systems for meal preparation.

name: Interior Corridor
description: A protected passageway connecting guestrooms to lobby, stairs, elevators, and other common spaces.

name: Guest Bathroom
description: A private wet room within each guestroom containing toilet, shower or bathtub, and vanity with built-in plumbing fixtures.

name: Guestroom Door & Lock System
description: A fire-rated guestroom door with electronic card lock or keypad access control integrated into the building security system.

name: Guestroom HVAC Terminal Unit
description: A fan-coil unit or through-wall PTAC installed in each guestroom providing individual heating and cooling control.

name: Built-in Wardrobe
description: A recessed or wall-mounted closet unit with hanging rod and shelving permanently installed in each guestroom.

name: Guestroom Window Assembly
description: An operable or fixed window unit with thermal glazing, frame, and integrated blinds installed in each guestroom.

name: Housekeeping Closet
description: A small storage room on each floor with a mop sink and shelving for custodial supplies and equipment.

name: Mechanical Room
description: A dedicated interior space housing boilers, chillers, pumps, air handlers, and the building's central HVAC equipment.

name: Electrical Room
description: A secured space containing the main electrical switchgear, panelboards, meters, and distribution equipment.

name: Sprinkler Riser Room
description: A fire-rated room housing the fire sprinkler system riser, valves, flow switches, and fire alarm control panel.

name: Elevator Machine Room
description: A room at the top of the elevator shaft housing the hoist machinery, controller, and governor for the passenger elevator.

name: Passenger Elevator
description: An electrically powered vertical transport system with a passenger cab traveling within a hoistway serving all floors.

name: Fire Alarm System
description: A network of smoke detectors, pull stations, horns, strobes, and control panels providing early warning of fire throughout the inn.

name: Sprinkler System
description: A wet-pipe or dry-pipe automatic fire suppression system with sprinkler heads distributed throughout all occupied spaces.

name: Plumbing Distribution System
description: A network of hot and cold water supply pipes, drainage pipes, vents, and traps serving all plumbing fixtures in the inn.

name: Electrical Distribution System
description: A complete wiring system from service entrance through branch circuits, receptacles, switches, and lighting fixtures.

name: Lighting Fixture Package
description: All permanently installed ceiling, wall, and accent light fixtures including sconces, chandeliers, and emergency egress lighting.

name: Guestroom Bed Base & Headboard
description: A built-in platform bed base and attached headboard fixed to the wall or floor within each guestroom.

name: Lobby Seating Group
description: Built-in or heavy fixed seating including sofas, armchairs, and side tables permanently arranged in the lobby seating area.

name: Exterior Signage
description: Illuminated building-mounted sign at the entrance or facade displaying the inn's name and vacancy information.

name: Canopy / Porte-Cochère
description: A roofed structure projecting over the driveway entrance providing weather protection for arriving and departing guests.

name: Parking Lot Pavement System
description: The asphalt or concrete pavement, base course, curb stops, and striping forming the guest and staff parking area.

name: Outdoor Patio / Terrace
description: An exterior paved area with built-in benches, planters, and possibly a fireplace for outdoor guest seating.

name: Exterior Wall Cladding
description: The finished exterior wall surface material — wood siding, stone veneer, stucco, or brick — enclosing the inn.

name: Foundation System
description: The concrete footings, foundation walls, and slab-on-grade that transfer building loads to the ground.

name: Install Guestroom Plumbing Fixtures
description: On-site installation of toilets, sinks, shower pans, tubs, and faucets within each guest bathroom.

name: Install Guestroom HVAC Units
description: On-site installation and commissioning of PTAC or fan-coil units in each guestroom window or wall sleeve.

name: Install Fire Sprinkler System
description: On-site hanging and connection of sprinkler piping, heads, and valves throughout all spaces of the inn.

name: Install Interior Doors & Hardware
description: On-site hanging of all interior guestroom, corridor, and service doors with hinges, locksets, and closers.

name: Install Built-in Millwork & Casework
description: On-site assembly and fixing of reception desk, wardrobes, shelving, and lobby built-in seating.

name: Commission Fire Alarm System
description: On-site testing, programming, and verification of all smoke detectors, pull stations, horns, and strobes.

name: Install Exterior Signage
description: On-site mounting and electrical connection of the building-mounted illuminated inn sign and directional signs.

name: Bus Shelter
description: The overhead protective canopy/roof structure that provides weather protection for waiting passengers at the bus stop.

name: Bus Stop Signage
description: The mounted sign displaying route numbers, stop name, and operator information for passenger wayfinding.

name: Real-Time Passenger Information Display
description: An electronic screen mounted at the stop showing live bus arrival times and service updates.

name: Bus Stop Bench
description: A fixed seating unit installed within the shelter for waiting passengers.

name: Ticket Vending Machine
description: A building-integrated electronic kiosk allowing passengers to purchase fare media at the stop.

name: Bus Stop Lighting
description: Fixed luminaires illuminating the shelter area for passenger safety and visibility during low-light hours.

name: Bus Stop Foundation
description: The concrete or paved base pad supporting the shelter structure and anchoring it to the ground.

name: Passenger Waiting Pad
description: The paved or hardscaped ground surface area designated for passenger queuing and boarding at the stop.

name: Bus Stop Pole
description: A vertical structural post supporting the shelter canopy and affixed signage.

name: Bus Stop Trash Receptacle

name: Windbreak Panel
description: A transparent or translucent side panel attached to the shelter frame to shield passengers from wind.

name: Shelter Installation
description: On-site assembly and erection of the bus stop shelter components including foundation preparation.

name: Signage Installation
description: Mounting and securing of the bus stop sign and any electronic display units to the shelter or pole.

name: Lighting Installation
description: Electrical rough-in, fixture mounting, and connection of shelter lighting to a power source.

name: Ticket Machine Installation
description: Securing and commissioning of the ticket vending machine including power and data connections.

name: Kerb and Channel

name: Food stand counter
description: The fixed serving counter or bar where food is prepared and served to customers, typically with a work surface and under-counter storage.

name: Display shelving

name: Built-in refrigeration unit

name: Hood and exhaust system

name: Grease interceptor
description: A plumbing device installed in the drainage line to capture fats, oils, and grease before they enter the building wastewater system.

name: Food preparation sink

name: Service counter top
description: The durable work surface material (e.g., stainless steel, solid surface, tile) installed on the food stand counter.

name: Food stand cabinetry

name: Cashier counter

name: Menu board structure
description: A fixed overhead or wall-mounted frame and backer for displaying the menu, either as a physical board or digital screen mount.

name: Backsplash panel
description: A non-porous wall finish installed behind the counter and cooking area to protect walls from grease and moisture.

name: Built-in warming equipment
description: Building-integrated food warming devices such as heat lamps, steam tables, or heated holding cabinets built into the counter.

name: Electrical receptacle strip

name: Install food stand cabinetry

name: Install countertop and backsplash

name: Install hood and exhaust ductwork

name: Install electrical and data service
description: On-site rough-in and trim-out of electrical receptacles, lighting, and data cabling for the food stand.

name: Sleeping Cubicle
description: A small enclosed or semi-enclosed private space designed for brief rest or sleep in public facilities such as airports or libraries.

name: Public Dormitory
description: A shared multi-occupancy sleeping room in hostels, shelters, or transient accommodation facilities.

name: Sleeping Platform
description: A raised flat surface built into the structure for reclining or sleeping, common in capsule hotels or pod-style layouts.

name: Privacy Partition

name: Integrated Sleep Pod

name: Public Mattress System
description: A fixed, building-attached cushioned surface designed for reclining, distinct from loose bedding.

name: Ventilation Grille for Sleep Cubicles
description: A louvered or screened air opening built into sleeping enclosures to supply fresh air and remove stale air.

name: Emergency Alarm Integration

name: Sleeping Area Floor Finish
description: A durable, cleanable flooring material laid in areas designated for public sleeping, such as carpet tile or rubber sheeting.

name: Install Privacy Enclosures
description: On-site assembly and fixing of partition walls, doors, or screens to form individual sleeping enclosures.

name: Install Fixed Mattress Base
description: On-site mounting of a built-in platform or frame that supports a mattress in a public sleeping space.

name: Commission Sleep Pod Ventilation
description: Testing and balancing of ducted air supply and exhaust within integrated sleep pods to ensure adequate airflow.

name: Day-Night Lighting Control
description: Dimming and zone-control lighting system installed above sleeping areas to allow variable illumination levels for rest and circulation.

name: Structural System
description: The load-bearing framework of the complex comprising foundations, columns, beams, slabs, and lateral load-resisting elements.

name: Main Building Core

name: Annex or Wing
description: A subordinate attached or adjacent building volume extending from the main building core.

name: Connector / Link Structure
description: An enclosed bridge, atrium, or corridor physically connecting two or more buildings within the complex.

name: Below-Grade Parking Garage
description: Underground or semi-underground parking levels serving the complex as part of the substructure.

name: Above-Grade Parking Structure
description: A freestanding or attached multi-level parking facility for vehicles within the complex.

name: Central Plant / Utility Building
description: A dedicated space housing main mechanical, electrical, and plumbing equipment serving the entire complex.

name: Loading Dock and Service Yard
description: A service-access area for delivery trucks, waste collection, and building maintenance vehicle staging.

name: Plaza / Courtyard
description: An outdoor pedestrian-grade hardscape space framed by the buildings of the complex.

name: Landscape and Sitework
description: The planted areas, irrigation, retaining walls, site drainage, paving, and site furnishings within the complex boundary.

name: Pedestrian Walkway System
description: Covered or open pathways, elevated walkways, and paving routes connecting buildings and plazas of the complex.

name: Plumbing and Sanitary System
description: The domestic water supply, hot water generation, sanitary drainage, venting, and stormwater piping network for the complex.

name: Fire Protection System
description: The fire-suppression sprinklers, standpipes, fire alarms, smoke control, and fire-rated compartmentation across the complex.

name: Vertical Transportation System
description: All elevators, escalators, dumbwaiters, and platform lifts providing vertical movement between levels of the complex.

name: Telecommunications and Security System
description: The structured cabling, data/IT rooms, access control, CCTV, and intercom infrastructure throughout the complex.

name: Lighting and Emergency Lighting System
description: The general, task, accent, and emergency egress lighting fixtures and controls installed across interior and exterior spaces.

name: Site Utilities Connection
description: The underground service laterals and manholes connecting the complex to municipal water, sewer, gas, and electrical grids.

name: Roof System
description: The roofing membrane, insulation, drainage, roof hatches, parapets, and rooftop equipment supports for all buildings in the complex.

name: Exterior Cladding and Finish System
description: The non-structural external wall finishes, rainscreen panels, curtain walls, and decorative facade elements of the complex.

name: Interior Finishes
description: The ceiling, wall, and floor finishes, painting, wallcoverings, and interior glazing across all occupiable spaces.

name: Tenant Fit-Out Spaces
description: Leasable or occupiable subdivided interior areas with their own partition, finish, and MEP distribution systems.

name: Common Corridor and Circulation Zone
description: Interior hallways, lobbies, elevator landings, and stairways providing shared access within and between buildings.

name: Waste and Recycling Rooms
description: Dedicated interior rooms for solid waste, recyclables, and organic refuse collection before off-site removal.

name: Sheltered Drop-Off Canopy
description: A roofed drive-under structure at building entrances for passenger and delivery vehicle loading/unloading.

name: Construction Activity: Excavation and Earthwork

name: Construction Activity: Foundation and Substructure Construction
description: On-site formwork, reinforcement, and concrete placement for footings, mat slabs, piles, and waterproofing of the complex substructure.

name: Construction Activity: Structural Framing Erection
description: On-site assembly, bolting, welding, or casting of steel, concrete, or timber structural members forming the complex framework.

name: Construction Activity: Building Envelope Installation
description: On-site installation of roofing, cladding, glazing, insulation, air/vapor barriers, and sealants to enclose the complex.

name: Construction Activity: MEP Rough-In and Installation
description: On-site routing, hanging, and connection of HVAC ductwork, piping, conduit, and equipment across all complex buildings.

name: Construction Activity: Interior Fit-Out and Finishing
description: On-site construction of partitions, ceiling grids, flooring, millwork, painting, and trim within each space of the complex.

name: Construction Activity: Elevator and Escalator Installation
description: On-site assembly, hoisting, and commissioning of elevator cars, rails, machines, and escalator trusses within the complex.

name: Construction Activity: Site Paving and Landscaping
description: On-site placement of asphalt, concrete pavers, curbs, and planting of site vegetation and hardscape features.

name: Construction Activity: Commissioning and Systems Integration Testing
description: On-site functional testing, balancing, and verification of all integrated building systems before occupancy.

name: Construction Activity: Fire Protection System Installation
description: On-site installation of sprinkler piping, fire alarm devices, standpipes, and suppression equipment throughout the complex.

name: Total Stories Count
description: The aggregate number of all stories in the building, from the lowest basement to the highest roof-accessible level.

name: Above-Grade Stories
description: The count of stories that are entirely or partially above the surrounding finished grade level.

name: Below-Grade Stories
description: The count of stories that are entirely below the surrounding finished grade level, including basements and sub-basements.

name: Partial / Mezzanine Stories
description: Intermediate floor levels that occupy less than the full building footprint, often governed by special code area allowances.

name: Typical Story Height
description: The vertical floor-to-floor dimension repeated across standard floors, which affects overall building massing and systems design.

name: Ground Floor / First Story
description: The lowest above-grade story that typically contains the main entrance and primary public zones.

name: Basement Stories
description: One or more fully or partially below-grade stories providing parking, mechanical rooms, storage, or service areas.

name: Roof / Penthouse Level
description: The topmost story that may contain mechanical penthouses, elevator overruns, or accessible roof terraces.

name: Structural Floor-To-Floor Height Determination
description: On-site measurement and verification of vertical distance between finished floor levels during framing and core construction.

name: Floor Level Marking and Layout
description: On-site surveying and marking of each story elevation on structural columns and cores to guide slab and framing installation.

name: Shielded Parking Barrier System
description: Blast-resistant barriers, bollards, or walls designed to absorb and deflect vehicle-borne explosive forces around the parking perimeter.

name: Hardened Parking Entry Portal
description: Reinforced entry gate system with vehicle inspection and access control points to screen vehicles before entering the shielded zone.

name: Blast Ventilation Dampers
description: Automated dampers integrated into parking ventilation ducts that close upon blast detection to prevent pressure wave propagation into occupied zones.

name: Shielded Parking Structural Slab
description: Reinforced concrete floor slab with increased thickness and standoff capacity designed to withstand blast loads from vehicle explosions.

name: Vehicle Blast Containment Walls
description: Perimeter walls engineered to contain blast fragments and redirect explosion pressure upwards away from adjacent building spaces.

name: Blast-Resistant Parking Entry Doors
description: Hardened pedestrian doors at parking-to-building transitions rated to withstand blast overpressure from vehicle explosions.

name: Hardened Parking Column Encasement
description: Steel or FRP wrapping around parking structural columns providing additional blast resistance and spall mitigation.

name: Shielded Parking Exhaust System
description: Specialized ventilation system with blast-rated ductwork and filtration to manage vehicle exhaust and post-blast contaminants.

name: Vehicle Access Control System
description: Integrated security system of license plate recognition, under-vehicle scanners, and barrier controls for authorized vehicle entry.

name: Shielded Parking Space Layout
description: Optimized parking stall arrangement maximizing standoff distance from building occupied zones and critical structural elements.

name: Parking Blast Glazing System
description: Laminated or polycarbonate glazing at parking facade openings designed to resist blast pressures without hazardous fragmentation.

name: Shielded Parking Fire Suppression System
description: Fire protection system with blast-resistant piping and valves to maintain operability during and after a blast event.

name: Parking Security Lighting
description: Impact-resistant and blast-hardened light fixtures ensuring continued illumination for surveillance and evacuation during emergencies.

name: Emergency Egress from Shielded Parking
description: Designated protected escape routes and exit pathways from the shielded parking area to a safe assembly point.

name: Install Blast Barriers and Bollards
description: On-site installation of perimeter blast barriers and anti-ram bollards including foundation anchoring and impact testing.

name: Install Hardened Entry Gates
description: Installation of blast-rated vehicle gates with automatic operators and interlock systems at parking entry and exit portals.

name: Install Blast Ventilation Dampers
description: Mounting and commissioning of automatic blast dampers within parking ventilation ductwork linked to the blast detection system.

name: Pour Shielded Parking Slab
description: Placement and curing of reinforced blast-resistant concrete slab including embedded reinforcement and expansion joint detailing.

name: Erect Blast Containment Walls
description: Construction of reinforced concrete or steel-plate perimeter containment walls around the shielded parking area.

name: Install Vehicle Access Control System
description: Installation and integration of LPR cameras, under-vehicle scanners, and barrier control panels at the parking security checkpoint.

name: Apply Column Blast Wrapping
description: On-site application of steel jacketing or FRP wrapping to parking columns for blast resistance and spall control.

name: Install Blast-Resistant Glazing
description: Fitting of laminated blast-resistant glazing panels into parking facade frames with structurally rated anchors and sealants.

name: Horizontal Circulation

name: Vertical Circulation
description: Spatial volumes enabling movement between different building levels, including stairwells, elevator shafts, escalator wells, and ramp runs.

name: Entrance Zones
description: Transitional spaces at building or zone entry points such as lobbies, foyers, vestibules, and airlocks that mediate between exterior and interior environments.

name: Egress Routes

name: Atria and Interior Streets

name: Corridor Partitioning
description: On-site construction of corridor wall assemblies, including framing, insulation, boarding, fire-rating treatments, and door frame installation along circulation paths.

name: Circulation Floor Finishing
description: On-site installation of floor coverings, slip-resistant treatments, floor hardeners, or raised access flooring specifically within circulation zones.

name: Staircase System
description: Prefabricated or site-assembled stair assemblies including structural flights, intermediate landings, balustrades, handrails, and nosings integrated into vertical circulation spaces.

name: Escalator and Moving Walk
description: Powered continuous vertical or inclined pedestrian transport system with step chains, handrails, balustrades, and drive mechanisms for high-volume circulation.

name: Railing and Guard System
description: Fixed handrails, guardrails, balustrades, and protective barriers installed along stairs, ramps, elevated walkways, and open edges to provide fall protection and guidance.

name: Wayfinding and Signage Elements
description: Building-integrated directional signage, room numbering systems, directory boards, tactile paving, and visual indicators fixed to circulation surfaces to guide occupant movement.

name: Building Structure
description: The load-bearing framework of the main building including columns, beams, and load-bearing walls.

name: Interior Spaces

name: Built-in Furniture & Equipment

name: Exterior Cladding
description: The weather-resistant outer layer of the main building's walls such as brick, curtain wall, or siding.

name: Window & Glazing System
description: Operable and fixed windows, curtain walls, skylights, and glazed assemblies in the main building envelope.

name: Structural Slab
description: Floor slabs and roof slabs that form horizontal structural diaphragms in the main building.

name: Partition Walls

name: Ceiling System
description: Suspended or directly applied ceiling assemblies including tiles, grids, and integrated services in the main building.

name: Structural Columns
description: Vertical compression members that support beams and slabs within the main building's frame.

name: Structural Beams

name: HVAC Ductwork Installation
description: On-site assembly and mounting of supply, return, and exhaust ductwork throughout the main building.

name: Plumbing Pipe Installation
description: On-site installation of water supply, waste, and vent piping within the main building walls and shafts.

name: Electrical Wiring & Termination
description: On-site pulling, routing, and terminating of electrical cables and conduits in the main building.

name: Floor Finishing
description: On-site installation of floor coverings such as tile, carpet, wood, or polished concrete in the main building.

name: Wall Finishing
description: On-site application of plaster, drywall, paint, or wall coverings to interior surfaces of the main building.

name: Ceiling Installation
description: On-site erection and finishing of suspended or direct-applied ceiling systems in the main building.

name: Built-in Furniture Assembly
description: On-site construction and fitting of reception desks, benches, cabinetry, and auditorium seating in the main building.

name: Door & Hardware Installation
description: On-site hanging of doors, fitting of frames, and mounting of locks and hardware in the main building.

name: Window & Glazing Installation
description: On-site setting of window frames, glazing panels, and curtain wall units into the main building envelope.

name: Exterior Cladding Installation
description: On-site application of brick, stone, metal panels, or siding to the main building's exterior walls.

name: Pedestrian Street Pavement

name: Pedestrian Street Deck/Base Slab
description: The structural base slab or deck that supports the pedestrian street and any overlying finishes.

name: Pedestrian Street Canopy/Awning

name: Pedestrian Street Hardscape Planters
description: Built-in raised beds or modular planters integrated into the pedestrian street for landscaping.

name: Pedestrian Street Retaining Walls

name: Pedestrian Street Signage System
description: Fixed directional, informational, and wayfinding signs installed along the pedestrian street.

name: Pedestrian Street Bollards

name: Pedestrian Street Furniture Installation
description: On-site placement and securing of fixed street furniture elements into the pedestrian street pavement or deck.

description: On-site laying and finishing of paving units or poured surfacing material on the pedestrian street.

name: Pedestrian Street Lighting Installation
description: On-site mounting, wiring, and commissioning of fixed light fixtures along the pedestrian street.

name: Pedestrian Street Drainage Installation
description: On-site installation of drainage channels, gratings, and connection to stormwater systems for the pedestrian street.

name: Pedestrian Street Signage Installation
description: On-site mounting and anchoring of fixed signs and wayfinding elements along the pedestrian street.

name: Pedestrian Street Bollard Installation
description: On-site anchoring and setting of fixed bollards into the pedestrian street substrate.

name: Covered Arcade

name: Pedestrian Plaza
