name: Entry Door
description: The primary hinged or sliding door panel that provides the main access point through an entrance.

name: Entrance Lobby
description: The transitional interior space immediately inside the entrance that mediates between outdoors and the main building interior.

name: Entrance Canopy
description: A roof-like overhead shelter projecting over the entrance to protect arriving visitors from weather.

name: Door Hardware Set
description: The collection of handles, locks, hinges, closers, and panic devices fitted to an entrance door.

name: Entrance Mat/Grid
description: A recessed floor-mounted scraper or mat system at the doorway that captures dirt and moisture from footwear.

name: Entrance Signage
description: Fixed building-mounted signs identifying the entrance, building name, or address at the point of entry.

name: Weather Stripping
description: The compressible sealant strips fitted around the door perimeter to block drafts, water, and noise.

name: Hardware Fitting
description: On-site installation and adjustment of locks, handles, hinges, and closers onto the entrance door.

name: Intercom/Entry Phone
description: A wall-mounted communication unit at the entrance that enables visitors to call building occupants for access.

name: Entrance Threshold
description: The bottom transition strip or saddle spanning the floor between the door frame legs at ground level.

name: Paving Surface
description: The load-bearing paved area of the parking lot, typically asphalt, concrete, or permeable pavers, that vehicles drive and park on.

name: Parking Stall Striping
description: Painted markings on the pavement that delineate individual parking spaces, accessibility zones, and directional arrows.

name: Wheel Stop
description: A precast concrete or rubber barrier installed at the front of each parking stall to prevent vehicle overhang.

name: Curb and Gutter
description: Concrete or stone edge restraints that define the parking lot perimeter and channel stormwater runoff toward drains.

name: Parking Lot Lighting
description: Pole-mounted or building-mounted light fixtures that provide illumination for safety and security during nighttime use.

name: Parking Lot Signage
description: Fixed signs indicating entrance/exit, directional flow, fee payment, accessibility parking, and regulatory information.

name: Entry and Exit Driveways
description: The paved vehicle access points connecting the parking lot to adjacent public roads or site circulation routes.

name: Parking Lot Landscaping
description: Planted islands, bioswales, shade trees, and ornamental vegetation integrated into or surrounding the parking lot for aesthetics and stormwater management.

name: Parking Barrier or Gate
description: Mechanical arm gates, bollards, or tire spikes installed at entry/exit points to control vehicle access and collect fees.

name: Pay Station / Ticket Kiosk
description: Fixed electronic kiosk or meter for fee payment and ticket dispensing, typically mounted on a pedestal or small shelter.

name: Electric Vehicle Charging Station
description: Building-integrated EV charging unit with pedestal mount and conduit connection to the electrical supply.

name: Parking Lot Bicycle Rack
description: Fixed, anchored metal rack designed for securing bicycles, installed within or adjacent to the parking lot.

name: Asphalt Paving Installation
description: On-site placement and compaction of hot-mix asphalt layers over a prepared sub-base to form the driving surface.

name: Concrete Curb and Gutter Installation
description: Forming, pouring, and finishing concrete curbs and gutters along the perimeter of the parking lot.

name: Parking Lot Striping and Marking
description: Applying traffic-grade paint or thermoplastic markings to delineate parking stalls, aisles, directional arrows, and accessible spaces.

name: Parking Lot Lighting Installation
description: Setting concrete foundations, mounting poles, running conduit, and connecting luminaires to the building electrical system.

name: Parking Lot Pavement Marking Removal
description: Grinding or hydro-blasting existing pavement markings to prepare for restriping during reconfiguration or resurfacing.

name: Accessible Parking Space Compliance
description: Designated accessible stalls with adjacent access aisles and signage meeting ADA or local building code requirements.

name: Parking Lot Base and Sub-base
description: The engineered aggregate layers beneath the pavement surface that provide drainage and load distribution.

name: Cut and Fill
description: Earthmoving operation to cut high areas and fill low areas on the building site to achieve desired finished grades.

name: Topsoil Stripping and Stockpiling
description: Removal and storage of topsoil from the building footprint and disturbed areas for later reuse in landscaping.

name: Site Drainage and Grading
description: Engineered slopes, swales, and channels that direct surface water away from the building and manage stormwater runoff on the site.

name: Erosion and Sediment Control
description: Temporary or permanent measures such as silt fences, sediment basins, and erosion control blankets that prevent soil loss during and after construction.

name: Subgrade Preparation and Compaction
description: Mechanical compaction and stabilization of the exposed subgrade soil to meet bearing capacity requirements for foundations and slabs.

name: Imported Fill Material
description: Engineered granular or cohesive soil brought to the site to raise grades or replace unsuitable native soils.

name: Geotextile and Geogrid
description: Synthetic fabric or grid layers placed between soil lifts to reinforce, separate, or filter soil strata in repaired or built-up areas.

name: Soil Amendment and Stabilization
description: On-site treatment of native or fill soils with lime, cement, or other additives to improve strength and reduce shrink-swell potential.

name: Backfill and Compaction Around Foundations
description: Placement and densification of soil against foundation walls and footings after they are constructed.

name: Site Restoration Seeding and Mulching
description: Application of seed, straw mulch, and hydromulch to re-establish vegetation on disturbed areas following rough grading.

name: South-Facing Terrace
description: An outdoor paved or decked area on the south side of a building, designed for occupant use and often accessed via glazed doors.

name: South-Facing Balcony
description: A projecting outdoor platform on a south elevation, typically with railing, providing outdoor access at upper floors.

name: South-Facing Roof Terrace
description: A usable outdoor space located on a south-facing portion of a flat or low-slope roof, often with parapet walls.

name: South-Facing Courtyard
description: An open-air area enclosed by building wings or walls on the south side, functioning as a private or semi-private outdoor room.

name: South-Facing Veranda
description: A roofed, open-sided gallery or porch along the south facade, providing sheltered outdoor circulation and seating.

name: South-Facing Sun Shade Structure
description: Fixed external louvres, brise-soleil, or overhangs attached to the south facade to control solar gain while preserving the outdoor space.

name: South-Facing Glazed Screen
description: A full-height glazed partition or sliding door assembly separating the south-facing outdoor space from the interior.

name: South-Facing Decking System
description: The raised timber, composite, or tile floor surface installed within a south-facing outdoor space to provide a level walking surface.

name: South-Facing Railing System
description: Guardrails and handrails installed at the edge of a south-facing balcony, terrace, or raised deck for safety.

name: South-Facing Outdoor Lighting
description: Weatherproof light fixtures mounted within the south-facing outdoor space for nighttime usability and safety.

name: South-Facing Outdoor Drainage System
description: Surface drains, channels, and downpipes that collect and direct rainwater away from the south-facing outdoor area.

name: Construction of South-Facing Terrace
description: On-site assembly of substructure, waterproofing, and deck finish for a south-facing terrace including drainage integration.

name: Installation of South-Facing Balcony
description: On-site erection or attachment of balcony structure, waterproof membrane, and railing to the south building facade.

name: Installation of Sun Shading Devices
description: On-site fixing of external louvres, overhangs, or brise-soleil to the south facade to regulate solar exposure.

name: Roof Terrace
description: A usable outdoor flat area on a building's roof, designed for occupant access with appropriate waterproofing, drainage, and safety railings.

name: Loggia
description: A roofed outdoor gallery or corridor recessed into the building mass, open on at least one side with a colonnade or arcade.

name: Patio
description: A ground-level paved outdoor area directly adjoining a building, often used for dining or seating and bounded by walls, hedges, or the building itself.

name: Deck
description: An elevated wooden or composite platform attached to a building, providing a level outdoor surface for occupant use above grade.

name: Outdoor Seating Area
description: A designated exterior zone furnished with built-in or fixed benches, chairs, or tables for rest and social activity.

name: Garden Terrace
description: A stepped or sloped outdoor space integrated into a building's landscape design, often incorporating planted beds and retaining walls.

name: Veranda
description: A roofed, open-galleried outdoor space along the front or side of a building, typically with a floor elevated slightly above ground level.

name: Outdoor Walkway
description: An exterior elevated or ground-level pedestrian path attached to a building, connecting different wings or entries, often with a canopy or railing.

name: Green Roof
description: A layered roof system designed to support vegetation, including waterproofing, drainage, growing medium, and plantings, providing stormwater management and insulation.

name: Rain Screen Cladding
description: An exterior wall system with a ventilated cavity that allows pressure equalization and drainage, managing rainwater while ventilating the outer surface.

name: Outdoor Drainage System
description: A network of gutters, downpipes, trench drains, and permeable surfaces that collects and conveys rainwater away from outdoor spaces to prevent ponding.

name: Outdoor Lighting Fixtures
description: Weatherproof electric luminaires mounted on building façades, walls, or posts to illuminate exterior spaces for safety and ambiance.

name: Railing and Balustrade
description: A guardrail system of posts, handrails, and infill panels mounted at edges of elevated outdoor spaces to prevent falls and guide movement.

name: Outdoor Paving
description: Hard-wearing, slip-resistant surface material such as concrete pavers, stone tiles, or bricks laid on a prepared base for exterior floors.

name: Trellis and Pergola Structure
description: An open-frame overhead structure attached to or near a building, supporting climbing plants or providing partial shade to an outdoor space.

name: Built-in Bench
description: A fixed seating unit integrated into the building structure or landscape, constructed from masonry, concrete, or weather-resistant timber.

name: Fixed Canopy
description: A permanent roof-like projection over an entrance, window, or walkway, providing shelter from rain and sun.

name: Outdoor Deck Construction
description: Installation of elevated platform framing, decking boards, and fasteners on site to create a usable wooden or composite outdoor floor.

name: Outdoor Paving Installation
description: On-site laying of pavers or stone slabs over a prepared sub-base and sand or mortar bed to form a durable exterior surface.

name: Outdoor Lighting Installation
description: Mounting and wiring of weatherproof luminaires, conduit, and junction boxes on exterior walls or poles for nighttime illumination.

name: Pergola Erection
description: On-site assembly and anchoring of vertical posts, beams, and cross-members to form a freestanding or attached shade structure above an outdoor space.

name: Light-Transmitting Roof Structure
description: The primary framed roof assembly incorporating glazing or translucent panels to admit natural daylight into the space below.

name: Structural Wing Canopy
description: The cantilevered or winged overhang elements extending beyond the main building line, often housing integrated lighting or shading.

name: Integrated Daylight Control Louvers
description: Adjustable or fixed louver assemblies within the wing structure that modulate light penetration and solar heat gain.

name: Light Shelf Assembly
description: Horizontal reflective surfaces mounted within the wing space to redirect daylight deeper into adjacent interior areas.

name: Glazed Curtain Wall System
description: The non-load-bearing vertical glass facade system forming the perimeter enclosure where the wing meets the building envelope.

name: Etched or Fritted Glass Panels
description: Specialized glass units with surface treatments that diffuse, direct, or filter incoming light for visual comfort.

name: Automated Shading Blind System
description: Motorized roller blinds or louvered shades integrated into the wing structure for dynamic light and glare control.

name: Wings of Light Steel Support Framework
description: The primary steel or aluminum structural framing that shapes and supports the wing geometry and glazing.

name: Rainwater Drainage Channel
description: Concealed gutter and downpipe system routed within the wing profile to manage runoff from the glazed surfaces.

name: Perimeter Edge Sealing Gasket
description: Continuous EPDM or silicone gaskets that weather-seal the interfaces between glass panels and the wing frame.

name: Install Light-Transmitting Wing Roof
description: On-site erection and fixing of the glazed roof panels onto the prepared wing steelwork, including sealing and waterproofing.

name: Install Integrated Daylight Louvers
description: Field installation and alignment of fixed or motorized louver assemblies within the wing apertures.

name: Commission Automated Shading System
description: On-site programming, calibration, and testing of motorized blind controls linked to building management system.

name: Install Light Shelf Assemblies
description: Mounting and leveling of reflective light shelves onto the wing structure at designated daylight-redirecting positions.

name: Apply Weatherproof Edge Sealing
description: Field application of gaskets, sealants, and flashings at all wing perimeter joints to achieve airtightness and watertightness.

name: Skybridge
description: An enclosed or open elevated walkway connecting two separate buildings, typically at upper floors.

name: Underground Tunnel
description: A below-grade passageway linking separate buildings for pedestrian or service access.

name: Atrium Link
description: A shared glazed or enclosed atrium that physically and visually connects adjacent buildings.

name: Expansion Joint
description: A structural separation device between adjacent building blocks that accommodates thermal and seismic movement.

name: Shared Service Core
description: A communal vertical shaft or core containing stairs, elevators, and MEP risers serving multiple connected buildings.

name: Interconnecting Corridor
description: A ground-level or multi-level enclosed passageway providing weather-protected circulation between buildings.

name: Shared Utility Trench
description: A below-grade raceway or tunnel carrying shared electrical, data, plumbing, or HVAC services between buildings.

name: Joint Foundation/Mat Slab
description: A continuous foundation element that supports two or more adjacent building structures as a single structural system.

name: Common Plant Room
description: A centralized mechanical or electrical room serving multiple connected buildings with shared heating, cooling, or power systems.

name: Structural Tie Beam
description: A horizontal structural member that links adjacent building frames to resist lateral loads and improve overall stability.

name: Install Expansion Joints
description: On-site installation of prefabricated expansion joint assemblies between connected building blocks.

name: Construct Underground Tunnel
description: On-site excavation, waterproofing, and construction of a below-grade link between buildings.

name: Erect Skybridge Structure
description: On-site erection and bolting/welding of steel or concrete skybridge segments between building structures.

name: Connect Shared MEP Services
description: On-site installation and interconnection of ducts, pipes, and cables between buildings via shared service trenches or cores.

name: Narrow Rectangular Floor Plate
description: The elongated, narrow plan layout that defines the Long Thin House's primary spatial configuration, typically with a high aspect ratio.

name: Linear Structural Frame
description: The load-bearing framework (e.g., bearing walls or post-and-beam) oriented along the long axis to support the narrow span.

name: End Wall Glazing
description: Large glazed assemblies at one or both short ends of the house to introduce light and views along the length.

name: Continuous Ridge Beam
description: A long horizontal beam running the full length of the roof peak, supporting the roof structure over the narrow span.

name: Linear Roof Form
description: A roof shape (e.g., shed, gable, or butterfly) elongated to match the narrow plan, often with a single continuous slope or ridge.

name: Long Window Wall
description: A continuous or near-continuous strip of windows along one or both long side elevations for daylighting and passive solar gain.

name: Slot Courtyard
description: A narrow, linear outdoor space cut into the plan to bring light and air into the deep interior of the thin house.

name: Linear Circulation Spine
description: A long corridor or path running the full length of the house, connecting rooms arranged sequentially along the axis.

name: Thermally Massive Slab-on-Grade
description: A continuous concrete floor slab used as a thermal mass to absorb and store solar heat from the large glazed areas.

name: Rain Screen Cladding System
description: A ventilated exterior cladding assembly applied to the long elevations to manage moisture and provide a uniform finish.

name: Sliding Partition Wall
description: A movable wall system running on tracks along the length of the house to allow flexible room configurations.

name: Continuous Soffit/Canopy
description: A long projecting eave or canopy extending the full facade length to provide shading and weather protection to the glazed walls.

name: Linear Foundation Trench
description: A narrow, continuous strip footing or trench foundation following the full length of the building footprint.

name: Install Long Span Joists
description: On-site installation of prefabricated floor or roof joists spanning the short dimension across the narrow plan.

name: Pour Continuous Slab
description: On-site concrete placement and finishing of the elongated slab-on-grade floor for the thin house.

name: Erect Sequential Bearing Walls
description: On-site construction of interior bearing walls spaced at intervals along the length to support the long roof and floor spans.

name: Install Continuous Glazing Track
description: On-site mounting of the track/channel system that holds the long run of window wall or curtain wall assemblies.

name: Commission Linear HVAC Run
description: On-site testing and balancing of the elongated duct runs or radiant loops serving the narrow, multi-zone layout.

name: Entrance Door
description: The main operable door leaf or panel providing primary access through the entrance opening.

name: Entrance Frame
description: The structural perimeter framing that supports and surrounds the entrance door assembly.

name: Entrance Glazing
description: Fixed or operable glass panels flanking or above the door for visibility and daylight.

name: Entrance Matting System
description: Built-in recessed walk-off mat or grid at the threshold to capture dirt and moisture.

name: Entrance Locking Hardware
description: Lockset, panic bar, or electronic access control hardware securing the entrance.

name: Entrance Weatherstripping
description: Sealing strips around the door perimeter to prevent air and water infiltration.

name: Entrance Security System
description: Integrated security components including intercom, camera, card reader, and door release.

name: Entrance Lighting
description: Fixed luminaires above or beside the entrance providing task and safety illumination.

name: Entrance Ramp
description: Sloped accessway adjacent to or replacing steps for wheelchair and accessibility compliance.

name: Entrance Steps
description: Built masonry or concrete stairway from grade to the entrance landing.

name: Entrance Landing
description: The immediate interior floor area inside the entrance serving as a transition zone.

name: Vestibule
description: An enclosed intermediate space between the outer entrance and the main interior lobby.

name: Entrance Handrail
description: Fixed railing installed along steps or ramp for user support and code compliance.

name: Entrance Bollard
description: Fixed short post installed adjacent to the entrance for vehicle impact protection.

name: Install Entrance Door and Frame
description: On-site setting and fixing of the door leaf, frame, hinges, and associated hardware into the prepared opening.

name: Install Automatic Door Operator
description: On-site mounting, alignment, and connection of the powered door actuation mechanism.

name: Install Canopy
description: On-site erection and waterproofing of the overhead shelter structure above the entrance.

name: Install Matting System
description: On-site installation of recessed walk-off grating or mat tray in the floor at the entrance.

name: Commission Entrance Security
description: On-site testing, programming, and integration of access control and surveillance devices.

name: Garden Enclosure Wall
description: The structural or screen walls that define the perimeter of the half-hidden garden and separate it from adjacent spaces.

name: Garden Canopy
description: A partially open roof or trellis structure that provides filtered light and partial concealment from above.

name: Garden Floor Pavement
description: The hardscape paving or decking surface installed as the finished floor of the garden space.

name: Planting Bed
description: A built-in raised or recessed planter structure that contains soil and vegetation within the garden.

name: Integrated Seat Wall
description: A built-in bench or seating edge incorporated into the garden enclosure or planter walls.

name: Fixed Garden Lighting
description: Building-integrated luminaires installed within the garden for ambient or accent illumination.

name: Garden Drainage System
description: The subsurface drainage network that collects and directs rainwater away from the garden floor.

name: Garden Irrigation Supply
description: The fixed piping and connection points for delivering water to planting beds within the garden.

name: Interior Garden Window Wall
description: A glazed partition or window assembly that visually connects the half-hidden garden to an adjacent interior space.

name: Garden Entry Door Assembly
description: The door or sliding panel system providing access from the building interior into the garden.

name: Integrated Trellis Structure
description: A fixed framework of beams or cables attached to the building to support climbing plants overhead.

name: Garden Soils and Growing Medium
description: The engineered soil mix, drainage aggregate, and mulch laid within planting beds to support vegetation.

name: Garden Construction - Earthwork
description: On-site excavation, grading, and soil preparation to form the garden floor and planting bed volumes.

name: Garden Construction - Planting Installation
description: On-site placement of trees, shrubs, and groundcover into prepared planting beds within the garden.

name: Garden Construction - Hardscape Finishing
description: Installation of paving, decking, seat walls, and other fixed hardscape elements in the garden.

name: Weather Stripping & Seals
description: Perimeter gaskets, drop seals, and brush strips that prevent air and water infiltration around the door opening.

name: Entry Canopy / Porte-Cochère
description: A projecting roof or canopy structure over the entrance that shelters users and doors from rain and snow.

name: Entry Floor Grille / Mat
description: Recessed scraper and absorbent mats or grilles at the door interior side that capture dirt and moisture from footwear.

name: Entry Stoop / Landing
description: The exterior paved platform immediately outside the entrance door providing a level transition surface at the threshold.

name: Ramp at Entry
description: A sloped accessible pathway adjacent to or replacing steps that provides barrier-free entry for wheelchairs and strollers.

name: Entry Stairs
description: A series of exterior or interior steps at the entrance threshold providing vertical circulation between grade and the door level.

name: Accessible Door Operator
description: A power-assist mechanism or push-button actuator that automatically opens the entry door for accessibility compliance.

name: Door Bell / Intercom / Keypad
description: Wall-mounted visitor notification and access control devices installed at the entry for security and communication.

name: Entry Lighting
description: Fixed light fixtures (wall sconces, ceiling lights, step lights) illuminating the entry area for safety, wayfinding, and visibility.

name: Handrail / Guardrail at Entry
description: Safety railings installed along entry stairs and ramps to provide user support and fall protection per building code.

name: Threshold Plate
description: The metal or rubber transition strip spanning the width of the door opening at the floor to bridge the gap between interior and exterior finishes.

name: Install Entrance Door Assembly
description: On-site installation of the door frame, hanging of door leaf, and attachment of hardware including hinges, lockset, and closer.

name: Install Weather Seals & Threshold
description: Field application of perimeter gaskets, drop seals, and threshold plate to achieve airtightness and water resistance at the entry.

name: Install Entry Floor Grilles
description: Recessing and securing dirt-trapping mats or grilles into the floor slab at the interior side of the entrance.

name: Install Entry Canopy
description: Erection of the overhead canopy structure including support columns, roof deck, flashing, and integration with the main building wall.

name: Install Access Control Devices
description: Mounting and wiring of intercom, keypad, card reader, or doorbell units at the entry for security and visitor access.

name: Install Entry Lighting Fixtures
description: Mounting and electrical connection of fixed light fixtures at the entrance including wall sconces, ceiling fixtures, and step lights.

name: Form & Pour Entry Landing / Stoop
description: Construction of the exterior concrete landing or stoop including formwork, reinforcement, pouring, finishing, and curing.

name: Build Entry Ramp
description: Construction of an accessible ramp including base preparation, forming, pouring or unit paver installation, and surface texturing.

name: Build Entry Stairs
description: Construction of exterior or interior steps at the entrance including tread and riser forming, material placement, and finish application.

name: Install Handrails & Guardrails
description: Mounting of safety railings along entry stairs and ramps including brackets, posts, top rails, and code-required balusters.

name: Install Vestibule Partition
description: Framing, glazing, and finishing of interior partition walls that enclose the vestibule space between outer and inner doors.

name: Car Parking Space
description: A designated area within a building or structure for parking a single vehicle, including markings and clearances.

name: Parking Guidance System
description: A sensor-based system that detects space occupancy and displays availability to drivers via signage.

name: Parking Floor Coating
description: A durable surface treatment applied to parking area floors to resist wear from vehicles and provide skid resistance.

name: Vehicle Restraint System
description: Fixed barriers or bollards installed along edges of parking decks to prevent vehicles from overrunning the edge.

name: Parking Ventilation System
description: Mechanical fans and ductwork that exhaust vehicle exhaust fumes and maintain air quality in enclosed parking garages.

name: Roller Door / Overhead Door
description: A motorized or manual door system that opens vertically to provide vehicle entry and exit from the parking area.

name: Pedestrian Walkway in Parking
description: A marked or separated path within a parking facility designated for safe pedestrian movement between vehicles and exits.

name: Ticket Kiosk / Pay Station
description: A fixed booth or machine installed at parking entrances or exits for issuing tickets or processing payments.

name: Car Park Drainage System
description: Trench drains, floor drains, and piping installed to collect and remove water and wash-down fluids from parking surfaces.

name: Parking Space Marking
description: Painted or applied lines and symbols that define individual parking spaces, directional arrows, and accessibility zones.

name: Plaza
description: A paved public outdoor space adjacent to or within a building complex, used for pedestrian circulation and informal assembly.

name: Sky Garden
description: An elevated open or semi-open planted space within or atop a building, providing amenity and biophilic relief at height.

name: Inner Garden
description: A planted open space contained within a building's footprint, accessible from surrounding rooms and often visible through glazing.

name: Covered Walkway
description: A linear open or semi-enclosed passage providing weather-protected pedestrian movement between building wings or external areas.

name: Lightwell
description: A vertical open shaft within a building volume that brings daylight and natural ventilation to adjacent interior spaces.

name: Arcade
description: A covered pedestrian passage defined by a sequence of arches or columns, typically at ground level along a building facade.

name: Courtyard Enclosure Walls
description: Freestanding or building-adjacent perimeter walls that define the courtyard boundary and provide visual and acoustic separation.

name: Courtyard Floor/Paving
description: The ground surface finish of the courtyard, including stone, concrete, brick, tile, or wood decking that provides a durable walking surface.

name: Courtyard Drainage System
description: Subsurface and surface drainage components including drains, channels, and grading that manage rainwater and run-off within the courtyard.

name: Courtyard Planting Beds
description: Built-in fixed planters, raised beds, and soil retention structures integrated into the courtyard floor or walls for vegetation.

name: Courtyard Irrigation System
description: Piped water distribution network, drip lines, and emitters installed within the courtyard to irrigate planted areas.

name: Courtyard Lighting
description: Fixed exterior lighting fixtures mounted on walls, ground, or within planting beds to illuminate the courtyard for evening use.

name: Courtyard Water Feature
description: Built-in fixed fountain, reflecting pool, or water wall including basin, pump, and recirculation plumbing integrated into the courtyard.

name: Courtyard Canopy/Shade Structure
description: Fixed overhead structure such as a pergola, trellis, tensile canopy, or louvered roof providing partial or full shade within the courtyard.

name: Courtyard Seating Elements
description: Built-in fixed benches, seat walls, or integrated seating platforms constructed as permanent parts of the courtyard fabric.

name: Courtyard Power and Data Outlets
description: Weatherproof electrical receptacles and data ports installed in courtyard walls or floors to support temporary equipment and events.

name: Courtyard Access Doors/Gates
description: Fixed doors, gates, or pivoting panels in the courtyard enclosure that control pedestrian access and egress.

name: Courtyard Interior Partition Walls (if enclosed)
description: Glazed or solid partition walls separating the courtyard from adjacent interior spaces, including sliding or folding door systems.

name: Courtyard Construction
description: On-site excavation, grading, paving, wall erection, and installation of courtyard systems.

name: Courtyard System Installation
description: On-site assembly and commissioning of courtyard drainage, irrigation, lighting, and water feature infrastructure.

name: Stepped Roof Plane
description: A roof surface configured as a series of descending horizontal or sloped planes arranged in a stepped formation.

name: Roof Step Structure
description: The structural framing elements (beams, rafters, trusses) that support each tier of the cascading roof.

name: Step Vertical Risers
description: The vertical or near-vertical panel or wall sections connecting each roof step level.

name: Cascade Water Diversion System
description: A rainwater management system including stepped gutters, downspouts, and splash pads tailored to the tiered roof layout.

name: Stepped Roof Decking
description: The sheathing or decking material applied across each stepped roof plane to form the water-shedding surface.

name: Roof Step Flashing
description: Metal or membrane flashing installed at the junctions between roof steps and vertical risers to prevent water ingress.

name: Cascade Roof Drainage Scupper
description: An opening or scupper at the low point of each roof step to channel water to the next level or to a downspout.

name: Tiered Roof Insulation Layer
description: Insulation board or spray foam applied continuously across each step to meet thermal performance requirements.

name: Cascading Roof Overhang
description: The projecting edge of each roof step providing shading, weather protection, and visual depth to the cascade.

name: Step-to-Step Thermal Break
description: An insulating barrier placed at the transition between roof steps to minimize thermal bridging through the structure.

name: Construct Cascade Roof Framing
description: On-site assembly and erection of the stepped structural framing system supporting the tiered roof planes.

name: Install Step Roof Decking
description: On-site placement and fastening of structural sheathing across each roof step deck.

name: Apply Stepped Roof Waterproofing
description: On-site installation of membrane or liquid-applied waterproofing across the stepped roof surfaces, risers, and transitions.

name: Install Cascade Flashing and Trim
description: On-site fitting of metal flashings, step counter-flashings, and trim at all roof step junctions and edges.

name: Commission Cascade Drainage System
description: On-site testing and verification of water flow through stepped gutters, scuppers, and downspouts across all roof tiers.

name: Roof Deck / Substrate
description: The structural base layer of the roof onto which waterproofing and finishes are applied.

name: Insulation Layer
description: Thermal barrier installed within the roof assembly to reduce heat transfer.

name: Roof Covering / Finish
description: The exposed outermost weather-resistant surface material (e.g. tiles, metal sheets, green roof substrate).

name: Roof Edge / Fascia
description: Trim or cladding at the perimeter of the roof that encloses and protects the roof edge.

name: Roof Penetration Flashing
description: Prefabricated or field-formed metal/neoprene seals around pipes, vents, or ducts that pierce the roof.

name: Roof Overhang / Eaves
description: The portion of the roof projecting beyond the exterior wall line to shed water away from the facade.

name: Roof Truss / Rafter System
description: The triangulated or sloping structural framework that supports the roof deck and transfers loads to walls.

name: Roof Access / Hatch
description: A hinged or sliding door assembly in the roof plane providing maintenance access to the roof surface.

name: Snow Guard / Snow Rail
description: Devices mounted on sloped roofs to control the release of snow and ice in a safe manner.

name: Roof-mounted Equipment Support
description: Structural curbs, rails, or sleepers that raise and secure HVAC units or solar panels above the roof surface.

name: Green / Vegetated Roof Assembly
description: A multi-layered roof system incorporating a growing medium and vegetation for stormwater and thermal benefits.

name: Roof Vapor Retarder
description: A layer installed on the warm side of insulation to limit moisture diffusion into the roof assembly.

name: Roof Flashing / Counter-flashing
description: Sheet metal or preformed pieces that seal joints between the roof membrane and vertical elements.

name: Membrane Roof Installation
description: On-site application and fastening of single-ply or built-up roof membranes to the prepared deck.

name: Roof Covering Installation
description: On-site laying, fastening, or interlocking of roof finish materials such as shingles, tiles, or standing-seam panels.

name: Roof Drainage Setup
description: On-site assembly and connection of gutters, downpipes, and roof drains to the building stormwater system.

name: Skylight Installation
description: On-site positioning, flashing, and glazing of skylight units into prepared roof openings.

name: Truss / Rafter Erection
description: On-site hoisting, alignment, and bracing of roof trusses or rafters to form the structural roof frame.

name: Roof Parapet Construction
description: On-site forming, reinforcing, and finishing of masonry or concrete parapet walls at the roof perimeter.

name: Roof Garden Drainage Layer
description: The engineered drainage system (e.g., drainage boards, gravel, or geocomposite mats) that channels excess water away from the roof garden to prevent ponding and protect the waterproofing.

name: Roof Garden Waterproof Membrane
description: The root-resistant waterproofing layer (e.g., bituminous, PVC, or liquid-applied membrane) that separates the roof garden from the building structure below.

name: Roof Garden Growing Medium
description: The engineered lightweight soil substrate designed for rooftop conditions, providing nutrients and anchorage for plants while managing drainage and load.

name: Roof Garden Planting
description: The selected vegetation (sedum, grasses, shrubs, or trees) installed on the roof as part of the garden system.

name: Roof Garden Insulation Layer
description: The thermal insulation (e.g., extruded polystyrene or mineral wool) placed above or below the waterproofing to meet building energy performance requirements.

name: Roof Garden Root Barrier
description: A protective layer (often a sheet membrane or coating) that prevents plant roots from penetrating and damaging the waterproof membrane and structure.

name: Roof Garden Filter Fabric
description: A geotextile layer placed between the drainage and growing medium that prevents fine soil particles from clogging the drainage system.

name: Intensive Roof Garden
description: A deep-soil roof garden (typically >300 mm substrate) that supports a diverse range of plants including shrubs and small trees, requiring greater structural load capacity and regular maintenance.

name: Extensive Roof Garden
description: A shallow-soil roof garden (typically 80–200 mm substrate) planted with low-growing, drought-tolerant vegetation such as sedum or moss, designed for minimal maintenance and lighter structural loads.

name: Roof Garden Edge Restraint / Curb
description: The perimeter barrier or kerb that retains the growing medium and drainage layers at the roof edge while providing a clean architectural finish.

name: Roof Garden Irrigation System
description: The fixed water supply system (drip lines, sprinklers, or capillary mats) installed on the roof to maintain adequate moisture for plant health.

name: Roof Garden Paver / Deck Surface
description: Elevated paving stones, deck tiles, or walkway units set on pedestals or directly on the growing medium to create accessible paths and patio areas.

name: Roof Garden Pedestal System
description: Adjustable-height support pedestals that elevate paving stones above the waterproof membrane and drainage layer to create a level, load-distributing walking surface.

name: Roof Garden Access / Maintenance Hatch
description: A roof access door, hatch, or stairway that provides safe entry for personnel to construct, irrigate, and maintain the roof garden.

name: Roof Garden Fall Protection System
description: Engineered edge protection such as guardrails, parapet extensions, or safety netting that prevents falls from the roof garden perimeter.

name: Roof Garden Substrate Retention Grid
description: A cellular confinement system (geocells or trays) that stabilizes the growing medium on sloped roofs to prevent erosion and slippage.

name: Roof Garden Installation – Layering and Waterproofing
description: On-site sequential placement of root barrier, waterproof membrane, insulation, drainage, filter fabric, and growing medium layers.

name: Roof Garden Planting Installation
description: On-site placement of pre-grown vegetation mats, plugs, seeds, or container plants into the prepared growing medium.

name: Roof Garden Irrigation System Installation
description: On-site assembly and connection of irrigation pipes, drippers, controllers, and backflow preventers within the roof garden build-up.

name: Roof Garden Paver and Deck Assembly
description: On-site positioning and leveling of pedestals and laying of paving stones, deck tiles, or walkway units over the drainage layer.

name: Roof Garden Guardrail and Safety Installation
description: On-site fixing of guardrails, handrails, or parapet extensions to the roof structure to provide fall protection for occupants and maintenance workers.

name: Arcade colonnade
description: The row of columns supporting the arcade roof or upper structure, defining the rhythmic vertical support of the arcade.

name: Arcade vaulted ceiling
description: The arched or vaulted overhead enclosure spanning between the colonnade and the adjacent building wall.

name: Arcade floor paving
description: The finished walking surface within the arcade, typically stone, tile, or other durable paving material.

name: Arcade spandrel panel
description: The infill panel between the column capitals and the arch springing line, often decorated or finished as part of the arcade fabric.

name: Arcade keystone
description: The central wedge-shaped stone or block at the apex of an arch within the arcade, locking the arch together.

name: Arcade entablature
description: The horizontal lintel or beam assembly carried by the colonnade, forming the transition between columns and upper wall or roof.

name: Arcade drainage channel
description: The linear drainage system embedded in the arcade floor to handle rainwater runoff along the covered walkway.

name: Arcade column base
description: The widened footing at the bottom of each arcade column distributing load to the foundation.

name: Arcade impost block
description: The block or molding at the top of a column or pier from which the arch springs in the arcade.

name: Arcade arch voussoirs
description: The wedge-shaped masonry units forming the curved arch ring in the arcade.

name: Arcade installation
description: The on-site erection and assembly of the arcade columns, arches, and roof structure.

name: Arcade waterproofing application
description: The on-site application of waterproof membranes and sealants to the arcade roof and floor to prevent water ingress.

name: Arcade masonry construction
description: The on-site laying of stone or brick units for the arcade arches, columns, and spandrel assemblies.

name: Blind arcade
description: A decorative arcade applied flush against a wall surface with no depth or walkable passage behind it.

name: Pier arcade
description: An arcade supported by solid masonry piers rather than individual columns, providing greater structural mass.

name: Arcade cornice
description: The projecting decorative molding at the top of the arcade entablature or roof edge.

name: Arcade soffit lining
description: The finished underside surface of the arcade roof or vault, often lined with plaster or paneling.

name: Arcade lighting conduit
description: The embedded electrical conduit and wiring system serving lighting fixtures within the arcade ceiling.

name: Stairway
description: A vertical circulation space containing a series of steps allowing movement between different floor levels.

name: Exit Passageway
description: A fire-rated path of egress leading from a building interior to a public way or exit discharge.

name: Escalator Well
description: The structural opening and enclosure accommodating an escalator or moving walkway system.

name: Emergency Egress Stair
description: A protected fire-escape stairway dedicated to emergency evacuation, typically enclosed with fire-rated construction.

name: Egress Path Marking System
description: The installed signage, photoluminescent markings, and emergency lighting guiding occupants along exit paths.

name: Guardrail
description: A protective barrier installed at open sides of stairs, ramps, or elevated walkways to prevent falls.

name: Step Nosing
description: A protective and slip-resistant edge trim applied to the front of stair treads for safety and durability.

name: Egress Door
description: A door specifically located along a means of egress, equipped with panic hardware or push-pull operation per code.

name: Install Stair Treads and Risers
description: On-site installation of stair tread and riser finishes, including anchoring, grouting, and surface sealing.

name: Install Handrails and Guardrails
description: On-site mounting and anchoring of handrails and guardrails to walls, posts, or stair stringers per code requirements.

name: Install Wayfinding and Egress Signage
description: On-site mounting and electrical connection of illuminated exit signs and wayfinding signage along circulation paths.

name: Apply Slip-Resistant Floor Finish
description: On-site application of slip-resistant coatings, tapes, or embedded aggregates to corridor and stair surfaces.

name: Linear Path Shape
description: A straight-line or gently curved elongated path shape defining corridors, passageways, or circulation routes.

name: Curved Path Shape
description: A path shape with a continuous bend or arc, often used for curved corridors or ramps.

name: L-Shaped Path
description: A path that changes direction at approximately a right angle, creating an L-shaped circulation route.

name: T-Shaped Path
description: A path where one branch meets another perpendicularly to form a T-shaped junction.

name: Cross/Intersection Path Shape
description: A path shape where two or more routes intersect, forming crossing or branching circulation nodes.

name: U-Shaped Path
description: A path that bends in three segments forming a U-shape, typical around obstructions or building cores.

name: Switchback Path Shape
description: A path that reverses direction sharply, commonly used in stair runs and ramp configurations.

name: Circular/Round Path Shape
description: A closed-loop path shape forming a circle or ring, typical for rotundas, roundabouts, or annular corridors.

name: Polygonal Path Shape
description: A path defined by multiple straight segments forming a polygonal layout such as a hexagon or octagon.

name: Freeform/Organic Path Shape
description: A path shape with irregular, non-geometric curves often used for aesthetic or landscape-integrated routes.

name: Axial Path Shape
description: A dominant straight path that establishes a strong visual or organizational axis through a building.

name: Path Width Transition
description: A localized change in the width of a path, such as a narrowing or widening along the route.

name: Path Direction Change
description: A defined node or zone where the path changes horizontal direction, distinct from the path segments themselves.

name: Path Termination Shape
description: The end condition of a path, such as a dead-end, T-stop, or expanded terminal node.

name: Path Branching Node
description: The spatial zone at which a path splits into two or more diverging routes.

name: Main Entrance Front
description: The primary building face containing the main public entrance, often featuring a canopy, lobby, and signage.

name: Side Front
description: A secondary building face on the lateral side, typically less prominent but may contain service entries or egress doors.

name: Rear Front
description: The back-facing elevation of the building, often hosting service doors, loading docks, and utility connections.

name: Facade Cladding System
description: The exterior protective and aesthetic layer attached to the building structure, including panels, rainscreens, and curtain wall assemblies.

name: Front Structural Frame
description: The load-bearing frame (columns, beams, lintels) forming the front elevation structure.

name: Front Glazing and Windows
description: All fixed and operable window assemblies, storefront glazing, and curtain wall units on the building front.

name: Entrance Door Assembly
description: The complete door system including frames, doors, hardware, thresholds, and automatic operators at the front entry.

name: Front Canopy / Marquee
description: A projecting roof-like structure over the entrance providing weather protection and visual identity.

name: Building Signage and Lettering
description: Fixed signs, address numerals, and logo installations mounted on the building front.

name: Front Lighting Fixtures
description: Permanently installed exterior light fixtures illuminating the facade, entrance, and signage.

name: Front Landscape Buffer
description: The transitional zone between the building front and the site, including planters, paving, and fixed seating.

name: Forecourt / Plaza
description: An open paved area immediately in front of the building used for gathering, circulation, and arrival.

name: Facade Installation Activity
description: On-site erection and fixing of cladding panels, curtain wall units, and exterior finishes to the front elevation.

name: Front Glazing Installation
description: On-site setting, glazing, and sealing of window and storefront assemblies into prepared openings.

name: Entrance System Installation
description: On-site assembly and fitting of door frames, door leaves, hardware, and automatic operators at building front entries.

name: Front Canopy Construction
description: On-site fabrication and erection of the canopy structure including its framing, deck, and waterproofing.

name: Front Signage Mounting
description: On-site fixing and connection of building signs and lettering to the facade or canopy.

name: Cornice and Parapet
description: The projecting horizontal decorative or protective trim at the top of the front facade, including parapet walls and copings.

name: Ground Floor Frontage
description: The lower-level front elevation zone typically containing retail frontage, display windows, and the primary entrance.

name: Upper Floor Frontage
description: The front elevation areas above the ground level, characterized by repetitive window patterns and cladding.

name: Front Stoop / Steps
description: Permanent exterior stairs and landings at the building front providing grade-to-entrance access.

name: Awning / Sunshade Device
description: Fixed or retractable shading structures mounted on the front facade to control solar gain and weather.

name: Front Security Grilles / Shutters
description: Fixed or roll-down security barriers installed over front glazing and doors.

name: Front Column / Pilaster
description: Vertical architectural or structural elements projecting from or forming part of the front facade.

name: Occupant Load
description: The calculated number of people a space is designed to accommodate based on building code occupant load factors.

name: Crowd Flow Rate
description: The measured or modeled rate at which people move through a space, typically expressed in persons per minute per unit width of egress path.

name: Standing Density
description: The concentration of standing occupants per unit floor area in assembly or queuing spaces such as lobbies, concourses, and waiting areas.

name: Seated Density
description: The concentration of seated occupants per unit floor area, applicable to auditoria, classrooms, dining halls, and conference rooms.

name: Circulation Density
description: The pedestrian concentration within corridors, aisles, and other circulation paths that affects travel speed and level of service.

name: Egress Capacity
description: The maximum pedestrian throughput a door, stair, or corridor can accommodate under emergency evacuation conditions per code.

name: Queue Length
description: The physical extent of waiting pedestrian lines at building entries, security checkpoints, elevators, or service counters.

name: Occupant Distribution
description: The spatial pattern of how occupants are arranged across zones of a floor plate or building at a given time.

name: Level of Service (LOS)
description: A qualitative classification (A through F) of pedestrian traffic conditions based on density, speed, and freedom to maneuver, as defined in transportation and building planning standards.

name: Pedestrian Flow Zone
description: A designated area within a larger space where pedestrian movement is expected, distinct from stationary-use zones like seating or display areas.

name: Activity Pocket Partition/Enclosure
description: Fixed or operable wall panels, glazed screens, or curtains that define and separate an activity pocket from adjacent spaces.

name: Activity Pocket Floor Finish
description: Specialized floor covering (e.g., rubber, carpet tile, cork) applied within the pocket to support its specific activity while providing acoustic and tactile comfort.

name: Activity Pocket Acoustic Treatment
description: Fixed acoustic panels, baffles, or soft wall padding installed within the pocket to control sound transmission and reverberation.

name: Activity Pocket Integrated Seating
description: Built-in benches, banquettes, or fixed chairs designed as part of the pocket and not intended for relocation.

name: Activity Pocket Work Surface
description: Fixed desk, counter, or shelf surface integrated into the pocket for task support, collaboration, or display.

name: Activity Pocket Storage Unit
description: Built-in shelving, cabinetry, or cubbies within the pocket to store activity-related materials and equipment.

name: Activity Pocket Lighting System
description: Dedicated overhead, task, or accent lighting fixtures that serve the specific functional and mood requirements of the pocket.

name: Activity Pocket Power & Data Outlets
description: Fixed electrical receptacles, USB ports, and data jacks embedded in the pocket's walls, floor, or furnishings to support devices.

name: Activity Pocket Display/Tack Surface
description: Fixed whiteboard, tackboard, or projection surface mounted on the pocket's walls for visual collaboration and information sharing.

name: Activity Pocket Floor Box
description: A flush or recessed floor-installed enclosure providing power, data, and AV connectivity within the pocket's floor plane.

name: Activity Pocket Door or Gateway
description: A fixed framed opening, sliding door, or swing door that controls access into the activity pocket.

name: Activity Pocket Ceiling System
description: A suspended or dropped ceiling within the pocket, often incorporating integrated lighting, acoustics, and HVAC diffusers.

name: Activity Pocket HVAC Terminal Unit
description: A dedicated supply diffuser, return grille, or fan-coil unit that conditions the air within the pocket independently of the surrounding zone.

name: Activity Pocket Partition Installation
description: On-site assembly and fixing of wall, screen, or curtain elements that form the physical boundary of the pocket.

name: Activity Pocket Floor Finish Installation
description: Laying, adhering, or installing the specialized floor material within the pocket boundaries.

name: Activity Pocket Acoustic Treatment Installation
description: Mounting and securing acoustic panels or soft treatments to walls and ceilings of the pocket.

name: Activity Pocket Integrated Furniture Installation
description: On-site placement and fixing of built-in seating, work surfaces, and storage units within the pocket.

name: Activity Pocket Lighting & Electrical Fit-Out
description: Installation and connection of dedicated lighting fixtures, power outlets, and data interfaces within the pocket.

name: Activity Pocket MEP Rough-In
description: Routing and terminating HVAC, electrical, and low-voltage conduit within the pocket zone prior to finishes.

name: Activity Pocket Commissioning
description: Testing and balancing of lighting levels, acoustic performance, HVAC airflow, and AV systems within the activity pocket.

name: Stair Seat Tread
description: The horizontal walking surface of the stair seat that serves as both a step and a seating platform.

name: Stair Seat Riser
description: The vertical face between consecutive stair seat treads, contributing to structural support and finish continuity.

name: Stair Seat Stringer
description: The inclined structural member on one or both sides of the stair seat that supports the treads and risers.

name: Stair Seat Handrail
description: A grab rail mounted alongside the stair seat for user safety when climbing or descending.

name: Stair Seat Guardrail/Balustrade
description: A protective barrier system at the open side of the stair seat to prevent falls, including posts, infill, and top rail.

name: Stair Seat Landing
description: A level platform at the top, bottom, or intermediate point of the stair seat that provides resting and gathering space.

name: Stair Seat Nosing
description: The leading edge trim of each stair seat tread, often with slip-resistant or visual contrast detailing.

name: Stair Seat Under-stair Storage
description: The cavity beneath the stair seat flight that can be enclosed and used for built-in storage or equipment.

name: Stair Seat Lighting Tread
description: An integrated light fixture recessed into or mounted beneath the stair seat tread nosing for wayfinding and ambiance.

name: Stair Seat Handrail Lighting
description: A linear light strip integrated into the handrail or guardrail to illuminate the stair path.

name: Stair Seat Cushion Insert
description: A fixed upholstered pad or bench cushion integrated into the stair seat tread for seating comfort.

name: Stair Seat Timber Finish
description: The wood board or plank cladding applied to stair seat treads and risers for a warm aesthetic.

name: Stair Seat Carpet Finish
description: A fixed carpet runner or full-width carpet installed on stair seat treads for sound attenuation and comfort.

name: Stair Seat Tile Finish
description: Ceramic, stone, or porcelain tile fixed to stair seat treads and risers for durability and cleanability.

name: Stair Seat Concrete Structure
description: The cast-in-place or precast concrete slab forming the monolithic stair seat structure.

name: Stair Seat Steel Structure
description: The fabricated steel frame and plate assembly that supports the stair seat spans.

name: Stair Seat Sound-Absorbing Underlayment
description: An acoustic mat or resilient layer installed beneath the stair seat finish to reduce impact noise transmission.

name: Stair Seat Fire-Rated Enclosure
description: A fire-resistive assembly enclosing the stair seat, including gypsum board, fire doors, and smoke seals.

name: Stair Seat Convection Heater
description: A built-in linear heating unit installed within the stair seat kick space or riser for localized warmth.

name: Stair Seat Power/Data Outlet
description: A recessed electrical or data receptacle integrated into the stair seat side or riser for device charging.

name: Install Stair Seat Structure
description: On-site erection, forming, or steel fixing of the stair seat load-bearing frame or concrete structure.

name: Install Stair Seat Finish
description: On-site application or fixing of tread/riser finishes, nosing, and cushion inserts to the stair seat.

name: Install Stair Seat Railings
description: On-site anchoring and assembly of handrails and guardrails along the stair seat edges.

name: Install Stair Seat Lighting
description: On-site wiring, mounting, and connection of integrated lighting fixtures to the stair seat.

name: Install Stair Seat Integrated Equipment
description: On-site installation of built-in heaters, power outlets, or data ports into the stair seat assembly.

name: Amphitheater Seating
description: A cascading stepped seating arrangement in an auditorium or lecture hall, closely related to stair seats in form and function.

name: Bleacher Seating
description: A tiered bench seating system in sports venues with integrated steps, analogous to stair seats for spectator use.

name: Monolithic Stair Bench
description: A single continuous stair-bench combination where every step is a seat and there is no separate aisle.

name: Core
description: A central vertical assembly containing elevators, stairs, shafts, and mechanical risers that distributes services and circulation through the building.

name: Central Corridor
description: A primary internal circulation path running through the approximate middle of a building floor plan, connecting wings or zones on either side.

name: Central Light Well
description: An internal vertical void open to the sky, located centrally to bring daylight deep into the building floor plate.

name: Central Structural Core
description: A centralized cluster of columns, shear walls, and lateral bracing elements that provides primary structural stability to the building.

name: Central Mechanical Room
description: A centrally located room housing major HVAC equipment, air handlers, pumps, and building services distribution headers.

name: Central Staircase
description: A main stairway positioned in the middle zone of a building, providing primary vertical egress and circulation between floors.

name: Central Atrium Floor Slab Opening
description: A structural opening or series of openings in floor slabs at the center of a building to accommodate an atrium or light well.

name: Central Plenum Zone
description: A concealed horizontal space above a central ceiling or below a raised floor used for running MEP services across the building.

name: Central Lobby
description: A welcoming entry and waiting area located at the approximate middle of a building's ground floor, often adjacent to elevators and stairs.

name: Central Service Core Construction
description: On-site assembly and pouring of the central core structure including formwork, reinforcement, concrete, and embedments for MEP services.

name: Atrium Glazing and Curtain Wall Installation
description: On-site erection and sealing of the glass and framing system enclosing a central atrium or light well.

name: Central Vertical MEP Riser Installation
description: On-site mounting and connection of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing risers within the central shaft or core of the building.

name: Central Corridor Ceiling and Lighting Installation
description: On-site fixing of ceiling grid, panels, and lighting fixtures along a central corridor to complete the finished interior.

name: Central Staircase Precast Tread Installation
description: On-site craning, positioning, and grouting of precast concrete or steel stair flights within the central stairwell.

name: Entry Transition Zone
description: The threshold and entry area that mediates between public exterior and private interior, establishing the first layer of the intimacy gradient.

name: Visitor Reception Area
description: A semi-public space immediately inside the entry where visitors are greeted and screened before proceeding deeper into the building.

name: Public Gathering Hall
description: A large, openly accessible interior space for assembly, circulation, and informal interaction, representing the most public end of the gradient.

name: Semi-Private Corridor
description: A circulation space that transitions users from public zones toward restricted or private areas, often with controlled access points.

name: Personal Retreat Room
description: A small, highly private space designed for solitude, reflection, or rest, accessible only to authorized individuals.

name: Privacy Screen Wall
description: A fixed or operable partition that visually and acoustically separates zones of differing intimacy levels within an open plan.

name: Sightline-Blocking Louver
description: A fixed or adjustable louver assembly installed in walls or partitions to control visual privacy while permitting airflow.

name: Graduated Ceiling Height
description: A ceiling design strategy that reduces ceiling height progressively from public to private zones to signal decreasing social distance.

name: Recessed Entry Alcove
description: A niche or indentation at an entrance that creates a spatial buffer, delaying full visual exposure to the interior beyond.

name: Layered Door Assembly
description: A sequence of two or more doors (e.g., vestibule doors, acoustic doors, privacy doors) that incrementally control sound and visual access along the gradient.

name: Glazing Opacity Gradient
description: Glass or glazing units with graduated opacity or frit patterns that transition from transparent in public zones to translucent or opaque in private zones.

name: Soft-Floor Buffer Zone
description: Carpet or resilient flooring installed at the transition between zones to acoustically dampen footfall and signal a change in privacy level.

name: Install Privacy Partitions
description: On-site installation of fixed or operable partitions to define intimacy zones, including framing, drywall, glazing, and acoustic sealing.

name: Commission Door Access Control System
description: On-site installation, wiring, and programming of electronic access control hardware for doors separating zones of differing privacy levels.

name: Apply Fritted Glazing Film
description: On-site application of opacity-graduated window film or frit patterns to existing glazing to create visual privacy transitions.

name: Window Openings & Glazing
description: Fixed or operable fenestration assemblies including frames, glass panes, and seals that admit sunlight through the building envelope.

name: Skylights & Roof Glazing
description: Overhead transparent or translucent assemblies installed in the roof plane to admit daylight from above.

name: Light Tubes & Solar Tunnels
description: Reflective tubular devices that channel sunlight from rooftop collectors through the roof and ceiling into interior spaces.

name: Atria & Light Wells
description: Multi-story interior volumes or open shafts designed to draw daylight deep into adjacent floor plates.

name: Sunshades & Solar Control Devices
description: Fixed or operable louvres, overhangs, fins, brise-soleil, or blinds that modulate the quantity and direction of incoming sunlight.

name: Light Shelves & Reflectors
description: Horizontal or angled reflective surfaces mounted above eye level to redirect sunlight deeper into interior spaces.

name: Glazing Coatings & Films
description: Applied or deposited thin-film layers on glass that selectively control solar heat gain, UV transmission, and visible light transmittance.

name: Sunspace & Conservatory
description: Glazed enclosed spaces attached to a building that passively capture solar radiation for heating or daylighting.

name: Interior Glazed Partitions
description: Glass walls or screens within the building that transmit sunlight between interior zones while maintaining visual separation.

name: Photovoltaic Glazing & BIPV
description: Building-integrated photovoltaic panels serving as both sunlight-modulating envelope elements and electricity-generating devices.

name: Installation of Sun-Control Systems
description: On-site mounting and commissioning of shading devices, louvres, blinds, or overhangs to regulate indoor sunlight.

name: Installation of Daylight Redirecting Devices
description: On-site assembly and positioning of light shelves, reflectors, or prismatic panels to optimize natural light distribution.

name: Glazing & Fenestration Installation
description: On-site fitting, sealing, and curing of window assemblies, skylights, or curtain walls that admit sunlight into the building.

name: Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC) Rating
description: The engineering metric assigned to glazing assemblies that quantifies the fraction of incident solar radiation admitted through the window.

name: Daylight Autonomy & Illuminance Sensors
description: Sensor networks and control logic that measure interior daylight levels and adjust electric lighting or shading in response.

name: Lobby/Atrium
description: The main entrance and transition space that connects the building exterior to interior circulation, often featuring double-height volume and visual prominence.

name: Break Room / Pantry
description: An informal common room equipped with a sink, countertop, cabinetry, and sometimes vending or coffee machines for occupant refreshment.

name: Public Toilet / Restroom
description: A publicly accessible sanitary space containing water closets, lavatories, and hand-drying fixtures designed for multiple occupants.

name: Built-in Reception Seating
description: Fixed bench or banquette seating integrated into the reception or waiting area that is part of the building fit-out.

name: Directory / Wayfinding Signage
description: Fixed building-mounted signs, floor plan displays, or digital kiosks that orient visitors within the common circulation zones.

name: Fire-rated Doorset
description: The complete door assembly installed at corridor and stairwell entries that provides fire compartmentation and means of egress.

name: Stair Handrail
description: A graspable rail mounted at stair flights and landings that provides fall protection and occupant support during ascent or descent.

name: Corridor Ceiling System
description: The suspended acoustic ceiling grid with panels, lighting fixtures, and sprinklers installed throughout common circulation paths.

name: Elevator Door Operator
description: The mechanical and control system that powers the automatic opening and closing of elevator car and hoistway doors.

name: Stairwell Pressurization Fan
description: A mechanical ventilation fan that maintains positive air pressure in the stair enclosure during a fire to prevent smoke ingress.

name: Common Area Lighting Control
description: The occupancy-sensing or time-scheduled lighting control system that manages illumination levels in shared circulation spaces.

name: Install Common Area Ceiling Grid
description: On-site installation of suspended ceiling runners, hangers, and grid components in corridors and lobbies.

name: Install Corridor Fire Doorsets
description: On-site hanging, hardware installation, and adjustment of fire-rated door assemblies in common circulation paths.

name: Install Stair Handrails
description: On-site mounting and anchoring of continuous handrail systems to stair stringers, walls, and landings.

name: Commission Elevator Lobby Systems
description: On-site testing and balancing of elevator operation, hall call fixtures, and landing door interlocks in the elevator lobby.

name: Entrance Floor Mat / Grille
description: A recessed floor-mounted scraper or mat system at the entry for dirt and moisture removal from footwear.

name: Entry Vestibule
description: A small transitional space between exterior and interior that reduces heat loss and provides a buffer zone.

name: Reception Desk / Counter
description: A fixed desk or counter where visitors are greeted and building access is managed.

name: Entry Floor Finish
description: Durable flooring material (tile, stone, terrazzo) specifically selected for high-traffic entry areas.

name: Entrance Canopy / Portico

name: Commission Plumbing System
description: Pressure-testing pipes, flushing lines, checking drainage flow, and verifying fixture operation.

name: Commission Electrical System
description: Testing circuits, installing light fittings and switch plates, and verifying safety switch operation.

name: Skillion Roof
description: A single-sloped roof design variant for the cottage, offering a modern aesthetic with simple construction.

name: Gable Roof
description: A traditional peaked roof design variant with two sloping sides meeting at a ridge, common for cottages.

name: Split-Level Cottage Layout
description: A cottage design variant where floor levels are offset by half a storey to follow sloping terrain.

name: Granny Flat (Auxiliary Dwelling)
description: A smaller self-contained secondary dwelling on the same lot, often used as an ageing-in-place unit.

name: Accessible Bathroom Layout
description: A bathroom design variant with widened doorways, grab rails, level-access shower, and slip-resistant flooring.

name: Retrofit Accessibility Upgrades
description: On-site installation of grab rails, ramp access, widened doorways, and step-free thresholds to an existing cottage.

name: Settled Work Indicator/Reference Mark
description: A physical mark, benchmark, or gauge embedded in or attached to a structure to monitor and verify ongoing settlement.

name: Settlement Monitoring System
description: Instrumentation and sensor network installed to measure differential or total settlement over time in a building or its foundation.

name: Settlement Joint/Accommodation Strip
description: A purpose-designed gap, joint, or flexible strip within the building fabric that accommodates differential settlement between building parts.

name: Compensated Foundation Slab
description: A foundation slab designed or adjusted to counteract anticipated settlement through preloading or compensatory geometry.

name: Underpinning Element
description: A structural element installed below an existing foundation to transfer loads to deeper, more stable strata and arrest settlement.

name: Grout Injection System (Settlement Remediation)
description: A network of grout pipes, ports, and injection points used to fill voids or densify soil beneath a settled structure.

name: Jacking Pocket
description: A recess or void left in a wall or foundation to accommodate hydraulic jacks used to re-level a settled building element.

name: Settlement Crack Repair Assembly
description: A repair assembly comprising stitching bars, helical ties, or epoxy injections used to structurally close and monitor settlement cracks.

name: On-Site Settlement Monitoring and Adjustment Activity
description: The on-site work of installing survey marks, taking periodic readings, and performing corrective jacking or grouting to manage settlement.

name: Foundation Underpinning Installation Activity
description: The construction activity of excavating and placing underpinning elements beneath an existing foundation to control ongoing settlement.

name: Grout Injection for Settlement Remediation Activity
description: The on-site injection of grout into subgrade voids or compressible layers to stabilize soil and arrest further building settlement.

name: Structural Releveling by Jacking Activity
description: The on-site activity of inserting jacks into jacking pockets and incrementally lifting settled building elements back to design levels.

name: Crack Stitching and Repair Activity
description: The construction activity of installing helical ties, stitching bars, or epoxy along settlement cracks to restore structural continuity.

name: Workbench
description: A sturdy built-in or freestanding table surface for assembly, repair, and crafting work, typically with a durable top and storage underneath.

name: Tool Storage Wall/Pegboard
description: A wall-mounted organizing system with hooks, shelves, and pegboard panels for hanging and storing hand tools within easy reach.

name: Workshop Sink
description: A deep utility sink with sturdy faucet, often integrated into a workbench or adjacent counter, for cleaning tools and washing hands.

name: Workshop Electrical Subpanel
description: A dedicated electrical distribution panel providing 120V and 240V circuits for workshop machinery, with separate breakers for each tool station.

name: Heavy-Duty Flooring
description: A durable, oil-resistant floor surface such as sealed concrete, epoxy coating, or heavy-gauge vinyl tiles that withstands impacts and chemical spills.

name: Workstation Lighting
description: Task-level LED or fluorescent luminaires positioned directly over workbenches and machinery to provide shadow-free illumination for precision work.

name: Dust Collection System
description: A ducted network of pipes, blast gates, and a central vacuum unit that captures airborne sawdust and particulate from woodworking machinery.

name: Workshop Exhaust Ventilation
description: A mechanical ventilation system including intake louvers and exhaust fans sized to remove fumes, VOCs, and fine dust from the workshop environment.

name: Machine Anchoring & Vibration Isolation
description: Concrete anchor bolts, mounting pads, and vibration-dampening mats used to securely fasten stationary power tools to the floor.

name: Workshop Door
description: An oversized, insulated overhead door or outward-swinging steel door wide enough to bring in large materials, machinery, and project pieces.

name: Material Storage Racking
description: Heavy-duty wall-mounted or freestanding metal racks for storing sheet goods, lumber, metal stock, and piping in organized horizontal or vertical bins.

name: Built-in Cabinetry and Drawers
description: Fixed base cabinets with heavy-duty slides and worktop counters providing enclosed storage for fasteners, abrasives, finishes, and small parts.

name: Clamp Rack and Tool Hangers
description: Wall-mounted rails, French cleats, and purpose-built hangers for storing bar clamps, C-clamps, and long-handled tools off the floor.

name: Electrical Outlet Strips (Workstation Power)
description: Surface-mounted multi-outlet raceways or overhead retractable cords providing abundant grounded outlets at each work position without extension cords.

name: Workshop Insulation and Vapor Barrier
description: Thermal insulation and vapor retarder installed in workshop walls and ceiling to maintain stable temperature and control humidity for material storage.

name: Install Workbench and Cabinetry
description: On-site assembly, anchoring, and leveling of fixed workbenches, base cabinets, and countertops to the workshop floor and walls.

name: Install Dust Collection Ductwork
description: Routing, hanging, and sealing of metal or PVC dust-collection piping from each machine location to the central dust collector unit.

name: Install Compressed Air Piping
description: Running copper, aluminum, or galvanized steel air lines with drop legs and quick-connect fittings from the compressor to multiple workstations.

name: Install Workshop Electrical Circuits
