description: Pulling and terminating 120V and 240V branch circuits from the subpanel to dedicated receptacles and machine disconnect switches.

name: Install Exhaust Fan and Louvers
description: Mounting and wiring of wall- or roof-mounted exhaust fans and motorized intake louvers to provide the required air changes per hour.

name: Install Floor Coating or Flooring
description: Applying epoxy coating, laying heavy-duty vinyl tile, or sealing concrete floor to create a durable, cleanable workshop surface.

name: Anchor Stationary Power Tools
description: Bolting table saws, band saws, drill presses, and other stationary machines to the floor with vibration isolation mounts.

name: Install Fire Extinguisher Station
description: Mounting a fire extinguisher cabinet or bracket on the workshop wall at the required clearance and signage per fire code.

name: Commission Dust Collection System
description: Testing airflow velocity at each blast gate, checking duct seals for leaks, and balancing branch dampers to achieve capture velocity at every tool.

name: Tread
description: The horizontal walking surface of an individual step that supports foot traffic.

name: Riser
description: The vertical face between two consecutive treads, which may be open or closed in an open stair design.

name: Stringer
description: The inclined structural member on one or both sides of a stair flight that supports the treads and risers.

name: Balustrade Assembly
description: The complete guard system comprising handrails, balusters, and a bottom rail along the open side of the stair.

name: Stair Support Structure
description: The underlying structural frame or cantilevered connections that transfer stair loads to the building structure.

name: Spiral Stair Variant
description: An open stair configuration where steps radiate around a central central pole or column in a helical pattern.

name: Monolithic Concrete Open Stair
description: A cast-in-place reinforced concrete stair with open risers forming a continuous structural element.

name: Prefabricated Steel Open Stair
description: A shop-fabricated steel stair assembly with open risers and often cantilevered treads delivered to site for installation.

name: Timber Open Stair
description: An open-riser stair constructed from wood treads and stringers, common in residential and light commercial interiors.

name: Glass Tread Stair
description: An open stair featuring laminated glass treads often supported by stainless steel stringers for a transparent effect.

name: Cantilevered Open Stair
description: An open stair where treads project from a supporting wall without visible stringers, creating a floating appearance.

name: Stair Nosing Profile Installation
description: The on-site installation of metal, rubber, or abrasive nosing strips along tread edges for slip resistance.

name: Handrail & Balustrade Installation
description: The on-site fixing of handrails, balusters, and guardrails to the stair structure and supporting walls.

name: Tread & Riser Installation
description: The on-site placement and fastening of individual treads and, where present, risers to the stringers.

name: Stair Stringer Erection
description: The installation and securing of stair stringers to supporting beams, slabs, or walls.

name: Under-Stair Enclosure
description: The void or usable space beneath an open stair flight, often enclosed for storage or secondary use.

name: Stair Opening (Stairwell)
description: The vertical shaft or floor opening through which the open stair passes, including any required fire-rated enclosures.

name: Anti-Slip Coating Application
description: The on-site application of abrasive paint, tape, or aggregate finish to tread surfaces for slip resistance.

name: Perimeter Glazing
description: Window assemblies installed on two adjacent or opposite exterior walls to admit daylight from multiple directions.

name: Light Shelves
description: Horizontal reflective surfaces positioned above eye level on windows that bounce daylight deeper into a room while reducing glare near the window.

name: Sidelight Openings
description: Door sidelights, transoms, or clerestory windows that supplement primary window openings with additional daylight from a second side.

name: Reflective Interior Surfaces
description: Light-colored paints, white ceilings, and polished floor finishes that maximize daylight distribution across the room.

name: Daylight-Responsive Lighting Controls
description: Automated dimming or switching systems that adjust electric lighting based on available daylight to maintain consistent illuminance.

name: Automatic Shading Devices
description: Motorized blinds, louvers, or shades that deploy to control glare and solar heat gain when daylight from two sides is excessive.

name: Double-Loaded Corridor Layout
description: A building floor plan configuration where rooms are arranged on both sides of a central corridor, enabling cross-ventilation and dual-aspect daylight.

name: Window Wall Assembly
description: A complete wall system incorporating glazing, framing, insulation, and weather barriers on a building face that admits light.

name: Glare Control Louvers
description: Fixed or adjustable horizontal blades integrated into window assemblies that redirect direct sunlight to the ceiling while maintaining views.

name: Install Perimeter Windows
description: On-site installation of window frames, glazing units, and flashings into prepared exterior wall openings.

name: Install Interior Glass Walls
description: Erection of glass partition systems including framing, panels, doors, and seals to create transparent interior boundaries.

name: Apply Reflective Coatings
description: On-site painting or application of high-reflectance finishes to ceiling and wall surfaces to enhance daylight distribution.

name: Commission Daylight Controls
description: Calibration and testing of photosensors, dimming ballasts, and shading actuators to ensure proper response to dual-aspect daylight.

name: Install Light Shelves
description: Mounting and securing light shelf assemblies to the interior or exterior of window walls at the designated height.

name: Building Edge Foundation
description: The lowest load-bearing portion of the building edge, including strip footings, grade beams, or edge beams that transfer wall loads to the ground.

name: Building Edge Soffit
description: The underside of the roof or floor overhang at the building perimeter, often finished and ventilated.

name: Fascia
description: The vertical band or board that caps the outer edge of the roof or eave, providing a finished appearance and weather protection.

name: Drip Edge
description: A metal flashing installed at the roof edge or window head to direct water away from the building face.

name: Perimeter Drainage System
description: Subsurface drain tiles, gravel trenches, and weep holes along the building edge that collect and redirect groundwater away from the foundation.

name: Building Edge Sealant
description: Elastomeric caulking or sealant applied at the interface between the building edge and adjacent materials to prevent air and water infiltration.

name: Perimeter Insulation
description: Rigid or spray foam insulation placed along the foundation wall or slab edge to reduce thermal bridging at the building perimeter.

name: Edge of Slab
description: The exposed perimeter edge of a concrete floor slab, often formed with a thickened edge or a chamfered finish.

name: Copings and Parapet Caps
description: The protective top cover on a parapet wall at the building edge, typically fabricated from metal, stone, or precast concrete.

name: Perimeter Flashing
description: Sheet-metal or membrane flashings installed at wall-to-roof, wall-to-window, and other edge transitions to shed water.

name: Building Edge Landscaping Interface
description: The transitional zone between the building edge and the adjacent ground or hardscape, including splash blocks, grade beams, and backfill.

name: Install Exterior Cladding
description: On-site attachment of the outer weather-resistant skin (panels, veneer, or curtain wall) to the building perimeter structure.

name: Apply Perimeter Sealant
description: Field application of caulking and sealant at all building edge joints, penetrations, and transitions to achieve air and water tightness.

name: Install Edge Flashing
description: On-site cutting, fitting, and fastening of metal or membrane flashings at roof edges, parapets, and wall terminations.

name: Build Perimeter Drainage
description: Excavation and installation of drain tile, gravel, and filter fabric along the foundation edge to manage subsurface water.

name: Sun-Facing Glazing Assembly
description: The window or curtain wall assembly on the sunny side of the building, optimized for solar heat gain management and daylighting.

name: Exterior Solar Shading Device
description: Fixed or operable external louvres, brise-soleil, overhangs, or screens that block or regulate direct sun penetration.

name: Interior Solar Shading Device
description: Internal blinds, shades, or curtains that control glare and diffuse incoming sunlight within the sunny space.

name: Sunspace / Solar Conservatory
description: An enclosed glazed room or atrium that passively captures solar radiation to preheat ventilation air or provide thermal buffer.

name: Trombe Wall Assembly
description: A massive thermal storage wall with glazing on the sunny side, designed to absorb solar heat and release it into the interior with a time lag.

name: Solar Thermal Collector Array
description: Roof- or wall-mounted collectors that convert solar radiation into heat for domestic hot water or space heating systems.

name: Building-Integrated Photovoltaic (BIPV) System
description: Photovoltaic modules integrated into the building envelope (roof tiles, façade panels, or glazing) generating electricity from sunlight.

name: Phase-Change Material (PCM) Thermal Storage
description: Materials embedded in walls or ceilings that absorb and release latent heat during diurnal solar cycles to stabilize indoor temperatures.

name: Solar-Responsive HVAC Zone Damper
description: A motorized damper in the air distribution system that modulates airflow based on real-time solar heat gain in the sunny zone.

name: Sunny-Place Glazing Selection & Installation
description: On-site installation of high-performance glazing units with appropriate solar heat gain coefficient (SHGC) for the sunny orientation.

name: Exterior Shading Installation
description: Field assembly and mounting of fixed or operable solar shading devices to the building structure on the sunny façade.

name: Solar Collector Mounting & Commissioning
description: On-site installation, piping connection, and system startup of roof-mounted solar thermal collectors and their control systems.

name: PCM-Enhanced Wall Construction
description: Incorporation of phase-change material panels into wall or ceiling assemblies during on-site construction.

name: North-facing wall assembly
description: The exterior wall construction on the north elevation, including cladding, insulation, vapor barrier, and structural backing.

name: North-facing glazing system
description: Windows, curtain walls, or storefronts on the north elevation, often designed for controlled diffuse daylight with minimal direct solar gain.

name: North-facing shading devices
description: Fixed or operable external louvres, overhangs, or fins mounted on the north facade to manage glare and daylight.

name: North entrance / lobby
description: The entry space on the north side of the building, including vestibule, weather seal, and access control zone.

name: North face foundation / footing
description: The foundation wall, strip footing, or frost protection along the north perimeter of the building.

name: North roof edge / parapet
description: The roof-to-wall transition at the north elevation, including parapet cap, flashing, and coping.

name: North face rainwater drainage
description: Downspouts, gutters, and conductors collecting runoff specifically from the north roof and facade areas.

name: North face exterior insulation and finish system (EIFS)
description: A multi-layer exterior wall cladding system applied to the north elevation for thermal performance and weather resistance.

name: North face snow/ice management system
description: Snow guards, ice belts, or heat trace cables installed on the north roof slope and parapet to control snow and ice accumulation.

name: North face commissioning
description: On-site testing and verification of north-facing envelope performance, including air leakage, thermal imaging, and water penetration tests.

name: North face air barrier installation
description: On-site application and sealing of the air barrier membrane along the north exterior wall assembly.

name: North face cladding installation
description: On-site erection and fastening of the exterior cladding material on the north elevation.

name: Terrace
description: An outdoor paved or tiled area, often on a roof or at ground level, used for seating and activities.

name: Lanai
description: A covered open-sided porch or veranda, common in tropical architecture.

name: Outdoor Stair
description: An exterior stairway of treads, risers, and stringers providing vertical circulation between outdoor levels.

name: Outdoor Ramp
description: An inclined exterior surface for accessible movement between different outdoor or entry levels.

name: Outdoor Balustrade
description: A guardrail system comprising posts, handrails, and infill panels for safety at edges of outdoor spaces.

name: Outdoor Handrail
description: A graspable rail fixed to walls or posts at exterior stairs and ramps for user support.

name: Outdoor Floor Paving
description: The finished surface layer of tiles, stone, concrete pavers, or brick set on an outdoor deck or terrace.

name: Outdoor Decking Board
description: Individual timber, composite, or PVC planks laid as the walking surface on a deck frame.

name: Outdoor Wall Cladding
description: Exterior-facing finish material applied to walls adjacent to or enclosing an outdoor room.

name: Pergola
description: A garden structure of vertical posts and open beams overhead, providing partial shade and defining an outdoor room.

name: Outdoor Ceiling
description: A soffit or overhead surface applied under the roof or balcony above an outdoor room.

name: Weatherproof Electrical Outlet
description: A building-integrated socket rated for exterior use, providing power in outdoor living spaces.

name: Outdoor Lighting Fixture
description: A permanently installed luminaire designed to withstand weather while illuminating an outdoor room.

name: Exterior Ceiling Fan
description: A building-mounted fan rated for damp locations to improve air circulation in covered outdoor rooms.

name: Outdoor Heater Mount
description: A fixed bracket or infrastructure for attaching an overhead radiant heater in an outdoor space.

name: Exterior Drainage Channel
description: A linear trench drain or slot set into the outdoor floor to collect and convey rainwater.

name: Outdoor Room Enclosure Wall
description: A partial-height or full-height wall that defines the boundary of an outdoor room without fully enclosing it.

name: Privacy Screen
description: A fixed louvered, perforated, or solid panel that visually shields an outdoor room from neighbors.

name: Outdoor Shade Louver
description: An adjustable or fixed angled blade assembly mounted overhead to control sunlight penetration.

name: Outdoor Shade Sail Mount
description: Fixed posts, brackets, or cables integrated into the building structure for tensioning a fabric shade sail.

name: Outdoor Bench
description: A built-in fixed seating unit of wood, metal, or concrete, attached to the structure or paving.

name: Outdoor Planter Wall
description: A built-in raised planting bed integrated into the building edge or freestanding within the outdoor room.

name: Outdoor Fireplace
description: A permanently constructed hearth and chimney for an open fire, built into the outdoor room structure.

name: Outdoor Fire Pit
description: A fixed, building-integrated bowl or ring enclosure for contained open flames in an outdoor space.

name: Outdoor Kitchen Counter
description: A built-in fixed countertop with base cabinet for food preparation in an exterior cooking area.

name: Outdoor Kitchen Sink
description: A permanent sink fixture with plumbing connections installed in an outdoor kitchen counter.

name: Outdoor Kitchen Island
description: A freestanding, fixed structure housing cooking appliances, storage, and counter space outdoors.

name: Outdoor Shower
description: A permanently plumbed shower fixture with drain located in an exterior space.

name: Retractable Awning
description: A fabric or metal canopy on a fixed frame that extends and retracts to provide adjustable shade.

name: Outdoor Speaker Mount
description: A fixed bracket or recessed enclosure for permanently installed weather-rated speakers in an outdoor room.

name: Exterior Water Feature Basin
description: A built-in basin, fountain, or reflecting pool integrated into the outdoor room's hardscape.

name: Outdoor Floor Heating System
description: An embedded radiant tubing or electric mat beneath the outdoor paving that melts snow or provides warmth.

name: Window Head/Lintel
description: The horizontal structural element at the top of the window opening that carries load above the opening.

name: Window Gasket/Glazing Bead
description: The strip or molding that secures the glass pane within the sash or frame.

name: Window Mullion
description: The vertical or horizontal divider between adjacent window units within a single opening.

name: Window Transom
description: A horizontal crossbar separating a smaller upper window panel from the main window below.

name: Window Shading Device (Built-in)
description: Building-integrated external or internal blinds, louvers, or shutters that control solar gain and privacy.

name: Window Operation Mechanism
description: The crank, push-bar, chain winder, or sliding track system that governs the window's opening mode.

name: Street Window Installation
description: On-site placement, leveling, and securing of the window unit into the prepared rough opening.

name: Window Weather Barrier Installation
description: Application of flashing, sealant, and weather-resistant barrier around the window opening during installation.

name: Storefront
description: A fully glazed exterior wall system with doors that forms the primary visual and physical interface between the building's interior and the street.

name: Entry Canopy
description: A roof-like projection over the street-facing entrance that provides weather protection and visually marks the transition zone.

name: Street-Facing Window Wall
description: A non-operable or operable glazed wall assembly oriented toward the street, providing daylight, views, and visual connection.

name: Display Window
description: A large fixed glazed panel at street level specifically designed for visual merchandising or public viewing into the building.

name: Entry Threshold
description: The horizontal transition element at the base of the door opening that bridges interior floor and exterior sidewalk levels.

name: Access Ramp
description: A sloped walking surface at the street entrance designed to provide barrier-free access between sidewalk and interior floor level.

name: Street-Level Vestibule
description: A small enclosed transition space immediately inside the street entrance that acts as an airlock and buffer between outdoor and indoor climates.

name: Fixed Street Canopy
description: A permanent structural projection over the sidewalk along the building frontage providing continuous pedestrian weather protection.

name: Door Closer & Panic Hardware
description: Mechanical and electronic devices mounted on street-facing doors to ensure automatic closing, fire safety, and emergency egress compliance.

name: Entry Mat/Grid System
description: A recessed walking surface insert at the entrance interior side that captures dirt and moisture from street footwear.

name: Street-Facing Entrance Door
description: The primary operable door panel or pair of panels set within the storefront that provides the main passageway from street to interior.

name: Install Storefront System
description: On-site installation of framing, glazing, gaskets, and anchorage to form the complete storefront wall assembly at the street façade.

name: Install Entrance Doors & Hardware
description: On-site mounting and adjustment of door panels, hinges, closers, panic hardware, and access control devices at the street opening.

name: Install Threshold & Mat System
description: On-site placement and anchoring of the entry threshold and recessed mat/grid system at the base of the street opening.

name: Commission Automatic Doors
description: On-site programming, sensor calibration, and safety testing of automatic sliding or revolving doors at the street entrance.

name: Gallery Surround Floor Slab
description: The structural floor deck supporting the gallery surround, typically a concrete slab on metal deck or precast plank.

name: Gallery Surround Floor Finish
description: The finished walking surface applied to the gallery surround floor, such as carpet, tile, wood, or resilient flooring.

name: Gallery Surround Balustrade
description: A guardrail system installed along the open edge of the gallery surround to prevent falls.

name: Gallery Surround Handrail
description: A horizontal or sloping rail mounted on walls or balusters to provide occupant support along the gallery surround.

name: Gallery Surround Glazing Panel
description: Fixed glass panels within the gallery surround balustrade or wall for visibility and light transmission.

name: Gallery Surround Structural Beam
description: A horizontal structural member supporting the gallery surround and transferring loads to columns or walls.

name: Gallery Surround Cantilever Bracket
description: A steel or concrete bracket that extends the gallery surround outward from the primary building structure.

name: Gallery Surround Soffit
description: The finished underside of the gallery surround visible from the space below.

name: Gallery Surround Upstand Wall
description: A low wall or parapet at the outer edge of the gallery surround providing containment and mounting surface for balustrades.

name: Gallery Surround Nosing Profile
description: The edge trim or profile at the outer lip of the gallery surround floor, often with slip-resistant or lighting properties.

name: Gallery Surround Step
description: A stepped transition within or at the entry of the gallery surround to accommodate level changes.

name: Gallery Surround Acoustic Barrier
description: Sound-attenuating material installed within the gallery surround assembly to reduce noise transmission between adjacent spaces.

name: Gallery Surround Access Hatch
description: A concealed access panel or door in the gallery surround floor or soffit for maintenance access to building services.

name: Gallery Surround Floor Box
description: A recessed electrical/data outlet box flush-mounted in the gallery surround floor.

name: Gallery Surround Baseboard
description: A trim piece at the junction of the gallery surround wall and floor concealing the expansion gap.

name: Balustrade Installation
description: On-site erection, anchoring, and alignment of the balustrade system along the gallery surround edge.

name: Soffit Framing and Finishing
description: On-site construction and finishing of the gallery surround soffit including framing, sheathing, and ceiling finish.

name: Structural Support Installation
description: On-site erection and connection of structural beams, brackets, and supports for the gallery surround.

name: Glazing Installation
description: On-site setting and sealing of glass panels into the gallery surround balustrade or wall framing.

name: Balcony Slab
description: The horizontal structural floor element extending outward from the building to form the walking surface of the six-foot balcony.

name: Balcony Guardrail/Handrail Assembly
description: The safety barrier system including top rail, intermediate rails, and infill elements installed at the outer edge of the balcony.

name: Balcony Balusters
description: The vertical posts or pickets supporting the guardrail, spaced to meet building code requirements for the six-foot depth.

name: Balcony Deck Drainage
description: The waterproofing membrane, sloping, and drain or scupper system that manages water runoff on the six-foot balcony surface.

name: Balcony Door Assembly
description: The door, frame, and threshold unit providing access from the interior to the balcony, often a sliding or hinged glass door.

name: Balcony Soffit
description: The finished underside of the balcony slab visible from below, typically clad or painted to match the building exterior.

name: Balcony Floor Finish
description: The exterior-grade walking surface material applied atop the balcony slab, such as tile, stone, decking, or coated concrete.

name: Balcony Lighting
description: The fixed light fixtures installed on the balcony ceiling or walls to provide illumination for the outdoor space.

name: Balcony Structure Anchorage
description: The steel brackets, embed plates, or reinforced concrete connections that transfer balcony loads back to the main building structure.

name: Install Balcony Waterproofing
description: On-site application of liquid-applied or sheet waterproofing membrane on the balcony slab prior to floor finishing.

name: Install Guardrail System
description: On-site erection and fastening of the balcony guardrail, handrail, and baluster assembly to the slab edge.

name: Earthing Electrode
description: A metallic rod, plate, or strip embedded in the ground that provides a direct electrical connection to the earth.

name: Earth Continuity Conductor
description: The protective conductor that connects all exposed conductive parts of the building's electrical system to the earthing electrode.

name: Earth Termination Bar
description: A central busbar located in the main electrical room where all grounding conductors are bonded together.

name: Earth Pit / Inspection Pit
description: A covered underground box that houses the earthing electrode connection point for inspection and testing access.

name: Foundation Earth Electrode
description: A copper or galvanized steel conductor looped within the building's foundation concrete to act as a grounding electrode.

name: Lightning Protection Down Conductor
description: A conductor that connects the roof lightning air termination network to the earth termination system.

name: Bonding Conductor
description: A conductor that connects metallic building services (water pipes, gas pipes, HVAC ducts) to the earthing system to prevent potential differences.

name: Earthing Cable
description: The insulated or bare copper cable that carries fault current from the building's electrical system to the earth electrode.

name: Backfill Material for Earth Pit
description: Special low-resistivity material (such as bentonite or conductive backfill) placed around the earthing electrode to improve ground conductivity.

name: Main Earth Busbar
description: The central copper or aluminum bar within the main distribution board where all grounding conductors terminate.

name: Equipotential Bonding Grid
description: A grid of interconnected conductors buried in the ground beneath the building slab that equalizes earth potential across the site.

name: Soil Resistivity Test
description: On-site measurement of the electrical resistivity of the surrounding soil to determine the required earthing electrode configuration.

name: Earth Electrode Installation
description: On-site driving or excavation and backfilling of earthing rods, plates, or grids into the ground.

name: Earth Continuity Testing
description: On-site verification of electrical continuity between all bonded metallic components and the earthing system using a low-resistance ohmmeter.

name: Earthing System Commissioning
description: On-site measurement of the overall earth resistance value and verification against the design specification to certify the earthing system.

name: Ground Ring
description: A closed loop of bare copper conductor buried around the building perimeter serving as an earth electrode.

name: Terraced Slope Structure
description: The load-bearing framework or stepped substrate that creates the tiered levels of a sloped seating or planting area.

name: Stepped Seating Risers
description: The vertical or inclined structural elements forming each step or tier of a terraced slope used for seating.

name: Tiered Treads
description: The horizontal walking or seating surfaces on each level of the terraced slope, providing usable flat areas.

name: Terraced Retaining Wall
description: A wall at the back or front of each terrace level that retains earth or supports the next tier.

name: Slope Drainage System
description: Subsurface or surface drainage installed within the terraced slope to manage water runoff between tiers.

name: Geogrid Soil Reinforcement
description: Tensile reinforcement layers embedded within the slope fill to stabilize the terraced soil structure.

name: Terraced Planting Pockets
description: Recessed soil zones on each terrace tier designed to accommodate fixed landscaping or vegetation.

name: Integrated Terrace Bench Seating
description: Built-in fixed benches mounted on or forming part of the terrace treads for permanent seating.

name: Terraced Amphitheater Layout
description: A sweeping, stepped arrangement of seating tiers arranged in a semicircular or fan-shaped plan.

name: Handrail and Guardrail System
description: Fixed safety rails installed along the edges of terraced tiers to prevent falls between levels.

name: Terraced Slope Excavation and Grading
description: On-site earthmoving and cutting of the natural slope into stepped benches prior to structural works.

name: Tier Formwork and Concrete Placement
description: Installation of formwork and pouring of concrete to create the stepped geometry of each terrace tier.

name: Terrace Soil Backfill and Compaction
description: Placement and compaction of engineered fill behind retaining elements to build up each tier level.

name: Built-in Terrace Lighting Installation
description: Recessed or surface-mounted lighting fixtures fixed into the treads or risers of the terraced slope.

name: Orchard
description: A dedicated outdoor space within the building site where fruit trees are systematically planted for cultivation and harvest.

name: Fruit Tree Planting Pit
description: The excavated and prepared ground location within the site where an individual fruit tree is set into the earth.

name: Fruit Tree Root Barrier
description: A physical underground barrier installed around fruit trees to prevent root encroachment into building foundations, paths, or underground services.

name: Fruit Tree Support Structure
description: A fixed system of stakes, posts, wires, or trellises that supports fruit tree growth and branch training within the landscape.

name: Fruit Tree Irrigation System
description: A building-integrated or landscape irrigation system delivering water specifically to fruit trees, including drip lines, soaker hoses, or micro-sprinklers.

name: Fruit Tree Protective Caging
description: A fixed enclosure or cage around young fruit trees to protect them from animals and mechanical damage.

name: Fruit Tree Mulch Bed
description: The organic or inorganic mulch layer placed around the base of fruit trees to retain moisture and suppress weeds.

name: Tree Pit Grate
description: A metal or composite grate installed flush with the ground surface around a fruit tree to protect the root zone while allowing water and air penetration.

name: Espalier Trellis System
description: A wall-mounted or freestanding fixed framework for training fruit trees into a flat, two-dimensional form against a building facade or garden wall.

name: Fruit Tree Soakaway Drain
description: A subsurface drainage feature that directs excess water away from fruit tree roots to prevent waterlogging.

name: Interior Courtyard
description: An open-air or roofed courtyard space enclosed within the building volume, often planted with trees as a focal feature.

name: Tree Atrium
description: A multi-story interior space designed to accommodate large trees, typically with a glazed roof or clerestory for daylight.

name: Green Wall / Vertical Garden (tree-adjacent)
description: A vegetated wall system attached to the building structure near tree places, often with integrated irrigation and drainage.

name: Tree Pit (Interior)
description: A below-grade or raised planting container built into the building structure to support tree roots within an interior space.

name: Tree Grate / Cover
description: A fixed metal or perforated cover over an interior tree pit, flush with the finished floor for pedestrian access.

name: Structural Soils / Engineered Soil Mix
description: A compactible soil mix designed to support both tree root growth and pavement loads in building-integrated planting zones.

name: Root Barrier System
description: A sub-surface barrier installed along tree pits to direct root growth away from building foundations and utilities.

name: Irrigation System (Tree-Specific)
description: A fixed plumbing network with drippers or bubbler emitters dedicated to supplying water to interior tree planting.

name: Drainage Layer / Sub-base
description: A granular or geocomposite drainage material placed beneath tree pits to remove excess water from the root zone.

name: Tree Lighting (Integrated)
description: Recessed up-lights or spotlights fixed in the floor or ceiling near the tree to accent the canopy at night.

name: Bench / Seating Around Tree Pit
description: A built-in bench or seat-wall encircling an interior tree pit as an integrated architectural element.

name: Tree Support / Guying System (Temporary)
description: Underground or surface-level guying anchors and straps fixed to the building slab to stabilize a newly planted tree.

name: Soil Moisture Sensor
description: A probe installed in the tree pit soil to monitor moisture levels and trigger irrigation as part of a BMS.

name: Install Interior Tree Pit & Planting
description: On-site construction of the tree pit structure, placement of engineered soil, and planting of the tree within the building.

name: Install Root Barrier & Drainage
description: Installation of sub-surface root barriers and drainage layers within the tree pit during slab or floor build-up construction.

name: Commission Irrigation & Monitoring System
description: Testing and calibration of the tree-specific irrigation supply and soil moisture sensors to ensure proper operation.

name: Wild-Maintained Planting Beds
description: In-ground or raised planting beds designed for intentionally untamed, self-seeding vegetation within the building's site.

name: Untrimmed Hedge Rows
description: Freestanding linear shrub or hedge barriers left unpruned to achieve a natural, wild appearance along property edges.

name: Self-Seeding Groundcover Zone
description: Open soil or mulch areas where spontaneous plant germination is encouraged, forming part of the garden floor.

name: Wildflower Meadow Patch
description: Deliberately uncultivated grassy or herbaceous area within the garden where native wildflowers grow uncontrolled.

name: Naturalistic Pond or Wetland Pocket
description: A built water feature designed to appear unmaintained, supporting aquatic plants and wildlife within the garden.

name: Overgrown Trellis or Pergola
description: A structural framework intended to be densely covered by climbing plants in a seemingly uncontrolled manner.

name: Informal Stone or Gravel Path
description: A meandering, unpaved walkway using loose aggregate or irregular flagstones that blends with the wild aesthetic.

name: Rustic Wooden Garden Bench
description: A fixed, built-in seating element made from unfinished or weathered timber integrated into the garden layout.

name: Rainwater Collection Cistern
description: A building-integrated tank or barrel system capturing roof runoff for passive irrigation of the wild garden.

name: Dry-Laid Retaining Wall
description: A mortared-stone wall built without mortar to hold soil while allowing a natural, weathered appearance.

name: Install Wild-Maintained Planting Beds
description: Construction activity of excavating, edging, and filling planting beds with soil and selected hardy plant stock.

name: Construct Naturalistic Water Feature
description: On-site installation of pond liner, aquatic plants, and recirculation system to create a self-sustaining water pocket.

name: Lay Informal Stone Path
description: Installation of irregular stepping stones or loose gravel over a geotextile base to form a naturalistic walkway.

name: Erect Rustic Trellis Structure
description: On-site assembly and anchoring of timber or metal framework intended to support uncontrolled climbing vegetation.

name: Install Rainwater Harvesting System
description: Integration of roof gutters, downpipes, and a storage cistern with overflow for garden irrigation supply.

name: Build Dry-Laid Stone Wall
description: Stacking and fitting natural stone without mortar to create a retaining or boundary wall with a wild character.

name: Wild Garden Irrigation Drip Network
description: A low-pressure, building-fed tubing system delivering water directly to root zones of untended planting areas.

name: Garden Site Drainage Layer
description: Subsurface aggregate and perforated pipe network preventing waterlogging while supporting the wild garden ecology.

name: Garden Wall Base Foundation
description: The continuous footing or strip foundation that supports the garden wall and transfers loads to the ground.

name: Garden Wall Core
description: The primary structural infill material (e.g., concrete block, cast-in-place concrete, or reinforced masonry) forming the interior of the wall.

name: Garden Wall Facing / Cladding
description: The external visible layer of brick, stone, tile, or other finish material applied to the wall face for appearance and weather protection.

name: Garden Wall Coping
description: The protective capping or capstone installed along the top of the wall to shed water and prevent moisture ingress.

name: Garden Wall Damp-Proof Course
description: A horizontal layer of impermeable membrane or slate built into the wall to prevent rising damp from the ground.

name: Garden Wall Pier / Pilaster
description: A thickened vertical section of the wall that provides additional structural support and visual articulation at intervals or ends.

name: Garden Wall Expansion / Movement Joint
description: A deliberate gap with sealant or filler that allows the wall to accommodate thermal expansion and contraction without cracking.

name: Garden Wall Drainage / Weepholes
description: Small openings or tubes through the wall that allow trapped water to escape from behind the facing to the exterior.

name: Garden Wall Embedded Reinforcement
description: Steel reinforcing bars or mesh cast into or laid within mortar joints to improve tensile strength and crack resistance.

name: Garden Wall Mortar / Jointing
description: The bedding and pointing mortar used to bond masonry units together and seal the joints against weather.

name: Garden Wall Plaster / Render Finish
description: A cementitious or lime-based coating applied to the wall surface for a smooth or textured decorative finish.

name: Garden Wall Insulation Layer
description: Rigid board or cavity insulation integrated into or applied to the wall to improve its thermal performance.

name: Garden Wall Site / Excavation Work
description: Earthmoving and trench excavation along the wall alignment to prepare the ground for the foundation.

name: Garden Wall Foundation Concrete Pour
description: Placement and curing of concrete in the foundation trench to create the load-bearing base strip.

name: Garden Wall Masonry / Block Laying
description: On-site laying and alignment of brick, block, or stone units with mortar to erect the wall structure.

name: Garden Wall Installation of Coping
description: Setting and securing coping stones or precast caps along the top of the completed wall.

name: Garden Wall Application of Render/Finish
description: Trowel-application or spray-application of plaster, render, or coating to the wall face for final finish.

name: Garden Wall Joint Pointing / Tooling
description: Compacting and profiling the mortar joints between masonry units while still green to achieve the desired weather-resistant finish.

name: Garden Wall with Retaining Function
description: A thickened or reinforced garden wall designed to resist lateral earth pressure on one side, acting as a retaining structure.

name: Garden Wall with Gate Opening
description: A formed opening within the wall fitted with a gate frame, hinges, and hardware for pedestrian or vehicle access.

name: Garden Wall Integrated Planter / Seat
description: A built-in planter box or bench seat formed as part of the wall massing, providing landscape integration.

name: Garden Wall Lighting Niche
description: A recess or cavity formed in the wall to accept low-voltage landscape lighting fixtures.

name: Garden Wall with Pier Cap / Ball Finial
description: A decorative ornamental cap or ball finial mounted on the top of a pier for architectural accent.

name: Trellis Framework
description: The structural grid of beams, slats, or latticework that forms the overhead or vertical support for climbing plants and defines the trellised walk enclosure.

name: Trellis Support Posts
description: Vertical structural columns or posts that anchor the trellis framework to the ground or building substrate.

name: Trellis Roof/Canopy
description: The overhead covering layer, which may be open slats, pergola-style beams, or a solid weatherproof roof over the trellis structure.

name: Trellis Walk Floor Surface
description: The paved or decked walking surface within the trellised walk, such as pavers, concrete, stone, tiles, or wood decking.

name: Trellis Walk Base/Substrate
description: The compacted granular base, concrete slab, or structural subfloor beneath the walking surface.

name: Trellis Walk Edge Curbing
description: Border curbs, edging strips, or retaining elements that define the boundary of the walkway surface.

name: Climbing Plant Support System
description: Wires, cables, netting, or tensioned guides attached to the trellis framework specifically for training and supporting climbing vegetation.

name: Trellis Walk Drainage System
description: Surface drains, linear channels, or subsurface drainage installed within or beneath the walk floor to manage rainwater runoff.

name: Trellis Walk Lighting
description: Fixed lighting fixtures integrated into the trellis structure or posts, including path lights, uplights, or string lights.

name: Trellis Walk Integrated Seating
description: Built-in benches or seating elements permanently affixed to the trellis posts or side rails along the walk.

name: Trellis Walk Side Panels/Screens
description: Decorative or privacy screens, louvers, or partial walls attached to the sides of the trellis framework.

name: Pergola Walk
description: A garden walkway covered by an open-beam pergola structure, closely related to trellised walk but typically with heavier timber beams.

name: Arbored Walkway
description: A walkway passing beneath a series of arching arbors or tunnels, closely related to trellised walk in form and planting function.

name: Green Canopy Walk
description: A covered walkway where the roof is formed primarily by dense overhead vegetation trained on a support structure.

name: Trellis Walk Construction - Framework Erection
description: On-site assembly and installation of the trellis posts, beams, and latticework into the permanent structure.

name: Trellis Walk Construction - Surface Paving
description: Installation of the floor paving, decking, or surface finish material on the prepared base.

name: Trellis Walk Construction - Planting Support Installation
description: Attachment of wires, trellis netting, or guide cables to the framework for climbing plant training.

name: Trellis Walk Construction - Lighting Installation
description: Mounting and wiring of fixed lighting fixtures into the trellis structure and along the walk path.

name: Trellis Walk Construction - Drainage Installation
description: Placement of surface channels, drains, and subsurface drainage components within the walk floor assembly.

name: Greenhouse Glazing System
description: The transparent or translucent envelope (glass, polycarbonate, or ETFE panels) and its framing that admits sunlight for plant growth.

name: Greenhouse Frame Structure
description: The load-bearing skeleton (aluminum, galvanized steel, or timber) supporting the glazing and resisting wind and snow loads.

name: Greenhouse Foundation
description: The perimeter footing or concrete curb that anchors the greenhouse structure to the ground and provides a thermal break.

name: Greenhouse Environmental Control System
description: Integrated mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems managing temperature, humidity, ventilation, and CO₂ levels inside the greenhouse.

name: Greenhouse Irrigation & Drainage System
description: The fixed piping, drip lines, misters, and floor drains delivering water to plants and removing excess runoff.

name: Greenhouse Shading & Light Control System
description: Motorized interior or exterior roller shades, blackout curtains, or movable louver systems that regulate light intensity and photoperiod.

name: Greenhouse Ventilation System
description: Fixed ridge vents, sidewall vents, louvers, and exhaust fans providing passive or active airflow exchange.

name: Greenhouse Heating System
description: In-floor radiant tubing, unit heaters, or fin-tube radiators that maintain optimal growing temperatures.

name: Greenhouse Benching & Shelving System
description: Fixed or movable metal or plastic bench tables and shelving units that support plant trays at working height.

name: Greenhouse Growing Medium & Containment
description: The built-in raised beds, planting troughs, or flood-floor containment that holds soil, gravel, or hydroponic substrate.

name: Greenhouse Lighting System
description: Supplemental high-intensity grow lights (LED or HPS) installed overhead to extend day length or provide sole-source lighting.

name: Greenhouse Access & Circulation Space
description: Aisles, pathways, and head-house or staging areas within the greenhouse for worker movement and material handling.

name: Greenhouse Emergency Egress & Safety Systems
description: Emergency exits, fire extinguishers, and alarm devices required for occupant safety in a glazed enclosure.

name: Greenhouse Glazing Installation
description: On-site fitting and sealing of glass or polycarbonate panels into the framing system to create the weathertight envelope.

name: Greenhouse Frame Erection
description: On-site assembly and bolting of the structural frame members onto the foundation.

name: Greenhouse Benching Installation
description: On-site placement and anchoring of benching and shelving units onto the greenhouse floor.

name: Greenhouse Irrigation System Installation
description: On-site laying, connection, and testing of fixed irrigation mains, drip lines, and drains within the greenhouse.

name: Greenhouse Environmental System Commissioning
description: On-site calibration and testing of the heating, ventilation, cooling, and lighting control systems to meet grower specifications.

name: Built-in Garden Bench
description: A fixed bench attached to a wall, fence, or raised planter, forming a permanent seating element within the garden space.

name: Planter-Integrated Seat
description: A seating surface built as part of a raised planter edge or retaining wall, combining planting and seating in one fixed assembly.

name: Garden Seat Retaining Wall
description: A low masonry or timber wall designed to function as both a seating surface and a structural earth-retaining element.

name: Pergola-Seat Combination
description: A fixed seating arrangement integrated within the columns or beams of a garden pergola structure.

name: Weatherproof Seat Cushion Storage
description: A built-in compartment or box within or under the garden seat for storing removable cushions, protected from weather.

name: Garden Seat Foundation
description: The concrete or compacted base slab or strip footing supporting the garden seat to prevent settlement and movement.

name: Built-in Seat Lighting
description: Integrated low-voltage LED strip or recessed lights installed under or around the garden seat for ambient illumination.

name: Garden Seat Backrest
description: A fixed vertical panel or slatted element attached to the seat providing lumbar support for seated users.

name: Garden Seat Armrest
description: A fixed horizontal or angled support on one or both ends of the seat for resting arms.

name: Curved or Wrapping Garden Seat
description: A fixed seat following a curved plan layout, often wrapping around a tree pit, planter, or corner of a patio.

name: Stepped Garden Seating
description: A terraced or stepped arrangement of broad treads functioning as amphitheater-style fixed seating on a sloped site.

name: Fire Pit Seat Ring
description: A continuous fixed bench arranged in a full or partial circle around a built-in fire pit or outdoor fireplace.

name: Garden Seat Drainage Layer
description: A gravel or crushed stone layer beneath permeable seat pavers or decking to channel rainwater away from the seating area.

name: Timber Seat Decking
description: The horizontal timber boards or composite planks forming the walking and seating surface of the garden seat assembly.

name: Garden Seat Framing
description: The concealed structural frame of metal or timber joists supporting the seat deck and transferring loads to the foundation.

name: Install Garden Seat Foundation
description: Excavation, formwork placement, and concrete pouring for the base slab or strip footing supporting the garden seat.

name: Assemble and Install Garden Seat Frame
description: Cutting, joining, and fixing the structural timber or metal frame onto the foundation in its final position.

name: Install Seat Decking and Finishes
description: Fixing timber boards, composite planks, or stone slabs onto the frame and applying protective sealant or coating.

name: Install Integrated Seat Lighting
description: Running concealed conduit, mounting LED fixtures, and making electrical connections for the built-in seat lighting.

name: Waterproofing and Drainage Installation
description: Placing the drainage layer, waterproof membrane, and any weepholes to prevent water pooling on or beneath the seat.

name: Raised Planting Bed
description: A contained, elevated soil structure for planting that is built into the garden layout, often with timber, concrete, or metal edging.

name: In-Ground Planting Bed
description: A delineated area of prepared soil at grade level for direct planting of vegetables, typically edged with pavers, bricks, or timber.

name: Garden Irrigation System
description: The fixed network of pipes, drip lines, soaker hoses, and sprinkler heads installed to deliver water to the vegetable beds.

name: Garden Pathway
description: A defined walking surface within or around the vegetable garden, made of gravel, pavers, stepping stones, or compacted aggregate.

name: Garden Edging
description: The fixed border elements such as metal strips, timber sleepers, or concrete curbs that separate planting beds from paths or lawn.

name: Compost Bin Enclosure
description: A built-in, fixed structure housing compost bins, typically made of timber slats, brick, or concrete block integrated into the garden layout.

name: Garden Trellis
description: A fixed vertical framework of wood, metal, or mesh installed to support climbing vegetables such as beans, peas, or tomatoes.

name: Garden Cold Frame
description: A fixed, low transparent-roofed structure built into the garden bed to protect seedlings and extend the growing season.

name: Garden Hose Bib / Water Spigot
description: A fixed outdoor faucet connected to the building's plumbing system, providing water access for garden irrigation.

name: Garden Lighting
description: The fixed outdoor luminaires, conduits, and wiring installed to illuminate the vegetable garden for evening access and aesthetics.

name: Fence / Garden Boundary
description: The fixed perimeter barrier such as timber fencing, wire mesh, or metal railing that encloses the vegetable garden area.

name: Garden Gate
description: A hinged or sliding opening in the garden fence or wall providing controlled access to the vegetable garden.

name: Soil / Growing Medium
description: The engineered or amended topsoil, compost, and mulch placed in planting beds as the growth substrate for vegetables.

name: Garden Mulch Layer
description: A surface layer of organic material such as wood chips, straw, or bark spread over the soil to retain moisture and suppress weeds.

name: Greenhouse / Polytunnel Structure
description: A fixed glazed or polyethylene-covered structure housing vegetable cultivation, with a frame of aluminum, galvanized steel, or timber.

name: Rainwater Harvesting System (Garden)
description: The fixed rain barrels, cisterns, downspout diverters, and connecting pipes that collect roof runoff for garden irrigation.

name: Garden Access Path Base
description: The compacted gravel, crushed stone, or sand sub-base layer beneath garden pathway paving materials.

name: Install Raised Planter Beds
description: On-site assembly and placement of prefabricated or site-built timber, metal, or concrete planter boxes in the designated garden area.

name: Install Irrigation System
description: On-site trenching, laying of pipes, connection to water supply, and installation of drip emitters or sprinklers in the garden beds.

name: Install Garden Edging
description: On-site cutting and placement of border materials to define the perimeter of planting beds and pathways.

name: Install Garden Trellis
description: On-site anchoring and assembly of vertical support structures for climbing vegetables within the planting beds.

name: Prepare and Amend Soil
description: On-site tilling, mixing of compost and conditioners into the existing soil or fill material to create a suitable growing medium.

name: Lay Garden Pathways
description: On-site grading, base preparation, and installation of finished paving materials for garden circulation routes.

name: Install Garden Fence and Gate
description: On-site setting of fence posts, attachment of fencing panels or wire mesh, and installation of gate hardware to enclose the garden.

name: Install Garden Lighting
description: On-site trenching for underground conduit, mounting of outdoor-rated luminaires, and connection to the building's electrical system.

name: Assemble and Glaze Greenhouse
description: On-site foundation preparation, frame erection, and installation of glazing panels or polyethylene covering for a growing structure.

name: Install Rainwater Collection System
description: On-site placement of rain barrels or cisterns, connection to downspouts, and installation of overflow and distribution piping for garden use.

name: Construct Cold Frame
description: On-site building of a low transparent-roofed structure integrated into a garden bed for season extension.

name: Soil Berm / Mound
description: An intentionally raised, sloping earth form built into the garden topography for visual interest or improved drainage.

name: Garden Tool Storage Shed
description: A small fixed building structure within the garden area for storing garden tools and supplies, with foundation and weatherproof enclosure.

name: Compost Storage Bin
description: A built-in container or enclosure integrated into the building fabric for holding organic waste prior to collection or processing.

name: Compost Chute
description: A vertical shaft or duct built into the building structure to allow organic waste to be dropped from upper floors to a central collection or processing area.

name: Compost Collection Room
description: A dedicated room or alcove within the building for storing and managing compost bins before external removal or on-site processing.

name: Compost Ventilation System
description: A mechanical or passive ventilation network installed within the building to manage odors and airflow from compost storage areas and chutes.

name: Compost Access Door
description: A built-in door, hatch, or flap in the building envelope or interior partition providing access to a compost chute or bin for depositing organic waste.

name: Compost Area Floor Drain
description: A floor drain installed in the compost collection room or closet, plumbed into the building's drainage system for washing down the area.

name: Compost Area Wall Finish
description: A non-porous, cleanable wall lining or coating applied to surfaces in the compost storage space to resist moisture and odors.

name: Compost Area Floor Finish
description: A durable, slip-resistant, and cleanable flooring material installed in the compost room to withstand wet cleaning and organic residue.

name: Compost Chute Cleaning Access
description: A built-in access panel or cleanout door on the compost chute, allowing periodic maintenance and cleaning of the shaft interior.

name: Compost Chute Fire Damper
description: A fire-rated damper installed within the compost chute that automatically closes to prevent fire spread between floors.

name: Install Compost Chute System
description: On-site installation of prefabricated compost chute sections, fire dampers, and access doors within the building's vertical shaft.

name: Install Compost Room Finishes
description: On-site application of wall coatings, floor finishes, and sanitary fittings in the designated compost collection room.

name: Install Compost Bin Enclosure
description: On-site assembly and fixing of built-in compost bin cabinetry or screened enclosures within the compost collection room.

name: Commission Compost Room Ventilation
description: On-site testing and balancing of the dedicated ventilation system serving the compost storage area to ensure proper airflow and odor control.

name: Seating alcove
description: A recessed or built-in seating area within an alcove, often with fixed benches or window seats.

name: Display alcove
description: A recessed niche designed to showcase art, artifacts, or merchandise within a wall opening.

name: Window alcove
description: An alcove formed by a projecting bay window or recessed window surround, creating a sheltered nook.

name: Entry alcove
description: A recessed area near an entrance that provides a transitional space for arrival, coat storage, or shoe removal.

name: Prayer alcove (mihrab)
description: A recessed niche in a mosque or religious building wall indicating the direction of prayer.

name: Storage alcove
description: A recessed wall niche fitted with shelving, cabinets, or hooks for organized storage.

name: Fireplace alcove
description: A recessed chimney breast or inglenook area flanking or surrounding a fireplace opening.

name: Kitchen alcove
description: A recessed cooking or pantry niche off a main room, often used in apartment layouts.

name: Alcove lighting
description: Integrated light fixtures installed within or above an alcove to illuminate the recessed area.

name: Alcove shelving
description: Built-in shelves fitted precisely into the alcove recess for storage or display.

name: Alcove architrave/frame
description: The decorative trim or framing surrounding the opening of an alcove niche.

name: Alcove back wall finishing
description: The wall lining, wallpaper, paneling, or tile applied to the rear surface of the alcove.

name: Alcove flooring/step
description: The floor finish or raised step platform within the alcove recess, often differentiated from the main room floor.

name: Alcove curtain track/blind
description: A concealed track or mounting for curtains, blinds, or screens that close off the alcove opening.

name: Alcove construction (drywall/framing)
description: On-site framing and drywall installation to create or fur out an alcove recess in a wall.

name: Alcove trim installation
description: Installation of architraves, moldings, and decorative trim around the alcove opening.

name: Alcove shelf fitting
description: On-site installation of fixed shelving within the alcove recess, including support brackets and leveling.

name: Window Reveal
description: The recessed or splayed opening around a window within the wall thickness, forming the transition between window frame and interior wall surface.

name: Window Seat
description: A built-in bench or seating surface installed within or immediately below a window opening, forming part of the building fabric.

name: Window Lintel
description: The horizontal structural beam spanning the top of a window opening to support the wall above.

name: Window Arch
description: A curved structural element spanning a window opening, typically found in masonry or historic construction, distributing loads above the opening.

name: Window Backing / Blocking
description: Reinforced wood or metal blocking installed within the wall framing around a window opening to provide secure attachment points for trim and hardware.

name: Window Drip Edge / Weathering
description: A projecting lip or groove at the bottom of the window sill or head designed to shed rainwater away from the wall surface.

name: Window Security Bar / Grille
description: Fixed or operable metal bars or grilles installed across a window opening for security, permanently attached to the building structure.

name: Window Opening Control Device
description: A mechanical restrictor or limit stop fixed to the window frame or sash that limits how far a window can open.

name: Window Blind / Shutter Housing
description: A built-in pocket, box, or recess within the wall or window frame that houses retractable blinds, shutters, or shades integrated into the building fabric.

name: Window Boxing / Pelmet
description: A decorative built-in enclosure above or around a window that conceals curtain tracks, blinds, or roller shades as part of the fixed joinery.

name: Window Deflection / Spandrel Panel
description: A fixed opaque or translucent panel adjacent to or below a window, typically in curtain wall systems, forming part of the building envelope.

name: Window Opening Fanlight
description: A hinged or pivoting panel above a door or larger window that opens independently for ventilation, often with its own operating hardware.

name: Window Trim / Casing Installation
description: On-site cutting, fitting, and fastening of interior or exterior trim boards around the window opening to finish the junction between wall and frame.

name: Window Opening Enlargement / Resizing
description: Structural modification of an existing wall opening to accommodate a larger or differently shaped window, including new lintels and framing.

name: Dormer Window
description: A window set vertically into a roof projection that extends from the sloping roof plane, creating additional headroom and light in an attic space.

name: Window Operator / Actuator
description: A mechanical device, often motorized, fixed to the window frame for remote or automated opening and closing of casement or awning windows.

name: Window Sunshade / Brise-soleil
description: A fixed external louvered or perforated panel mounted to the building facade above or around a window to control solar heat gain.

name: Fire barrier
description: Fire-rated wall, floor, or ceiling assembly designed to resist the spread of fire and smoke between compartments.

name: Fire damper
description: Mechanical device within ductwork that closes automatically to prevent fire and smoke spread via HVAC systems.

name: Fire hydrant / standpipe system
description: Building-integrated water supply system with hose connections for firefighter use on each floor.

name: Smoke control system
description: Mechanical system including fans, dampers, and pressurization equipment to manage smoke movement during a fire.

name: Firestop sealant system
description: Intumescent sealants, collars, wraps, and pillows installed at penetrations through fire-rated assemblies.

name: Fire-resistant glazing
description: Specialized glass and framing assemblies rated to resist fire exposure while maintaining visibility.

name: Sprinkler piping installation
description: On-site installation of supply mains, branch lines, risers, and sprinkler heads throughout the building.

name: Fire alarm system commissioning
description: On-site testing, calibration, and verification of all detection, notification, and control devices.

name: Fire door installation
description: On-site fitting and hanging of fire-rated door assemblies including frame anchoring and hardware adjustment.

name: Firestop application
description: On-site installation of firestop materials at all service penetrations through rated assemblies.

name: Restaurant Dining Area
description: The main customer seating area within a commercial food-service establishment, distinct from the kitchen, bar, or service zones.

name: Cafeteria Serving Line
description: The linear circulation and service zone where food is presented and dispensed to diners, including counter, sneeze-guard, and tray-slide elements.

name: Private Dining Room
description: A smaller, enclosed dining space adjacent to a main dining area, designed for reserved groups or special events.

name: Break Room / Lunchroom
description: A casual, often smaller space within an office or workplace for employees to eat meals and take breaks.

name: Food Court Seating Area
description: A shared, multi-vendor seating zone in a shopping mall or transit hub, typically furnished with communal tables and fixed seating.

name: Banquet Hall
description: A large, formal event space designed primarily for seated meal service for celebrations, conferences, or receptions.

name: Café / Coffee Shop Seating
description: An informal, smaller-scale seating area within a beverage-focused retail establishment, often with a mix of table and lounge seating.

name: Bar / Pub Dining Area
description: An eating zone integrated into or adjacent to a bar counter, typically featuring high-top tables, stools, or booth seating.

name: Dining Room (Residential)
description: A dedicated room within a dwelling unit, formally set apart from the kitchen and living areas, used for family meals.

name: Kitchen-Dining Combo / Great Room
description: An open-plan combined kitchen and dining area within a dwelling, where the dining zone is a contiguous part of a larger living space.

name: Outdoor Dining Patio / Terrace
description: An exterior paved or decked area adjacent to a building, designed and equipped for al fresco eating with fixed or site-anchored furniture.

name: Dining Counter / Breakfast Bar
description: A fixed elevated counter with seating on one side, integrated into a kitchen island or peninsular, serving as an informal dining surface.

name: Built-in Dining Banquette
description: A fixed bench seat attached to a wall or corner, often with a backrest and upholstered cushion, designed for sit-down dining.

name: Fixed Dining Table
description: A permanently anchored table surface in a food-court, restaurant, or cafeteria setting, often with attached or non-relocatable legs.

name: Dining Chair / Stool (Fixed)
description: A permanently attached or building-integrated seat intended for use at a dining table or counter.

name: Sneeze Guard / Food Shield
description: A fixed transparent barrier mounted above a serving counter to protect displayed food from airborne contaminants.

name: Tray Slide / Tray Rail
description: A fixed stainless-steel or plastic rail system attached to a cafeteria serving counter for sliding trays along the line.

name: Dining Area Lighting
description: The overhead and accent lighting fixtures dedicated to illuminating dining surfaces and creating ambiance in an eating space.

name: Dining Area HVAC Diffuser / Vent
description: Air supply or return grilles located in the dining zone, designed for occupant comfort and to manage food odors.

name: Dining Floor Finish
description: The durable, cleanable flooring material (tile, vinyl, sealed concrete, hardwood) installed in an eating area to withstand spills and foot traffic.

name: Wall Wainscot / Chair Rail (Dining)
description: A protective wall finish or rail installed in dining spaces to shield walls from chair backs and food splatter.

name: Condiment / Service Station
description: A fixed counter or kiosk in a cafeteria or fast-food setting for self-service condiments, napkins, and utensils.

name: Acoustic Ceiling Treatment (Dining)
description: Sound-absorbing ceiling panels or baffles installed specifically to control noise levels in a busy eating environment.

name: Dining Table Electrical / Data Outlet
description: Floor-box, table-column, or in-table power and data outlets installed to serve electronic devices at dining seats.

name: Install Dining Banquette Framing
description: On-site assembly and attachment of the structural wood or steel frame for a built-in dining banquette.

name: Install Fixed Dining Tables
description: On-site anchoring of pre-fabricated dining table bases or pedestals to the floor slab in food-court or restaurant settings.

name: Lay Dining Room Flooring
description: Installation of the specified floor finish material in a dining space, including underlayment and sealing.

name: Install Dining Area Lighting Fixtures
description: Mounting, wiring, and commissioning of pendant lights, chandeliers, or recessed luminaires in the dining zone.

name: Install Sneeze Guards / Service Counters
description: On-site mounting of transparent food-shield panels and assembly of cafeteria serving counter components.

name: Install Tray Slide / Rail System
description: Attachment of tray-slide rails to the top of a cafeteria serving counter, including end stops and transition pieces.

name: Frame and Finish Dining Nook
description: On-site framing, drywall, and trim work to create a dedicated alcove or nook for dining within a residential or commercial space.

name: Workstation
description: An individual or shared desk area with integrated data/ power provisions, often part of an open-plan layout.

name: HVAC Diffuser
description: An air distribution device integrated into the ceiling or floor for supplying conditioned air to the workspace.

name: Window / Glazed Panel
description: A fixed or operable glazed opening in the enclosure wall providing natural light and visual connection to adjacent spaces.

name: Workspace Door
description: A hinged or sliding door providing controlled access into and out of the workspace enclosure.

name: Data/Electrical Outlet
description: A floor, wall, or furniture-integrated outlet providing power and network connectivity to workstations.

name: Built-in Storage Unit
description: A fixed cabinet, shelving, or filing system integrated into the workspace enclosure for document and equipment storage.

name: Integrated Desk Seating
description: Fixed or building-integrated seating (e.g., auditorium-style workbenches with attached chairs) within the workspace.

name: Privacy Booth
description: A small enclosed or partially enclosed phone booth or focus room integrated into the open workspace.

name: Install Partition System
description: On-site assembly and erection of demountable or stud partitions to define workspace boundaries.

name: Install Raised Floor
description: On-site installation of pedestals, panels, and floor tiles to create the accessible raised floor system.

name: Install Suspended Ceiling
description: On-site fixing of ceiling grid, tiles, and associated services integration for the dropped ceiling.

name: Commission Lighting Controls
description: On-site testing, programming, and calibration of lighting zone controls and daylight harvesting sensors.

name: Meeting Room
description: An enclosed space within or adjacent to the workspace for group collaboration, equipped with AV and furniture.

name: Breakout Space
description: An informal lounge or casual seating area integrated within the workspace enclosure for breaks and impromptu meetings.

name: Kitchen island
description: A freestanding or built-in countertop unit in the center of a cooking layout, providing preparation surface, storage, and often integrated appliances.

name: Cooktop zone
description: The designated area within the cooking layout containing the cooktop or range, with required clearance and ventilation provisions.

name: Preparation counter
description: A continuous work surface for food preparation, typically between sink and cooktop, with under-counter storage.

name: Ventilation hood
description: A building-integrated exhaust appliance mounted above the cooktop to remove smoke, steam, and cooking odors.

name: Sink zone
description: The area within the cooking layout dedicated to the sink, including surrounding counter space and drainage provisions.

name: Cooking layout cabinetry
description: Built-in storage units (base, wall, and tall cabinets) forming the primary storage system within the cooking layout.

name: Cooking layout lighting
description: Fixed lighting system including under-cabinet task lights and overhead fixtures specifically serving the cooking layout.

name: Galley layout
description: A linear cooking layout variant with counters and appliances along one or two parallel walls in a corridor configuration.

name: L-shaped layout
description: A cooking layout variant arranged along two adjacent walls forming an L, creating an efficient work triangle.

name: U-shaped layout
description: A cooking layout variant with counters and appliances along three walls, enclosing the workspace on three sides.

name: One-wall layout
description: A cooking layout variant with all counters, appliances, and storage aligned along a single wall.

name: Install cooking layout cabinetry
description: On-site assembly and fixing of base, wall, and tall cabinets to the building structure and walls.

name: Install countertops
description: On-site placement, joining, and securing of countertop slabs or laminates onto base cabinets.

name: Install cooking appliances
description: On-site positioning, leveling, and connection of built-in cooking appliances (range, oven, cooktop) to building services.

name: Install ventilation hood
description: On-site mounting of the exhaust hood to underside of cabinet or ceiling and connection to ductwork.

name: Install cooking layout lighting
description: On-site mounting and wiring of under-cabinet task lights and overhead fixtures serving the cooking layout.

name: Fixed Auditorium/Stadium Seating
description: Row-mounted tiered seats permanently installed to form a stepped or sloped sitting circle.

name: Integrated Side/End Tables
description: Fixed tabletops or ledges attached to seating or walls within the circle for user convenience.

name: Reception/Concierge Desk
description: Built-in counter and workspace serving as the focal point or entry station of the sitting circle.

name: Modular Platform/Deck Base
description: Raised floor platform or tiered deck structure forming the geometric base of the sitting circle.

name: Integrated Power & Data Outlets
description: Floor, seat-arm, or wall-mounted receptacles for electrical and data connectivity built into the circle.

name: Sitting Circle Floor Finish
description: Specialized flooring material (carpet, rubber, wood) within the circle area, often patterned or demarcated.

name: Railing/Guardrail System
description: Fixed barriers at the perimeter or between tiers of the sitting circle for safety and access control.

name: Acoustic Wall/Backdrop Panel
description: Sound-absorbing wall panels or curved backdrop walls defining the rear boundary of the sitting circle.

name: Lighting System (Circle-Specific)
description: Dedicated overhead, step, or cove lighting fixtures integrated into the sitting circle layout.

name: Step/Tread Construction
description: Stair treads or risers forming the stepped seating levels within a tiered sitting circle.

name: Sitting Circle Framing Structure
description: Load-bearing steel or timber frame supporting elevated seating platforms within the circle.

name: Install Seating Platforms
description: On-site assembly and fixing of tiered or flat platform framing for the sitting circle base.

name: Install Fixed Seating Units
description: On-site mounting and anchorage of individual or row seating to the prepared platform.

name: Install Guardrails & Handrails
description: On-site erection and securing of safety railings around the perimeter of the sitting circle.

name: Install Circle Lighting
description: On-site mounting and connection of step, cove, and overhead lighting fixtures for the circle.

name: Apply Floor Finish to Circle
description: On-site installation of carpet, rubber, or other floor covering within the bounded circle area.

name: Landscaped/Green Sitting Circle
description: Outdoor or atrium sitting circle incorporating integrated planter beds and vegetation within the seating layout.

name: Fireplace/Hearth Circle
description: Sitting circle arranged around a fixed fireplace or hearth as the central architectural feature.

name: Lecture/Tiered Teaching Circle
description: Stepped sitting circle in an educational setting with integrated tablet arms or writing ledges.

name: Meditation/Quiet Circle
description: Enclosed, acoustically treated sitting circle designed for quiet reflection with dimmable lighting.

name: Collaborative Breakout Circle
description: Smaller sitting circle within an open office with whiteboard surfaces and monitor mounts integrated.

name: Dormitory Room
description: A room with multiple beds arranged for communal sleeping, typically in hostels, barracks, or shelters.

name: Bunk Bed System
description: Built-in or fixed multi-tier bed frames designed to maximize sleeping capacity within a communal floor plan.

name: Privacy Curtain Track System
description: Overhead tracks and fixed curtain systems mounted to ceiling or partitions for individual bed privacy.

name: Communal Locker Unit
description: Built-in fixed lockers or storage compartments for personal belongings adjacent to sleeping areas.

name: Sleeping Partition Wall
description: Fixed or semi-fixed low walls dividing a large room into individual sleeping bays without full enclosure.

name: Night Lighting System
description: Low-level ambient and individual task lighting circuit installed for nighttime visibility without disturbing sleepers.

name: Ventilation Zone Partition
description: Ducted or louvered partitions that allow shared HVAC airflow while maintaining visual separation between sleeping stations.

name: Emergency Egress Clearance
description: On-site layout verification and marking of unobstructed pathways between sleeping stations to meet fire code egress requirements.

name: Bunk Frame Installation
description: On-site assembly and anchoring of fixed multi-tier bed frames to floor and wall structure.

name: Sleeping Area Acoustic Treatment
