description: Installation of sound-absorbing panels, sealants, and isolation measures to reduce noise between sleeping stations.

name: Mosquito Net Mounting System
description: Fixed ceiling hooks, rods, or tracks for hanging insect netting above each sleeping station.

name: Sleeping Platform Railing
description: Fixed guardrails or balustrades along elevated sleeping platforms to prevent falls during sleep.

name: Bed Frame
description: The structural framework supporting the mattress and bedding, typically built-in or fixed to the floor or wall.

name: Mattress Support Base
description: The slatted base, box spring, or platform that directly supports the mattress within the marriage bed.

name: Headboard
description: The vertical panel fixed to the wall or bed frame at the sleeping head end, often built into the room joinery.

name: Footboard
description: The vertical panel at the foot end of the bed, either freestanding or integrated into built-in joinery.

name: Built-in Bedside Tables
description: Fixed shelving or cabinetry flanking the bed, integrated into the wall or bed frame structure.

name: Bed Canopy Structure
description: Overhead frame or ceiling-mounted rails for draping fabric, permanently fixed to the building structure.

name: Under-bed Storage Drawers
description: Built-in pull-out drawers fitted into the void beneath the bed platform for storage.

name: Bed Lighting System
description: Fixed lighting fixtures integrated into the headboard, canopy, or wall adjacent to the bed for reading and ambiance.

name: Bed Electrical Provisions
description: Built-in electrical outlets, USB ports, and wiring conduits installed within or adjacent to the bed frame.

name: Wall Paneling Behind Bed
description: Decorative fixed paneling or cladding on the wall directly behind the headboard, part of the interior finish.

name: Sleeping Platform/Deck
description: A raised fixed platform built into the room floor that replaces a conventional bed frame.

name: Bed Joinery Fabrication
description: On-site cutting, assembly, and installation of custom built-in bed cabinetry and joinery components.

name: Bed Frame Fixing and Anchoring
description: On-site securing of bed frame to floor, wall, or substrate using brackets, bolts, and anchors.

name: Integrated Mattress Installation
description: Placement of mattresses onto the built-in bed platform or slatted base as part of final fit-out.

name: Bed Electrical Rough-in
description: Installation of wiring, conduit, and outlet boxes for bed-related electrical provisions during construction.

name: Canopy Structure Installation
description: On-site mounting and securing of canopy rails or ceiling brackets for overhead bed draping.

name: Bed Alcove Structure
description: The enclosing wall, partition, or partial-height screen that defines the physical boundaries of the bed alcove.

name: Bed Alcove Ceiling
description: The ceiling plane over the alcove, which may be lowered, coffered, or finished differently than the main room ceiling.

name: Bed Alcove Floor
description: The floor area within the alcove, often finished with a distinct material such as carpet, wood, or tile.

name: Bed Alcove Lighting
description: Integrated lighting fixtures including recessed downlights, wall sconces, task lights, or cove lighting specifically serving the alcove.

name: Bed Alcove Electrical Outlets
description: Built-in power and data outlets installed within the alcove walls for bedside device charging and connectivity.

name: Built-in Bed Platform
description: A fixed or platform base within the alcove that supports the mattress, which may include integrated storage drawers.

name: Bed Alcove Storage
description: Built-in shelves, cabinets, or niches within the alcove walls or beneath the bed platform for organized storage.

name: Bed Alcove Curtain Track
description: A ceiling- or wall-mounted track system for privacy curtains or drapes that can enclose the alcove.

name: Bed Alcove Headboard Wall
description: The wall at the head of the alcove, often finished with an upholstered panel, wood slats, or accent material.

name: Bed Alcove Privacy Screen
description: A fixed or sliding partition, door, or curtain that visually or acoustically separates the alcove from the adjacent space.

name: Alcove Bed
description: The built-in or fitted bed frame and mattress assembly designed specifically for the alcove dimensions, distinct from a loose bed.

name: Bed Alcove HVAC Register
description: A supply or return air grille integrated into the alcove ceiling or wall for heating, ventilation, and air conditioning.

name: Bed Alcove Smoke Detector
description: A fire safety detection device installed within the alcove as required by building codes for sleeping spaces.

name: Bed Alcove Emergency Egress Window
description: An operable window or door within the alcove providing a means of emergency escape and rescue access.

name: Bed Alcove Construction
description: On-site assembly and installation of wall partitions, bed platform, and all built-in components defining the alcove.

name: Bed Alcove MEP Rough-In
description: Installation of electrical wiring, outlet boxes, lighting conduits, and HVAC ductwork within the alcove prior to finish work.

name: Bed Alcove Finish Installation
description: Application of final surface finishes including paint, wallcovering, flooring, trim, and headboard panel within the alcove.

name: Dressing Table
description: A built-in or fixed vanity counter with mirror and lighting for grooming activities in a dressing room.

name: Wardrobe/Closet
description: A fixed storage unit for hanging and organizing clothing within the dressing room.

name: Built-in Shelving
description: Fixed shelves for folded clothing, accessories, or shoe storage integrated into the dressing room walls.

name: Drawer Bank
description: A set of built-in drawers for storing smaller personal items and folded garments.

name: Dressing Room Seating
description: Fixed bench, ottoman, or built-in seating for use while dressing or putting on shoes.

name: Full-Length Mirror
description: A wall-mounted or floor-to-ceiling mirror allowing full-body viewing during dressing.

name: Jewelry/Valet Organizer
description: Small built-in drawer inserts or wall-mounted trays for organizing watches, jewelry, and accessories.

name: Valet Rod/Tie Rack
description: A pull-out or fixed rod for hanging suits, ties, or next-day outfits.

name: Shoe Rack/Shoe Storage
description: Fixed racks, cubbies, or slanted shelves dedicated to organized shoe storage.

name: Island Dressing Table
description: A freestanding but built-in central counter with drawers and surface space in larger dressing rooms.

name: Dressing Room Lighting
description: Integrated ambient, task, and accent lighting including vanity lights, cove lighting, and dimmable fixtures.

name: Dressing Room Ventilation
description: HVAC supply and exhaust registers integrated into the space to maintain air quality in an often enclosed room.

name: His-and-Hers Split Layout
description: A dressing room configuration with dual wardrobes and vanities on opposite sides for two occupants.

name: Walk-In Dressing Room
description: A fully enclosed room large enough to walk into with perimeter storage and central circulation.

name: Pass-Through Dressing Room
description: A linear dressing space connecting bedroom to bathroom with wardrobes along one or both sides.

name: Dressing Room Partition Wall
description: Interior wall construction separating the dressing room from adjacent spaces such as the bedroom or bathroom.

name: Dressing Room Door
description: A hinged or sliding door providing privacy and access between the dressing room and adjacent rooms.

name: Installing Dressing Room Joinery
description: On-site installation of custom fixed cabinetry, wardrobes, dressing tables, and shelving units.

name: Installing Mirror Systems
description: Mounting and securing full-length and vanity mirrors to walls or cabinetry within the dressing room.

name: Installing Dressing Room Lighting
description: Wiring and mounting of vanity lights, cove lighting, and dimmer switches specific to the dressing room.

name: Uniform Ceiling Height
description: A space where the ceiling is at a single consistent height across the entire room area.

name: Stepped Ceiling
description: A ceiling composed of two or more discrete horizontal planes at different heights, creating a tiered effect.

name: Sloped Ceiling
description: A ceiling that follows a single inclined plane, typically under a pitched roof, with height varying from low to high end.

name: Sawtooth Ceiling
description: A ceiling composed of a series of ridges with asymmetric slopes, often incorporating vertical glazing for daylighting.

name: Dropped Ceiling Section
description: A localized lowered ceiling area created by a suspended ceiling grid or soffit, often concealing ductwork or services.

name: Ceiling Height Transition Trim
description: A finishing profile or molding installed where two different ceiling heights meet, providing a clean visual transition.

name: Ceiling Height Measurement Point
description: A designated reference point or annotation in documentation indicating the finished ceiling height at a specific location.

name: Variable Height Ceiling Installation
description: On-site installation of ceiling systems involving multiple elevation changes, including framing stepped soffits and dropped sections.

name: Ceiling Height Verification Survey
description: On-site measurement and documentation of actual ceiling heights against design intent to ensure compliance.

name: Room Enclosure Surfaces
description: The walls, floors, and ceilings that physically bound and define the interior volume of a space.

name: Indoor Spatial Zones
description: Subdivisions within a larger indoor space defined by function, occupancy, or fire compartmentation (e.g., office zones, circulation zones, service zones).

name: Floor-To-Floor Height Clearance
description: The vertical dimension between finished floor and finished ceiling that establishes the usable volume of the indoor space.

name: Spatial Grid & Layout
description: The modular planning grid, column grid, and partition layout that organizes the subdivision of the indoor floor plate.

name: Ceiling Geometry & Finish
description: The soffit surface overhead, including dropped ceilings, exposed structure, vaults, or coffered treatments that shape the top boundary of the space.

name: Floor Geometry & Finish
description: The walking surface including level changes, stepped floors, ramps, or sunken areas that shape the bottom boundary of the space.

name: Wall Geometry & Finish
description: The vertical boundary surfaces including straight, curved, angled, or faceted wall configurations that define the perimeter of the indoor space.

name: Indoor-Outdoor Transition Zone
description: Intermediate spaces such as atriums, conservatories, or glazed lobbies where the boundary between inside and outside is blurred by extensive glazing.

name: Void & Atrium Spaces
description: Multi-storey openings or shafts within the building volume that create vertical spatial continuity and visual connection between floors.

name: Structural Columns Within Space
description: Vertical structural elements that penetrate the indoor volume and influence spatial subdivision, sightlines, and furniture layout.

name: Interior Partition Installation
description: On-site erection of non-load-bearing walls and partitions to subdivide the indoor space into functional rooms and zones.

name: Floor Finishing & Leveling
description: On-site application of screed, underlayment, and floor coverings to establish the finished walking surface geometry of the indoor space.

name: Spatial Commissioning & Tolerances Check
description: On-site verification that as-built room dimensions, clearances, and volumes meet the design specifications and spatial requirements.

name: Window Sill Plant Shelf
description: A fixed horizontal ledge or integrated shelf within or below the window frame designed to support living plants.

name: Integrated Planter Box
description: A built-in, waterproof container affixed to the window frame or adjacent wall for holding soil and plants.

name: Window Box Support Bracket
description: A fixed metal or timber bracket installed beneath the window to support an external planter box.

name: Internal Green Wall Frame
description: A vertical structure mounted against the window or adjacent wall with integrated irrigation for climbing or hanging plants.

name: Trellis or Climbing Support Frame
description: A fixed grid or lattice attached to the window frame or exterior wall for vine plants to grow across the window.

name: Biophilic Window System
description: A multi-layered window assembly incorporating integrated plant pockets, irrigation channels, and drainage within the frame.

name: Self-Watering Reservoir Tray
description: A built-in water collection and wicking tray integrated into the window sill or planter box for passive irrigation.

name: Window-Integrated Drip Irrigation Line
description: A fixed plumbing line routed through the window frame or wall to supply water to plants at the window.

name: Living Window Curtain System
description: A ceiling or wall-mounted track system supporting hanging plants that serve as a living curtain over the window.

name: Window Overhang / Shading Louvres for Plants
description: Fixed external shading elements mounted above the window to control sunlight exposure for plants placed on the sill or in boxes.

name: Glazing with Integrated UV-Filter Coating
description: Glass panes with a spectrally selective coating that filters ultraviolet light to protect living plants behind the window.

name: Drainage Layer / Geotextile Mat
description: A permeable fabric or perforated mat installed within planter boxes to separate soil from drainage gravel.

name: Window-to-Greenwall Transition Seal
description: A weather-resistant gasket or flashing that seals the joint between the window frame and an adjacent green wall structure.

name: Operable Casement with Plant Access Hatch
description: A hinged window sash section that opens to allow direct access for tending to plants on the exterior sill or box.

name: Install Window Sill Planter Box
description: On-site fixing and waterproofing of a built-in planter box onto the window sill or sub-sill structure.

name: Install Window-Integrated Irrigation Supply
description: On-site routing and connection of a water supply line from the building's plumbing to a window-mounted irrigation system.

name: Install Living Curtain Track System
description: On-site mounting of ceiling or wall tracks and hangers for hanging plants in front of a window.

name: Commission Green Wall Watering System
description: On-site testing and calibration of integrated irrigation controls, drainage, and moisture sensors for plants at the window.

name: Seal Window-Planter Waterproof Membrane
description: On-site application and curing of a liquid waterproof membrane at the junction between the window frame and the built-in planter.

name: Half-open Wall Frame
description: The structural or supporting framework (studs, tracks, posts) that defines the half-open wall's shape and load-bearing capacity.

name: Half-open Wall Cladding
description: The partial surface covering applied to one or both sides of the half-open wall frame, leaving a deliberate opening or gap.

name: Half-open Wall Opening
description: The designated unenclosed or glazed portion of the half-open wall that provides visual or physical connectivity between adjacent spaces.

name: Half-open Wall Insulation
description: Thermal or acoustic insulation installed within the wall cavity where the wall is fully enclosed.

name: Half-open Wall Glazing
description: Fixed or operable glass panels fitted into the opening portion of the half-open wall for light transmission and weather protection.

name: Half-open Wall Built-in Bench
description: A fixed seating element integrated into the lower portion of the half-open wall, often using the wall frame as support.

name: Half-open Wall Counter/Desk Top
description: A horizontal work surface built into the half-open wall at counter height for pass-through or reception functions.

name: Half-open Wall Sill
description: The horizontal member at the base of the opening in the half-open wall that transitions between the enclosed and open portions.

name: Half-open Wall Head Beam
description: The horizontal structural member spanning the top of the opening in the half-open wall to transfer loads to the supporting frame.

name: Half-open Wall Fabrication and Installation
description: On-site assembly, fitting, and securing of the half-open wall components into the building structure.

name: Half-open Wall Glazing Installation
description: On-site placement, setting, and sealing of glass panels within the opening of the half-open wall.

name: Half-open Wall Built-in Furniture Installation
description: On-site installation of fixed benches, counters, or desks that are incorporated into the half-open wall assembly.

name: Half-open Wall Finishing
description: On-site application of paints, sealants, trims, and surface treatments to complete the half-open wall assembly.

name: Interior Window Frame
description: The structural perimeter framing that holds the interior window glazing in place within an interior partition.

name: Interior Window Glazing
description: The glass or transparent panel assembly set into an interior window frame, which may be clear, frosted, tinted, or laminated.

name: Interior Window Sill
description: The horizontal ledge at the bottom of an interior window, typically finished with wood, stone, or metal to match interior trim.

name: Interior Window Header/Transom
description: The horizontal structural or decorative element above an interior window, often used for ventilation or borrowed light above doors.

name: Fixed Interior Window
description: A non-operable interior window panel installed within a partition wall for light transmission without ventilation.

name: Operable Interior Window (Casement/Sliding)
description: An interior window that can be opened via hinges or sliding tracks to allow air movement between interior spaces.

name: Interior Window Mullion
description: The vertical divider bar between adjacent interior window panels or panes within a single opening.

name: Interior Window Hardware
description: Handles, latches, locks, and hinge mechanisms specifically for operating and securing interior windows.

name: Interior Window Weatherstripping
description: Compressible seals applied to operable interior window edges to control airflow, sound, and dust between rooms.

name: Interior Window Trim/Casing
description: Decorative molding or architrave that covers the joint between the interior window frame and the surrounding wall surface.

name: Borrowed Light Window
description: An interior window installed in an interior wall strictly to pass daylight from an adjacent space, typically with fixed glazing.

name: Interior Window Installation
description: On-site placement, leveling, and fastening of the interior window frame into a rough opening within a partition wall.

name: Interior Window Glazing Installation
description: On-site setting of glass panels into the prepared interior window frame with gaskets or glazing beads.

name: Interior Window Sealing & Trim Installation
description: Application of sealants and attachment of casing/trim around the installed interior window to finish the wall opening.

name: Interior Window with Integrated Blind (Between-Glass)
description: A sealed interior window unit containing a manually operated or motorized blind between two panes of glass.

name: Interior Pass-Through Window
description: A counter-height interior window that opens to allow the passing of items between rooms, common in food service or reception areas.

name: Interior Window Frame Anchors/Fasteners
description: Metal clips, brackets, or screws used to secure the interior window frame to the surrounding wall structure.

name: Intermediate Landing
description: A landing located between floor levels where the stair changes direction, often 90 or 180 degrees.

name: Half-Landing
description: A landing that spans the full width of the stairwell at a point where the stair reverses direction by 180 degrees.

name: Stair Enclosure Wall
description: The fire-rated walls surrounding the staircase volume that provide structural support and fire compartmentation.

name: Stair Enclosure Door
description: A fire-rated door assembly providing access into and out of the protected stair enclosure at each floor level.

name: Stair Lighting
description: The dedicated lighting fixtures illuminating the stair treads, landings, and enclosure for safe egress and visibility.

name: Stair Ventilation System
description: The natural or mechanical smoke control system serving the staircase volume for pressurization and smoke evacuation during a fire.

name: Monumental Stair
description: A wide, grand staircase often with decorative materials and open risers, serving as a primary architectural feature in lobbies.

name: Scissor Stair
description: Two interlocking stair flights within a single enclosure that share a common fire-rated wall, providing dual means of egress.

name: Stair Construction Activity
description: On-site assembly, pouring, welding, or erection of stair components including setting stringers, installing treads and risers, and attaching balustrades.

name: Stair Finishing Activity
description: Application of stair tread coatings, anti-slip nosings, wall finishes, and paint or sealant to the completed staircase.

name: Handrail Installation
description: On-site fitting, anchoring, and alignment of handrails and balustrades to stringers, walls, or newel posts.

name: Stair Stairwell Fireproofing
description: Application of fire-resistive spray or board materials to structural stair components and enclosure walls to achieve required fire rating.

name: Corner Door Frame
description: The structural frame assembly specifically configured for corner-mounted door openings, providing support and attachment points at the building corner.

name: Corner Door Leaf
description: The swinging or sliding door panel(s) installed at a building corner, typically hinged at the corner axis or sliding along the corner line.

name: Corner Pivot Hinge Set
description: Specialized hinge hardware allowing a door leaf to pivot at the building corner rather than along a conventional jamb edge.

name: Corner Door Hardware
description: Locks, handles, closers, and strike plates designed for corner door configurations where traditional jamb-mounted hardware is infeasible.

name: Corner Door Weatherseal
description: Continuous gasketing and sweep seals arranged along the non-standard perimeter of a corner door opening to maintain thermal and weather integrity.

name: Corner Door Fixed Glazing Panel
description: A stationary glass panel flanking the corner door leaf to complete the corner enclosure while providing visibility and light.

name: Corner Door Sill/Threshold
description: The bottom transition piece spanning the corner door opening, managing water drainage and level changes at an angled door location.

name: Corner Door Installation
description: On-site fitting and securing of corner door assemblies into prepared rough openings at building corners, including frame shimming and anchoring.

name: Corner Door Hardware Adjustment & Commissioning
description: Field tuning of corner door hinges, closers, and locks to ensure proper swing, alignment, and latching at the non-standard corner geometry.

name: Revolving Corner Door
description: A revolving door assembly installed at a building corner, using the corner geometry to create a multi-chambered entrance system.

name: Folding Corner Door
description: A multi-panel bi-fold or accordion door system following a corner track, allowing a wide opening to wrap around the building corner.

name: Sliding Corner Door
description: A sliding door system where panels travel along corner-mounted tracks, pocketing into adjacent wall cavities at the corner.

name: Corner Door Leaf Material (Wood)
description: Timber or engineered wood door leaf fabricated with corner-specific joinery to resist racking at the angled installation point.

name: Corner Door Leaf Material (Metal)
description: Steel or aluminum door leaf formed with corner-specific reinforcing to maintain rigidity at the non-standard hanging location.

name: Corner Door Leaf Material (Glass)
description: Tempered or laminated glass door leaf with corner fittings designed for pivot or hinge attachment at the building corner.

name: Thick Wall Construction Types
description: Variants of thick wall assemblies including solid masonry, cavity wall, rammed earth, timber-laced, and composite build-ups.

name: Loadbearing Thick Wall
description: A thick wall designed to carry vertical structural loads from floors, roofs, or other superstructure elements.

name: Non-Loadbearing Thick Wall
description: A thick wall that serves as infill, partition, or enclosure without bearing structural loads above.

name: Thick Wall Insulation Layer
description: Continuous or cavity-fill insulation material integrated within or applied to the thick wall assembly to improve thermal performance.

name: Thick Wall Vapour Barrier
description: A membrane layer placed within the thick wall to control moisture diffusion and prevent interstitial condensation.

name: Thick Wall Waterproofing Membrane
description: An applied or integral waterproofing layer on below-grade or exposed thick walls to resist water ingress.

name: Thick Wall Reinforcement
description: Steel bars, mesh, or fibre reinforcement embedded within masonry or concrete thick walls for structural integrity.

name: Thick Wall Tie/Connector
description: Metal or synthetic ties connecting multiple wythes or leaves of a thick wall to ensure composite action and stability.

name: Thick Wall Opening Lintel
description: A beam or arch spanning an opening in a thick wall to transfer loads above to the adjacent wall sections.

name: Thick Wall Foundation
description: The strip or continuous footing that supports a thick wall and transfers loads to the ground.

name: Thick Wall Plaster/Finish
description: Applied internal or external render, plaster, or cladding that forms the finished surface of the thick wall.

name: Thick Wall Coping/Parapet
description: The top closure element on an exposed thick wall providing weather protection and aesthetic finish.

name: Thick Wall Construction Activity
description: On-site laying, assembling, or forming of thick wall materials including blockwork, bricklaying, formwork, and pouring.

name: Thick Wall Insulation Installation
description: On-site placement and fixing of insulation boards, batts, or blown material within the thick wall assembly.

name: Thick Wall Waterproofing Application
description: On-site application of waterproof coatings, sheet membranes, or tanking systems to thick walls.

name: Thick Wall Reinforcement Installation
description: On-site placing and tying of reinforcement within a thick wall prior to concrete pouring or mortar laying.

name: Thick Wall Finish Application
description: On-site rendering, plastering, or cladding of thick wall surfaces to achieve final finish and protection.

name: Thick Wall Damp-proof Course Installation
description: On-site insertion of a damp-proof course layer within a thick wall to prevent rising damp.

name: Closet Partition Walls
description: Light-framed or stud walls that enclose and define the closet space between rooms.

name: Closet Door
description: The door assembly (hinged, sliding, bifold, or pocket) providing access to the closet from either side.

name: Closet Shelving
description: Fixed or adjustable shelves installed within the closet for organized storage.

name: Closet Rod/Hanging Rail
description: A horizontal metal or wood bar mounted to support hanging garments within the closet.

name: Closet Floor Finish
description: The finished flooring material (e.g., hardwood, carpet, tile) applied within the closet space.

name: Closet Light Fixture
description: A fixed light source, often motion-activated or switch-controlled, installed in the closet ceiling or wall.

name: Closet Electrical Rough-In
description: Concealed wiring, junction boxes, and switch runs serving the closet's lighting or outlet needs.

name: Pass-Through Closet
description: A closet configured with doors on two opposite sides, allowing passage between adjacent rooms.

name: Reach-In Closet
description: A shallow closet accessed directly from one side, typically with shelves and a single rod.

name: Walk-In Closet
description: A larger closet room that allows a person to enter and move around among storage fittings.

name: Closet Framing Construction
description: On-site assembly and erection of stud walls, headers, and door openings for the closet enclosure.

name: Closet Door Installation
description: Mounting and hanging the chosen door style into the closet opening, including hardware adjustment.

name: Closet Shelving & Rod Installation
description: Fitting and securing shelving brackets, shelves, and hanging rods within the closet interior.

name: Wall-to-Wall Closet
description: A built-in closet spanning the full width of a wall, often with continuous shelving and multiple doors.

name: Closet Ventilation Grille
description: A louvered or transfer grille installed in the closet wall or door to allow airflow and prevent moisture buildup.

name: Sunny Counter Base/Cabinet
description: The structural base or cabinet box that supports the countertop and provides storage underneath.

name: Sunny Countertop Surface
description: The horizontal work surface of the counter, finished with a durable material suitable for sunlit areas.

name: Sunny Counter Backsplash
description: The vertical protective wall surface behind the counter, extending from the countertop to the wall.

name: Sunny Counter Integrated Sink
description: A sink basin built into the countertop for washing tasks in a sunny location.

name: Sunny Counter Edge Profile
description: The finished edge detailing of the countertop, shaped to prevent damage and enhance appearance.

name: Sunny Counter Overhang/Seating Extension
description: A projecting portion of the countertop designed for casual seating or bar-style use.

name: Sunny Counter Drawer System
description: Built-in soft-close drawers housed within the counter base for organized storage.

name: Sunny Counter Under-Counter Lighting
description: Integrated task lighting installed beneath the counter overhang to illuminate the work area.

name: Sunny Counter Electrical Outlets
description: Receptacles integrated into the counter surface or backsplash for power access.

name: Sunny Counter Splash Apron
description: A decorative or protective panel facing the front of the counter base below the countertop.

name: Sunny Counter Material - Quartz
description: Engineered stone countertop material offering durability and UV resistance for sunny locations.

name: Sunny Counter Material - Solid Surface
description: Non-porous acrylic-based countertop material that resists sun fading and can be seamlessly formed.

name: Sunny Counter Material - Stainless Steel
description: Heat- and light-reflective metal countertop material suitable for commercial kitchens in bright areas.

name: Sunny Counter Material - UV-Resistant Laminate
description: High-pressure laminate with UV-stabilized finish to prevent yellowing in direct sunlight.

name: Sunny Counter - Standing Height Variant
description: A taller counter configuration at 40-42 inches designed for standing work or bar seating.

name: Sunny Counter - Counter Height Variant
description: A standard 36-inch high counter configuration suitable for food preparation and casual dining.

name: Sunny Counter - L-Shaped Layout
description: An angled two-leg counter configuration that optimizes corner space in a sunlit area.

name: Sunny Counter - Peninsula Layout
description: A counter extending from a wall or main run, open on three sides and often including seating.

name: Sunny Counter - Island Configuration
description: A standalone counter positioned in the middle of a sunlit space, accessible from all sides.

name: Install Sunny Counter Base Cabinets
description: On-site installation of the counter's supporting cabinet box, including leveling and anchoring to the floor or wall.

name: Install Sunny Countertop
description: On-site placement, alignment, and securing of the prefabricated countertop onto the base cabinets.

name: Install Sunny Counter Backsplash
description: On-site installation of backsplash tiles or panels behind the counter, including cutting and sealing.

name: Install Sunny Counter Sink and Plumbing
description: On-site fitting of the integrated sink basin and connection of hot and cold water supply and drain lines.

name: Seal Sunny Counter Seams and Edges
description: On-site application of seam adhesive and sealant to countertop joints and edge profiles for watertightness.

name: Wire Sunny Counter Electrical Components
description: On-site rough-in and connection of under-counter lighting and integrated electrical outlets.

name: Sunny Counter Reception Desk Variant
description: A hospitality or office counter configuration with a raised front panel, designed for greeting visitors in a bright lobby.

name: Sunny Counter Wet Bar Extension
description: A counter extension featuring a small sink, glass storage, and drink-prep area in a sunlit room.

name: Open Shelf Bracket
description: A metal or plastic L-shaped bracket that fastens to a wall to support a single open shelf.

name: Open Shelf Standard/Rail
description: A vertical slotted metal strip anchored to the wall into which shelf bracket clips are inserted, forming an adjustable shelving system.

name: Shelf Pin/Clip
description: A small peg or clip inserted into holes in a shelf standard or side panel to support a shelf at a chosen height.

name: Wall Cleat
description: A concealed horizontal timber or metal strip fastened to the wall that a shelf sits or hooks onto for a floating appearance.

name: Corbel
description: A decorative or structural projecting bracket, often of wood or stone, that supports the underside of an open shelf.

name: Open Shelf Panel/Board
description: The flat horizontal surface (e.g., solid wood, MDF, plywood, glass, or metal) that forms the shelf itself.

name: Floating Shelf
description: A self-contained shelf unit with an internal hidden bracket system that mounts flush to the wall with no visible supports.

name: Corner Shelf
description: A triangular or quadrant-shaped open shelf designed to fit into an interior corner of a room.

name: Fixed Wall Shelving
description: A system of multiple open shelves permanently fastened to wall standards or cleats, forming a non-movable storage arrangement.

name: Adjustable Wall Shelving
description: A shelving system with vertical standards and repositionable brackets or clips allowing shelf heights to be reconfigured.

name: Cantilevered Shelving System
description: A commercial/industrial shelving system where shelves mount onto slotted upright posts with no face frames or vertical dividers between shelves.

name: Open Storage Unit
description: A freestanding or built-in case of multiple open shelves without doors or drawers, often with side panels and a back panel.

name: Bracket Shelf Installation
description: The on-site process of marking layout, fastening brackets or standards to the wall, and placing shelf boards onto supports.

name: Floating Shelf Installation
description: The on-site process of cutting a recess or installing a concealed cleat into the wall, then sliding or bolting the shelf into position flush to the wall.

name: Built-In Open Shelving Framing
description: The on-site construction of a framed alcove or niche with plywood or timber shelf supports as part of interior fit-out.

name: Open Shelf
description: A horizontal storage surface with no front cover or door, typically mounted on a wall or within a cabinet, allowing visible access to items.

name: Shelf Bracket
description: A structural bracket fixed to the wall that supports the shelf board of a waist-high shelf.

name: Shelf Board
description: The horizontal load-bearing surface of a waist-high shelf, typically made of wood, MDF, or metal.

name: Shelf Trim / Nosing
description: A decorative or protective edge piece applied to the front of the shelf board to finish the exposed edge.

name: Shelf Support Cleat
description: A continuous horizontal strip of wood or metal fastened to the wall beneath the shelf to provide additional bearing support.

name: Built-in Waist-high Shelf
description: A fixed, site-built shelving unit at waist height, often integrated into cabinetry or wall framing as part of the building fabric.

name: Free-standing Waist-high Shelf Unit
description: A prefabricated, self-supporting shelving system at waist height that is installed and fixed in place within a room.

name: Display Shelf (Waist-high)
description: A waist-high shelf specifically designed for displaying items, commonly found in retail or reception areas.

name: Counter Shelf
description: A waist-height shelf surface that also serves as a writing or transaction counter, often in lobbies or service areas.

name: Shelf Support Installation
description: On-site installation of brackets, cleats, or support strips to the wall or structure to receive the shelf board.

name: Shelf Board Fixing
description: On-site placement and securing of the shelf board onto the installed supports or brackets.

name: Shelf Levelling and Alignment
description: On-site adjustment of the shelf assembly to ensure horizontal level and proper alignment with adjacent elements.

name: Shelf Edge / Trim Application
description: On-site attachment of edge trim, nosing, or decorative moulding to the exposed front edge of the shelf.

name: Shelf to Backing Wall Interface
description: The junction detail between the rear edge of the shelf and the wall surface, including any back-splash or sealant.

name: Shelf Underside Panel
description: A finished panel applied to the underside of the shelf for aesthetic concealment of brackets and wiring.

name: ADA / Accessibility Clearance Zone (Shelf)
description: The required clear floor space and reach range around a waist-high shelf to comply with accessibility codes.

name: Stadium Bleacher
description: Tiered telescopic or fixed bench seating for sports venues and gymnasiums, either retractable or permanently anchored.

name: Seating Step/Terraced Step
description: Precast or cast-in-place concrete or masonry steps in amphitheaters and outdoor plazas designed for audience seating.

name: Fixed Waiting Area Seat
description: Floor-mounted single or multi-person seats in transit stations, lobbies, or medical facilities with integrated armrests.

name: Integrated Storage Seat
description: Seating unit with a hinged top or drawer compartments beneath the seat surface for storage within the building millwork.

name: Courtroom Bench
description: Fixed raised seating for judges or public gallery seating custom-built into courtroom joinery.

name: Bar Stool Anchored Base
description: Floor-fixed pedestal base for counter-height seating at bars or reception counters, permanently mounted to the structure.

name: Seating Upholstery and Finish
description: Applied fabric, leather, or vinyl covering and padding on built-in seat surfaces meeting fire and durability codes.

name: Seat Mounting Bracket
description: Metal or concealed sub-frame anchoring the seat to the floor, wall, or structure including cantilever supports.

name: Cave Niche
description: A recessed alcove or pocket within a child cave that provides a semi-enclosed, intimate retreat for one or two children.

name: Cave Entrance Tunnel
description: A constricted, tunnel-like passage that forms the threshold between the main room and the interior of the child cave.

name: Cave Interior Floor Finish
description: Soft or cushioned flooring (e.g., foam tiles, carpet, rubber) installed inside the cave for comfort and safety.

name: Cave Wall Lining
description: Acoustic or tactile wall covering applied to the interior surfaces of the child cave to dampen sound and provide a soft texture.

name: Cave Structure Frame
description: The primary load-bearing framework (timber, steel studs, or modular panels) that defines the cave's shape and supports all cladding.

name: Cave Interior Lighting
description: Built-in low-voltage LED strip lights or puck lights recessed into the cave ceiling or walls to provide ambient or task illumination.

name: Cave Ventilation Grille
description: A fixed or adjustable grille integrated into the cave structure to allow passive air exchange with the surrounding room.

name: Cave Cladding Panel
description: Decorative interior-facing panels (e.g., plywood, HPL, fabric-wrapped board) that form the finished visible surfaces of the cave.

name: Cave Acoustic Insulation
description: Sound-absorbing batts or foam placed within the cave wall/ceiling cavities to reduce noise transmission.

name: Cave Window / Glazed Opening
description: A small fixed or operable window set into the cave wall to admit natural light and allow visual connection to the outside.

name: Cave Built-in Bench / Shelf
description: A fixed seat or storage shelf integrated into the cave interior, forming part of the structure rather than loose furniture.

name: Cave Access Hatch / Door
description: A small hinged or sliding panel that serves as the closure for the cave entrance, often child-sized and safety-latched.

name: Child Cave Construction
description: On-site assembly, framing, cladding, and finishing of the child cave within the larger room.

name: Child Cave Lighting Installation
description: On-site wiring, mounting, and connection of the built-in lighting fixtures within the child cave.

name: Secret Room
description: A concealed room designed to be hidden from ordinary view, often accessed through a hidden door or secret passage.

name: Hidden Compartment
description: A small concealed void or cavity within walls, floors, or joinery for discreet storage.

name: Panic Room / Safe Room
description: A fortified, secure space with reinforced construction for personal protection during emergencies.

name: Secret Passage / Hidden Corridor
description: A concealed circulation route integrated into the building fabric, accessed via disguised entry points.

name: Hidden Door Assembly
description: A door disguised as a bookshelf, wall panel, mirror, or other element to conceal an opening.

name: Disguised Wall Panel
description: A removable or pivoting wall panel that blends seamlessly with adjacent wall finishes to hide an opening.

name: Concealed Hinge & Hardware Set
description: Specialized hinges, latches, and release mechanisms hidden within the door or frame to enable secret access.

name: Secret Latch / Magnetic Release
description: A hidden locking or release device operated by a concealed button, magnet, or pressure mechanism.

name: Ventilation Grill Concealment
description: A removable vent or grille that serves as a hidden entry or observation point within the HVAC system.

name: One-Way Mirror / Observation Window
description: A glazed panel that allows viewing from the concealed side while appearing as an ordinary mirror or wall on the exposed side.

name: Hidden Surveillance System
description: Concealed cameras and monitoring equipment integrated within the building fabric for discrete observation.

name: Acoustic Isolation Construction
description: Soundproofing layers and construction techniques to prevent noise from revealing the presence or activity within a secret space.

name: Concealed Wiring & Conduit System
description: Electrical and data cabling routed behind secret walls or panels to serve hidden spaces without visible infrastructure.

name: Hidden Light Fixture
description: Lighting integrated into disguised elements such as picture sconces, crown molding, or false books.

name: Secret Floor Trapdoor
description: A flush floor hatch with concealed hinges and matching flooring for access to basements or sub-floor cavities.

name: Bookshelf Door System
description: A pivoting or sliding bookshelf unit that serves as both storage and a disguised entry door.

name: Concealed Wall Safe
description: A security safe recessed into a wall cavity behind a removable or disguised panel.

name: Hidden Staircase
description: A concealed vertical circulation path, often narrow or spiral, connecting secret floors or rooms.

name: Secret Room Wall Construction
description: On-site framing and finishing of walls around a secret room, including installation of hidden doors and acoustic insulation.

name: Hidden Door Installation
description: Installation of the disguised door assembly, concealed hinges, and release mechanism within the wall opening.

name: Acoustic Seal Installation
description: Application of acoustic gaskets, seals, and insulation around secret spaces to prevent sound leakage.

name: Concealed Electrical Rough-In
description: Routing and termination of electrical wiring and low-voltage cabling behind hidden panels and within secret cavities.

name: Secret Latch & Release Mechanism Installation
description: Fitting and calibration of disguised latches, magnetic releases, and trigger devices for secret access points.

name: One-Way Glass Installation
description: On-site glazing of a one-way mirror observation window into a wall or door frame between spaces.

name: Social Hub / Piazza
description: A large, centrally located open space designed as the primary social anchor of a building, encouraging informal gatherings, circulation, and visual connectivity.

name: Atrium / Internal Street
description: A multi-story top-lit or daylit volume that functions as both a circulation spine and a social meeting point, often flanked by balconies and glazed frontages.

name: Breakout / Lounge Zone
description: An informal, furnished area adjacent to workspaces or classrooms designed for casual interaction, relaxation, and spontaneous collaboration.

name: Community / Common Room
description: A shared indoor room intended for group activities, social events, and community gathering, equipped with flexible seating and basic amenities.

name: Social Stair / Gathering Stair
description: A wide, stepped assembly with integrated seating and landings that serves both as a vertical circulation element and as an informal amphitheater for social interaction.

name: Integrated Bench / Window Seat
description: A fixed built-in seating element placed along walls, windows, or corridor edges, designed to accommodate casual perching and conversation.

name: Reception / Welcome Desk
description: A fixed counter and work station at the main entry that provides an identifiable point of arrival, wayfinding assistance, and social orientation.

name: Fitted Auditorium Seating / Tiered Benches
description: Fixed stepped seating rows installed in a lecture hall, theater, or assembly space, with integrated aisle railings and under-seat ventilation.

name: Social Zone Floor Finish
description: Durable, acoustically-absorptive flooring material (carpet tile, rubber, or timber) applied to social zones to reduce noise and define the area.

name: Acoustic Ceiling Cloud / Baffle
description: A suspended sound-absorbing panel or baffle system installed above social spaces to control reverberation and speech privacy.

name: Social Space Partition / Glazed Screen
description: A full-height or half-height glazed or solid demountable partition that visually connects social spaces while providing acoustic separation from adjacent circulation.

name: Built-in Display / Pin-up Wall
description: A fixed wall surface finished with tackable, writable, or magnetic material, intended for informal sharing of information and community content.

name: Kitchenette / Tea Point
description: A compact, fitted niche with a sink, countertop, cabinetry, and sometimes a microwave, serving as a social catalyst for informal breaks and conversation.

name: Social Zone Lighting System
description: A zoned, dimmable, and often decorative lighting installation designed to create a warm, inviting atmosphere and support varied social activities.

name: Install Social Seating and Benches
description: On-site installation, anchoring, and leveling of fixed built-in seating components including benches, window seats, and tiered seating.

name: Install Glazed Social Screens
description: On-site erection and glazing of demountable or fixed partition screens that define social space boundaries.

name: Install Social Zone Flooring
description: On-site laying, cutting, and finishing of specified floor finish materials within designated social interaction zones.

name: Commission Social Zone Lighting
description: On-site installation, focusing, and dimming-system calibration of decorative and task lighting fixtures in social spaces.

name: Install Social Stair Structure and Seating
description: On-site erection of steel or concrete stair frame, installation of treads, landings, and fixed seating elements for a gathering stair.

name: Load-Bearing Frame
description: The skeletal structural system (columns, beams, slabs) that transfers gravity and lateral loads to the foundation.

name: Lateral Force Resisting System
description: Bracing, shear walls, or moment frames designed specifically to resist wind and seismic forces.

name: Structural Wall
description: Walls designed to carry vertical loads and/or resist lateral forces, distinct from non-load-bearing partitions.

name: Structural Connection
description: Joints, splices, brackets, and fasteners that transfer forces between structural members.

name: Structural Steelwork
description: Hot-rolled steel sections (I-beams, channels, angles) and plates used for beams, columns, and bracing.

name: Structural Timber
description: Engineered wood products (glulam, cross-laminated timber, LVL) and heavy sawn lumber used for load-bearing members.

name: Masonry Structure
description: Load-bearing assemblies of brick, block, or stone units bonded with mortar.

name: Precast Concrete Element
description: Factory-cast concrete components (hollowcore planks, double-tees, wall panels) assembled on site.

name: Formwork and Falsework
description: On-site assembly and erection of temporary molds and supports for casting in-situ concrete structural elements.

name: Reinforcement Installation
description: On-site cutting, bending, tying, and placing of reinforcing steel bars and mesh within formwork before concrete pour.

name: Concrete Placement and Curing
description: On-site pouring, vibrating, finishing, and controlled curing of structural concrete.

name: Post-Tensioning
description: On-site tensioning of high-strength steel tendons within concrete after the concrete has gained sufficient strength.

name: Structural Connection Installation
description: On-site bolting, welding, grouting, or fastening of structural connections between prefabricated or cast-in-place members.

name: Sustainable Wood
description: Certified timber products used for structural framing, cladding, and finishes that meet sustainability standards.

name: Recycled Steel
description: Steel components with high recycled content used for structural framing, reinforcement, and building systems.

name: Low-VOC Paints & Coatings
description: Paints, varnishes, and sealants formulated to minimize volatile organic compound emissions for healthier indoor air.

name: Recycled Aggregate Concrete
description: Concrete incorporating crushed recycled concrete or other recycled aggregates as partial replacement for virgin stone.

name: Natural Stone
description: Dimension stone quarried with low environmental impact for cladding, flooring, and architectural features.

name: Biobased Insulation
description: Insulation materials derived from renewable sources such as cellulose, sheep's wool, hemp, or cork.

name: Recycled Glass
description: Glass products made from post-consumer or post-industrial cullet used for glazing, partitions, or decorative elements.

name: Rapidly Renewable Flooring
description: Flooring materials such as bamboo, cork, or linoleum made from fast-growing renewable resources.

name: Salvaged/Reclaimed Materials
description: Building components recovered from demolished structures and reused in new construction, including bricks, timbers, and fixtures.

name: Green Concrete Mixes
description: Concrete formulations using supplementary cementitious materials like fly ash, slag, or silica fume to reduce cement content.

name: Non-Toxic Sealants & Adhesives
description: Low-emission bonding and sealing products formulated without hazardous chemicals for healthy building assembly.

name: Durable Composite Decking
description: Recycled wood-plastic composite boards used for exterior decking, walkways, and outdoor platforms.

name: Recycled Metal Cladding
description: Exterior wall panels and roofing made from recycled aluminum, copper, or steel with high recycled content.

name: Low-Embodied-Energy Masonry
description: Masonry units such as compressed earth blocks, AAC blocks, or interlocking bricks with reduced manufacturing energy.

name: Natural Fiber Carpets
description: Carpeting made from wool, sisal, coir, or jute without synthetic backing or high-VOC adhesives.

name: Recycled Plastic Construction Products
description: Building products such as lumber substitutes, park benches, and drainage cells made from recycled plastics.

name: Low-Carbon Gypsum Board
description: Drywall manufactured with reduced embodied carbon through recycled content and alternative calcination processes.

name: Straw Bale Construction
description: Building system using baled straw as infill insulation within structural frames for highly insulated walls.

name: Rammed Earth
description: Compacted natural soil wall construction offering thermal mass and low embodied carbon.

name: Cob Construction
description: Monolithic wall material made from clay, sand, and straw mixed and built in place.

name: Recycled Rubber Flooring
description: Flooring tiles or sheets made from recycled tire rubber used in gyms, play areas, and utility spaces.

name: Low-Carbon Insulation Foam
description: Spray foam or rigid board insulation formulated with low global-warming-potential blowing agents.

name: Recycled Content Ceiling Tiles
description: Acoustic ceiling panels manufactured with recycled mineral wool, paper, or metal content.

name: Bamboo Structural Products
description: Engineered bamboo beams, columns, and panels used as renewable alternatives to dimension lumber.

name: Green Roof Growing Medium
description: Lightweight engineered soil substrate specifically formulated for vegetative roof assemblies.

name: Ferrock
description: Iron-rich waste-based binder material used as a carbon-negative alternative to Portland cement.

name: Hempcrete
description: Lightweight biocomposite material made from hemp hurds and lime binder used for insulation walls.

name: Mycelium Building Materials
description: Fungal-based biodegradable blocks and panels used for insulation and interior fit-out applications.

name: Recycled Bricks
description: Whole or crushed reclaimed bricks from demolition used for new masonry walls or paving.

name: Sustainable Material Sourcing Verification
description: On-site inspection and documentation of material certifications and chain-of-custody to verify green material claims.

name: Material Waste Sorting & Recycling Installation
description: Setting up on-site material separation stations and recycling collection systems for construction waste.

name: Low-Impact Material Installation
description: Site installation of sustainable materials following manufacturer guidelines to maintain environmental certifications.

name: Material Conditioning & Curing
description: On-site preparation, conditioning, and curing of natural and bio-based materials to achieve required performance.

name: Green Roof Growing Medium Placement
description: Installation and grading of engineered growing medium on vegetative roof assemblies.

name: Rammed Earth Wall Construction
description: On-site compaction of moist earth in formwork to build monolithic load-bearing or infill walls.

name: Straw Bale Wall Assembly
description: Placing and compressing straw bales within structural frames and applying finish plasters on-site.

name: Cob Wall Building
description: Hand-building monolithic cob walls by layering and shaping clay-sand-straw mix on-site.

name: Low-VOC Material Application
description: Application of paints, coatings, sealants, and adhesives with strict ventilation and curing protocols for low emissions.

name: Reclaimed Material Integration
description: On-site cleaning, preparation, and installation of salvaged building components into new assemblies.

name: Green Material Storage & Protection
description: On-site handling, storage, and weather protection of sensitive sustainable materials to preserve their integrity.

name: Progressive Collapse Resistance
description: Structural system designed to prevent disproportionate collapse by allowing alternative load paths after local failure of vertical elements.

name: Stiffness-Graded Frame
description: Structural frame with varying member stiffnesses along building height to control drift and redistribute lateral loads progressively.

name: Belt Truss / Outrigger System
description: Horizontal trusses at intermediate levels coupling core to perimeter columns to create gradual stiffening bands up the building.

name: Tapered Building Form
description: Building geometry that narrows with height, providing inherent progressive stiffening by reducing overturning moments and wind exposure.

name: Stepped Column Stiffening
description: Columns with increasing cross-section or reinforcement toward lower floors to gradually increase stiffness as gravity and lateral loads accumulate.

name: Gradual Shear Wall Thickening
description: Shear walls whose thickness increases incrementally from top to base to provide proportional stiffening under lateral loads.

name: Stiffness-Tuned Floor Diaphragm
description: Floor slab or diaphragm designed with variable thickness or reinforcement zones to transfer lateral loads with controlled stiffness progression.

name: Installation of Stiffening Outriggers
description: On-site erection and connection of steel or concrete outrigger trusses between the core and perimeter columns at designated levels.

name: Placement of Progressive-Stiffness Shear Wall Reinforcement
description: On-site installation of rebar cages and post-tensioning tendons for shear walls with stepwise increasing reinforcement ratios down the building height.

name: Construction of Stiffness-Graded Column Zones
description: On-site forming, pouring, and curing of concrete columns with distinct stiffness zones, including transition regions where cross-section changes.

name: Transfer Plate / Podium Stiffening
description: Thick reinforced concrete slab or plate at the transition between tower and podium that distributes loads and provides a sudden stiffening step.

name: Gradual Bracing Stiffness System
description: Steel bracing configuration with varying member sizes and connection stiffnesses along building height to create a progressive lateral stiffening effect.

name: Eaves / Soffit
description: The projecting lower edge of the roof including the underside soffit that encloses and vents the roof overhang.

name: Roof Penetrations / Curbs
description: Structures built around openings through the roof for vents, flues, skylights, or mechanical equipment.

name: Roof Framing
description: The structural assembly of rafters, trusses, purlins, or beams that supports the roof deck and transfers loads.

name: Roof Truss
description: A prefabricated triangular framework of timbers or steel that forms the primary roof support structure.

name: Gutter System
description: The horizontal channels at the roof edge that collect and direct rainwater to downspouts.

name: Flat Roof
description: A roof with minimal slope designed for waterproof membrane application, often usable as terrace or mechanical pad.

name: Pitched Roof
description: A sloped roof geometry that sheds water by gravity, typically covered with shingles, tiles, or metal panels.

name: Roof Installation (Activity)
description: On-site assembly, fastening, and sealing of roof structural elements, decking, and coverings.

name: Roof Waterproofing (Activity)
description: Application and sealing of membrane or liquid-applied waterproofing layers on the roof substrate.

name: Roof Insulation Installation (Activity)
description: Placing and securing thermal insulation boards or batts within the roof assembly.

name: Gutter & Downspout Installation (Activity)
description: On-site fitting and connecting of roof drainage components to direct water away from the building.

name: Skylight Installation (Activity)
description: Setting and sealing prefabricated skylight units into the prepared roof opening.

name: Ceiling Membrane
description: The visible undersurface finish of a ceiling, which may be gypsum board, acoustic tile, metal panel, or plaster.

name: Suspended Ceiling Grid
description: The hanging metal framework that supports ceiling panels and integrates lighting, HVAC diffusers, and sprinklers.

name: Floor Finish Layer
description: The top wearing surface of a floor, such as tile, hardwood, carpet, vinyl, polished concrete, or stone.

name: Underlayment
description: A leveling, cushioning, or sound-isolating layer placed between the structural slab and the finished floor surface.

name: Radiant Floor Heating/Cooling
description: Embedded tubing or electric cables within the floor construction that circulate heated or chilled fluid for thermal conditioning.

name: Structural Decking
description: The metal or wood paneling spanning between beams that supports the floor slab or concrete fill above.

name: Floor Drain & Trench
description: Plumbing fittings integrated into the floor slab for water collection, including drains, trenches, and channel grates.

name: Expansion Joint Cover
description: A bridging assembly that accommodates movement between adjacent floor slabs while maintaining a finished surface.

name: Ceiling Suspension Hanger
description: Vertical wire or rod assemblies that attach the ceiling grid to the overhead structure.

name: Acoustic Ceiling Panel
description: A sound-absorbing tile or baffle installed in the ceiling to reduce reverberation and control noise levels.

name: Cove Base
description: A curved molding or trim installed at the junction of floor and wall to provide a clean, cleanable transition.

name: Floor Box / Floor Outlet
description: A flush or raised electrical/data access point installed within the floor finish for plug-in connectivity.

name: Floor Framing (Joists & Beams)
description: The horizontal support members beneath the floor deck that transfer loads to columns or bearing walls.

name: Ceiling-Mounted Track & Curtain
description: Overhead rails and curtain systems fixed to the ceiling for space division, privacy, or acoustic separation.

name: Sound Isolation Mat
description: A resilient mat placed beneath floor finish or ceiling layers to reduce impact and airborne sound transmission.

name: Fire-Rated Floor/Ceiling Assembly
description: An integrated floor and ceiling construction designed and tested to provide a specific fire-resistance rating between floors.

name: Floor Leveling Compound
description: A self-leveling cementitious or polymer topping applied over a slab to create a smooth, flat substrate for flooring.

name: Ceiling T-Bar Spline & Clip
description: Small metal connectors and splices used to join and align sections of a suspended ceiling grid system.

name: Grout & Joint Filler
description: Cementitious or epoxy material used to fill joints between floor tiles and ceiling panels for seamless appearance.

name: Stair Tread & Landing
description: The horizontal walking surfaces of stairs and intermediate platforms, integral to floor-to-floor vertical circulation.

name: Floor-to-Ceiling Height (Clearance)
description: The measured vertical distance from finished floor to finished ceiling, a critical spatial parameter tracked in BIM.

name: Additional Insulation Layer
description: A supplementary thermal insulation board or blanket added to the exterior or interior face of the existing wall to increase overall R-value.

name: Thickened Structural Wythe
description: An increase in the thickness of the load-bearing masonry, concrete, or timber leaf of the outer wall to enhance structural capacity and thermal mass.

name: Cavity Fill Insulation Upgrade
description: Dense-packed or injected insulation material (e.g., mineral wool, foam) that fills an enlarged wall cavity to reduce heat loss.

name: Exterior Cladding Build-Out
description: A secondary rainscreen or cladding layer (e.g., brick slips, stone veneer, metal panels) installed over a deeper subframe to achieve a thicker outer skin.

name: Thickened Wall-to-Floor Connection
description: An enlarged junction detail where the thickened outer wall meets floor slabs, often including additional reinforcement and thermal break elements.

name: Expanded Window Reveal
description: A deeper window jamb and sill that results from the increased wall thickness, accommodating wider frames and improved perimeter insulation.

name: Thermal Break Insertion
description: A rigid insulation or non-conductive strip placed within the wall assembly to interrupt thermal bridging at slab edges or balconies.

name: Reinforced Foundation Bearing
description: A widened or deepened foundation strip or footing that supports the increased load and width of the thickened outer wall.

name: External Wall Insulation Retrofit Installation
description: On-site fixing of insulation boards and protective render to the existing outer wall exterior to achieve a thickened thermal envelope.

name: Cavity Wall Enlargement and Repointing
description: Demolition of existing inner leaf and reconstruction at a wider spacing to create a larger cavity, followed by repointing of masonry.

name: Corner Column
description: A vertical structural member positioned at the building corner, typically larger or more reinforced than perimeter columns due to higher load concentrations at edges.

name: Corner Column Foundation
description: The footing or pile cap specifically designed to transfer loads from a corner column to the ground, often eccentrically loaded.

name: Corner Column Capital
description: A flared or widened top section of a corner column that distributes loads from the structure or slab above.

name: Corner Column Base Plate
description: A steel plate anchored at the base of a corner column to distribute bearing forces and connect the column to its foundation.

name: Corner Column Reinforcement Cage
description: The assembly of longitudinal rebar and transverse ties or spirals encased within a concrete corner column.

name: Corner Column Cladding
description: The exterior finish or covering applied to a corner column for weather protection, fire rating, or architectural expression.

name: Corner Column Bracket
description: A projecting structural bracket at the corner column supporting beams, canopies, or building projections.

name: Corner Column Connection Joint
description: The interface where beams, slabs, or walls meet the corner column, including moment connections, shear connections, or seismic joints.

name: Corner Column Formwork
description: The temporary mold or shuttering system used to cast a concrete corner column in its final position.

name: Corner Column Erection
description: The on-site hoisting, positioning, and temporary bracing of a prefabricated steel or precast concrete corner column.

name: Corner Column Concrete Pouring
description: The on-site placement and consolidation of concrete into corner column formwork to create a monolithic structural element.

name: Corner Column Installation & Alignment
description: The on-site surveying, plumbing, and alignment of a corner column to ensure verticality and proper positioning at the building corner.

name: Corner Column Fireproofing Application
description: The on-site spray-applied or board-applied fire-resistive coating on a corner column to meet building code requirements.

name: Seismic Corner Column Detailing
description: A specialized system of enhanced reinforcement, confinement, or ductile detailing applied to corner columns in seismically active regions.

name: Corner Column Waterproofing System
description: The sealants, flashings, and membranes installed at the base and exterior face of a corner column to prevent moisture intrusion.

name: Corner Column Architectural Wrap
description: A decorative casing or surround enclosing a corner column for interior design or exterior aesthetic continuity.

name: Column Grid Layout
description: The organized arrangement of columns in a regular or irregular grid pattern defining the structural bay system of the building.

name: Column Spacing
description: The measured distances between adjacent column centers along each axis of the structural grid.

name: Column Size & Section
description: The cross-sectional dimensions and profile shape (rectangular, circular, L-shaped, etc.) of each column element.

name: Column Reinforcement
description: The arrangement of longitudinal rebar and transverse ties or spirals within reinforced concrete columns.

name: Column Formwork Installation
description: On-site assembly and erection of formwork molds to shape and support poured concrete columns until curing.

name: Column Concrete Pouring
description: On-site placement and vibration of concrete into column formwork to achieve the specified strength and finish.

name: Column Rebar Cage Assembly
description: On-site tying and positioning of reinforcement cages within column formwork prior to concrete placement.

name: Steel Column Erection
description: On-site hoisting, aligning, and bolting or welding of prefabricated steel columns into position on base plates.

name: Column Base Plate & Anchorage
description: The steel plate and anchor bolt assembly at the column base that transfers loads to the foundation.

name: Column Splice Connection
description: The mechanical or welded joint connecting multi-story column segments end-to-end in steel or precast construction.

name: Column Fireproofing Application
description: On-site spray-applied or board-applied fire-resistive coating or encasement around columns for fire rating compliance.

name: Column Cladding / Architectural Finish
description: Decorative or protective surface layer applied to columns for aesthetic integration with interior or exterior design.

name: Embedded Column Void / Sleeve
description: A pre-formed opening or sleeve cast into or through a column for passage of MEP services.

name: Column Tie Beam Connection
description: The junction detail where horizontal tie beams connect into columns for lateral stability and load distribution.

name: Pad Footing
description: An isolated concrete footing that supports a single column or pier and spreads its concentrated load to the ground.

name: Raft Foundation
description: A large continuous concrete slab that supports multiple columns or walls by spreading the entire building load over the full footprint area.

name: Mat Foundation
description: A thick concrete slab that supports the entire structure, used when soil bearing capacity is low and individual footings would be too large.

name: Caisson / Drilled Pier
description: A deep foundation element formed by drilling a large-diameter hole into the ground and filling it with reinforced concrete to support heavy concentrated loads.

name: Subgrade Preparation
description: The on-site excavation, grading, and compaction of soil to achieve the required bearing capacity and level for foundation construction.

name: Reinforcement Steel Placement
description: The on-site cutting, bending, and tying of steel rebar into a reinforcing cage within foundation formwork before concrete is cast.

name: Foundation Waterproofing Application
description: The on-site cleaning, priming, and application of waterproofing membranes or coatings to below-grade foundation surfaces.

name: Seismic Isolation Bearing
description: A flexible bearing placed between the foundation and superstructure that decouples the building from ground motion during an earthquake.

name: Anchor Bolt / Base Plate Assembly
description: Steel bolts cast into the foundation that secure the bottom plate or column base of the superstructure to the foundation system.

name: Foundation Vapor Barrier
description: A sheet membrane placed beneath a slab-on-grade to prevent moisture vapor migration from the soil into the building interior.

name: Slab structural layer
description: The primary load-bearing concrete or reinforced concrete layer forming the structural floor.

name: Reinforcement mesh
description: Steel reinforcing bars or welded wire mesh embedded within the slab for tensile strength.

name: Concrete cover / topping
description: A wear layer or topping applied over the structural slab to achieve required finish tolerance or slope.

name: Vapor barrier
description: A polyethylene or similar membrane laid beneath the slab to prevent moisture migration from the ground.

name: Rigid insulation layer
description: Extruded or expanded polystyrene boards placed below or within the slab assembly for thermal performance.

name: Blinding / lean concrete layer
description: A thin low-strength concrete layer placed on the subgrade as a clean working base for reinforcement and slab pouring.

name: Sub-base / hardcore fill
description: Compacted granular stone or crushed aggregate layer below the slab providing drainage and load distribution.

name: Expansion / contraction joints
description: Preformed joint strips, filler boards, or sealants installed to control cracking from thermal and shrinkage movements.

name: Edge / perimeter insulation
description: Vertical insulation strips placed around the slab perimeter to reduce thermal bridging at floor edges.

name: Ground bearing slab system
description: A slab cast directly on prepared ground distributing loads to the soil without intermediate piles or beams.

name: Suspended ground slab system
description: A slab spanning between foundation walls, beams, or piles with a void beneath for ventilation and radon control.

name: Radon extraction / vent mat
description: A gas-permeable membrane or mat layer beneath the slab connected to a vent pipe to collect and exhaust soil gases.

name: Under-slab drainage layer
description: A geocomposite or granular layer with perforated pipes that collects and conveys groundwater away from the slab.

name: Slab waterproof coating
description: A liquid-applied or sheet-applied waterproofing compound on the slab top surface before floor finishes.

name: Slab pouring and finishing
description: On-site placement, screeding, bull-floating, and troweling of the concrete to achieve specified flatness and texture.

name: Joint cutting and sealing
description: Saw-cutting control joints after initial set and installing sealant or joint filler strips.

name: Vapor barrier installation
description: Unrolling, lapping, and sealing vapor barrier sheets on the prepared sub-base before reinforcement placement.

name: Insulation placement
description: Laying rigid insulation boards and edge strips in position prior to concrete pour.

name: Reinforcement fixing
description: Tying steel reinforcing mesh or bars to the correct cover height using chairs and spacers before pouring.

name: Underfloor heating pipes
description: Hydronic or electric heating tubing embedded within the slab thickness for radiant floor heating.

name: Slab void formers
description: Hollow plastic or cardboard void-forming boxes used in suspended slabs to reduce concrete weight.

name: Ground moisture sensor
description: A fixed building-integrated sensor embedded below the slab to monitor humidity levels for facility management.

name: Structural screed
description: A bonded or unbonded cementitious topping applied on site over the structural slab to receive final floor finishes.

name: Solid Box Column
description: A monolithic box column formed from a single material such as concrete, masonry, or solid timber, providing structural vertical support through its entire cross-section.

name: Hollow Box Column
description: A box column with a hollow core, often formed by four side panels (steel plate, plywood, or precast concrete) to reduce weight while maintaining structural stiffness.

name: Steel Box Column
description: A fabricated steel column of rectangular or square hollow section, typically welded from four steel plates into a closed tubular shape for high load capacity.

name: Concrete Box Column
description: A cast-in-place or precast reinforced concrete column with a box-like cross-section, often used for large structural loads and fire resistance.

name: Timber Box Column
description: An engineered timber column built up from laminated veneer lumber (LVL), glulam, or cross-laminated sections into a square or rectangular profile.

name: Composite Box Column
description: A box column combining two or more materials (e.g., steel tube filled with concrete) to optimise strength, stiffness, and fire performance.

name: Box Column Base Plate
description: A thick steel plate welded or bolted to the bottom of a box column to distribute loads to the foundation and provide anchorage.

name: Box Column Cap/Head
description: A steel or reinforced concrete plate fitted at the top of a box column to transfer loads from the beam above evenly to the column walls.

name: Box Column Splice
description: A bolted or welded connection detail used to join two box column sections end-to-end at intermediate floors or splice points.

name: Box Column Diaphragm
description: An internal horizontal stiffener plate welded inside a hollow box column to resist local buckling and transfer lateral forces between connected beams.

name: Box Column Fireproofing
description: Intumescent paint, spray-applied fire-resistive material, or board cladding applied to a box column to achieve the required fire rating.

name: Box Column Cladding/Casing
description: Architectural finishing panels (gypsum, metal, stone, or wood) fixed around a structural box column for aesthetic or protective purposes.

name: Engaged Box Column
description: A box column partially embedded within a wall or partition so that only its face is exposed as an architectural feature or structural element.

name: Free-standing Box Column
description: A box column that stands entirely independent of adjacent walls, supporting a canopy, portico, or interior structural bay.

name: Box Column Formwork
description: Temporary steel or plywood shuttering assembled in a box shape to contain and shape concrete during casting of a box column.

name: Box Column Reinforcement Cage
description: The assembly of longitudinal rebar and lateral ties or spirals within a concrete box column formwork before pouring concrete.

name: Box Column Erection
