description: On-site process of placing bricks with mortar to construct walls, veneers, or pavements.

name: Tile and Brick Waterproofing Activity
description: On-site application of waterproof membranes or sealants to tile or brick assemblies to prevent moisture intrusion.

name: Applied Ornament
description: Decorative elements attached to surfaces, such as cornices, moldings, rosettes, and decorative brackets, that are fixed to the building fabric.

name: Carved Ornament
description: Decorative features carved directly into building materials like stone, wood, or plaster, including reliefs, capitals, and sculpted motifs.

name: Cast Ornament
description: Prefabricated decorative elements made from cast materials such as plaster, concrete, or metal, including medallions, urns, and balusters.

name: Ornamental Cladding
description: Decorative surface covering systems like terracotta facades, decorative tiles, ornamental brickwork, and patterned stone veneer.

name: Ornamental Metalwork
description: Decorative metal elements such as wrought-iron railings, grilles, gates, finials, and ornamental screens integrated into the building.

name: Ornamental Glass
description: Decorative glazing including stained glass, etched glass, leaded glass panels, and ornamental transoms integrated into windows or doors.

name: Ornamental Ceiling
description: Decorative ceiling treatments such as coffered ceilings, decorative plaster ceilings, tray ceilings with moldings, and ornamental ceiling medallions.

name: Ornamental Flooring
description: Decorative floor patterns and inlays including mosaic floors, parquetry, terrazzo patterns, and marble floor inlays.

name: Ornamental Column & Pilaster
description: Decorative structural or applied columns, pilasters, and half-columns featuring capitals, fluting, and base moldings as architectural ornament.

name: Ornamental Arch & Keystone
description: Decorative arches, archivolts, and keystones with ornamental detailing used in doorways, windows, and arcades.

name: Ornamental Frieze & Entablature
description: Horizontal decorative bands and entablature assemblies with carved or applied ornament typically located above columns or windows.

name: Ornamental Balustrade & Handrail
description: Decorative balustrades, handrails, and banisters with ornamental balusters, newels, and rail profiles along stairs and balconies.

name: Ornamental Mullion & Transom
description: Decorative window dividers including ornamental mullions, transoms, and tracery that form patterned window assemblies.

name: Ornamental Gutter & Downspout
description: Decorative rainwater goods such as ornamental gutters, downspouts, conductor heads, and scuppers with architectural detailing.

name: Ornamental Cornice
description: Projecting decorative molding at the top of walls or buildings, including box cornices, crown moldings, and bracketed cornices.

name: Ornamental Keystone & Voussoir
description: Decorative wedge-shaped stones forming an arch, with emphasized keystones featuring carving or applied ornament.

name: Ornamental Pediment & Gable
description: Decorative triangular or segmented pediments and gable treatments with moldings and sculptural ornament above entrances and windows.

name: Ornamental Niche & Aedicule
description: Decorative recessed niches and framed aedicules with ornamental surrounds used for statues, urns, or architectural emphasis.

name: Ornamental Rosette & Boss
description: Small decorative circular ornaments including ceiling rosettes, wall rosettes, and carved bosses at intersections of vault ribs.

name: Ornamental Quoin
description: Decorative corner stones or applied quoins that emphasize the edges of a building with contrasting materials or rusticated detailing.

name: Ornamental Parapet & Balustrade
description: Decorative parapet walls and roof balustrades featuring ornamental caps, corbels, and pierced stone or metal panels.

name: Ornamental Door Surround & Frame
description: Decorative door casings, architraves, and surrounds with moldings, pilasters, and pediments framing the door opening.

name: Ornamental Window Surround & Hood
description: Decorative window surrounds, hoods, sills, and lintels featuring moldings, brackets, and ornamental keystones.

name: Ornamental Corbelling
description: Projecting decorative masonry or concrete corbels and brackets supporting overhanging elements with ornamental profiles.

name: Ornamental String Course & Belt Course
description: Horizontal decorative bands projecting from the facade, including string courses, belt courses, and sill bands that articulate the building elevation.

name: Ornamental Medallion & Cartouche
description: Decorative oval or circular medallions and cartouches with carved or applied ornament, often containing inscriptions or reliefs.

name: Ornamental Spire & Finial
description: Decorative vertical termination elements such as spires, finials, pinnacles, and weather vanes atop roofs, towers, and gables.

name: Ornamental Cresting & Ridge
description: Decorative ridge cresting, ridge tiles, and roof-edge ornamentation along the ridges of roofs, often in metal or terracotta.

name: Ornamental Grille & Register
description: Decorative grilles, registers, and diffusers for HVAC or ventilation openings with ornamental patterns integrated into the building finish.

name: Ornamental Lighting Fixture
description: Decorative building-integrated light fixtures such as chandeliers, sconces, and pendant lights that are fixed to the building fabric.

name: Warm Color Paint
description: Interior or exterior paint with warm hue pigments (reds, oranges, yellows) applied to walls, ceilings, or trim.

name: Warm Color Wall Finish
description: A finished wall surface such as warm-toned plaster, wallpaper, or panels that imparts a warm color palette to a space.

name: Warm Color Floor Finish
description: Flooring material (tile, wood stain, vinyl, carpet) selected in warm tones like terracotta, ochre, or amber.

name: Warm Color Ceiling Finish
